raw.description:
Are you driven to reach your individual goals while mentoring your peers? Are you a top sales performer who is looking for an opportunity to make uncapped commissions while also making a difference in the world? Do you enjoy working from home in your PJs?

Then we want to meet you! Join our Local Splash family and love where you work!

We are growing quickly as we expand to new territories and are looking for hungry and talented sales professionals to help drive that growth! If you are someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment, enjoys working with people and has a strong student mentality - read on!

We provide an amazing opportunity with a company that has upward career opportunities, a phenomenal sales compensation structure and a fun and laid back atmosphere. This is a full-time work from home opportunity. Monday to Friday, 6:00 am to 3:00 pm (PST), no working weekends!

Responsibilities and Duties

After completing a dedicated 6-8 week sales associate training program to master our products and systems , the Senior Sales Associate will take pre-qualified live call transfers and walk the prospective client through the sales cycle. You will introduce the value proposition to the prospect and offer the product best suited for their online marketing needs. Additionally, you will leverage your expertise to mentor peers and sales associates to help achieve overall team goals.

  • Receive 10-15 pre-qualified transfers per day
  • Follow up on pipeline prospect and callbacks
  • Build rapport and engage prospects on Relevant Ads products
  • Utilize email correspondence, client testimonials, and market statistics to build interest
  • Effectively communicate appropriate rebuttals to all sales objections
  • Discuss online marketing needs and opportunities
  • Mentor peers and sales associates to achieve team goals
  • All Senior Sales Associates will begin their journey with a dedicated 2 week junior sales associate training program to thoroughly master our product offerings, systems, and core sales methodology.

Compensation & Benefits:

  • UNCAPPED commissions!
  • Base hourly rates are tailored competitively based on your experience and aligned with your local market's economic cost of living
  • OTE: $56,000 ~ $75,000 a year
  • Incentives such as spiffs, prizes, contests, bonuses, etc.
  • Business hours: Monday - Friday 6:00am - 3:00pm (PST). No weekends!
  • This position is 100% remote
  • Fantastic benefits: medical, dental, paid time off and 401(k) (Note: International roles are compensated via base rate plus commission and are not eligible for the U.S. benefits package).

Requirements:

  • Demonstrates a proven sales acumen
  • Demonstrates ability to communicate clearly over the phone
  • Must be able to type minimum of 50 WPM
  • Must have advanced computer and multi-tasking skills
  • Possesses an understanding of online advertising sales and current online advertising trends

Qualifications and Skills

  • 2+ years of experience as a sales closer position in: Inside sales, telesales, and/or SAAS.
  • 1+ years of experience working in a remote environment
  • Proven success in closing accounts and breaking sales records
  • Good communication and organizational skills, outgoing and ambitious
  • Self-starter, student mentally, detail oriented and punctual
  • Demonstrate integrity in interactions with clients and coworkers
  • Display a mature, professional and positive demeanor
  • Demonstrate our core values when handling confidential client information
  • Strive to meet and exceed weekly and monthly metrics and goals

Preferred:

  • 5+ years of sales experience in a sales closer position
  • 3+ years of experience working in a remote environment
  • Extensive knowledge of major search engines and search engine optimization
  • Google Ads Certified

Local Splash is an equal opportunity employer. We embrace diversity and we are committed to creating a versatile and fun environment for all employees.

Role Title: Hematology Physician

Role Type: Contractor

Location: United States, Remote

micro1 is engaging Hematology Physicians to participate in a high-impact customer project focused on advancing clinical AI solutions. In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. This opportunity is ideal for independent clinical experts interested in leveraging their hematology experience for transformative technology.

Scope of Work

  1. Review and annotate AI Generated transcripts of outpatient hematology clinic conversations for accuracy, clinical completeness, and clarity.
  2. Assess AI Generated documentation sections such as History of Present Illness (HPI), interval histories, and Assessment & Plans (A&Ps), providing input on appropriate information inclusion.
  3. Identify and comment on nuances of anticoagulation management, transfusion and iron therapy, treatment toxicities, laboratory discussions, and decision-making processes in clinical documentation.
  4. Provide feedback on how well AI Generated transcripts reflect real-world clinical reasoning and patient interactions, especially during follow-up visits.
  5. Contribute to the evaluation and improvement of AI scribe outputs or EHR note templates, as needed.

Preferred Qualifications

  1. Board certification in Hematology or Oncology with demonstrable outpatient clinical experience.
  2. Proficiency with electronic health records (EHR) and clinical documentation workflows.
  3. Deep familiarity with chemotherapy cycle management and hematologic malignancy care.
  4. Experience in crafting or reviewing patient histories, including histories of present illness and differential diagnosis.
  5. Strong attention to detail and ability to communicate complex concepts clearly in both written and spoken formats.
  6. Previous participation in clinical research, quality improvement, or AI/data-driven healthcare projects is a plus.
  7. Motivation to support innovative healthcare projects with real-world impact.

Role type: Contractor

Location: Remote, United States only

Commitment: Part-time, project-based

Compensation: $160–$180 USD per hour

About the role

micro1 is looking for experienced Medical Oncologists to support a customer project focused on improving AI-generated clinical documentation.

In this role, you'll use your clinical expertise to evaluate AI-generated transcripts and medical notes from outpatient oncology encounters. Your feedback will help improve the accuracy, completeness, and clinical relevance of AI-assisted documentation.

What you'll do

  1. Review AI-generated transcripts of outpatient oncology visits for clinical accuracy, completeness, and clarity.
  2. Evaluate clinical documentation, including History of Present Illness (HPI), interval histories, and Assessment and Plans (A&Ps).
  3. Identify inaccuracies or missing details related to cancer diagnoses, staging, treatment plans, and laboratory or imaging findings.
  4. Assess documentation of systemic cancer therapies, including chemotherapy, immunotherapy, targeted therapies, and supportive care.
  5. Review how clinical notes capture treatment responses, adverse effects, disease progression, and follow-up care.
  6. Provide clear, actionable feedback to improve AI-generated clinical notes and EHR documentation.

Required qualifications

  1. MD, DO, or equivalent medical degree, with board certification or eligibility in Medical Oncology.
  2. At least 2 years of recent outpatient medical oncology experience following fellowship.
  3. Strong clinical experience diagnosing and managing solid tumors, including treatment planning and longitudinal patient care.
  4. Proven ability to independently document HPIs, interval histories, and Assessment and Plans.
  5. Solid understanding of systemic cancer therapies, treatment-related toxicities, supportive care, and interpretation of laboratory and imaging results.
  6. Strong written communication skills and attention to clinical detail.
  7. Based in the United States.

Preferred qualifications

  1. Experience managing a broad range of solid tumors and complex oncology cases.
  2. Familiarity with AI scribe technology, EHR documentation templates, medical chart review, or clinical annotation projects.

Application process

Candidates will complete an AI interview to assess their relevant clinical expertise and experience.

raw.description:
The Brokerage Sales Internal Wholesaler is responsible for driving sales growth and deepening relationships with Tier B brokerage general agencies (BGAs) and newly recruited agencies. This role drives sales by proactively engaging assigned agencies via outbound phone calls, virtual meetings, and occasional in-person visits. The Internal Wholesaler (IW) is accountable for the total sales results of their assigned Tier B agencies and is compensated based on the performance of these agencies.

WHAT WE CAN OFFER YOU:

  • Estimated Salary: $60,000 - $80,000, plus annual bonus opportunity.
  • 401(k) plan with a 2% company contribution and 6% company match.
  • Work-life balance with vacation, personal time and paid holidays. See our benefits and perks page for details.
  • Applicants for this position must not now, nor at any point in the future, require sponsorship for employment.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Build and strengthen relationships with agency principals and key producers, with a focus on Tier B and newly recruited agencies, to drive fully underwritten life insurance sales.
  • Maintain a proactive sales cadence, connecting with approximately 15–20 agency personnel daily to identify opportunities, support producers, and grow business.
  • Identify and advance sales opportunities by assessing client needs, competitive positioning, and market dynamics, partnering with external sales directors on larger or more complex opportunities.
  • Develop proposals, respond to RFPs, deliver sales presentations, and clearly communicate product features, underwriting requirements, compensation, and operational processes.
  • Serve as a trusted resource to assigned agencies by providing product education, quoting support, sales guidance, and assistance with case readiness and implementation.
  • Execute sales and marketing strategies while partnering with underwriting, marketing, operations, and competitive analysis teams to support sales goals, profitability, and an effective customer experience.
  • Track agency activity, proposals, and sales in Salesforce; monitor progress toward goals; provide regular performance reporting; and stay current on industry trends and competitor offerings.

WHAT YOU’LL BRING:

  • Minimum 2 years of sales experience in life/health insurance or financial services, with brokerage distribution channels.
  • Strong organizational, problem-solving, analytical, and negotiation skills.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills; ability to build rapport and influence agency personnel.
  • Ability to handle multiple tasks simultaneously in a fast-paced, growth-oriented environment.
  • Strategic thinking and relationship management skills.
  • Must hold or obtain a Life/Health insurance license within 90 days of employment.
  • Familiarity with compliance requirements for insurance sales and broker-dealer regulations.
  • Proficiency with Salesforce and sales tracking tools.
  • You promote a collaborative culture, value different ideas and opinions, and listen courageously, remaining curious in all that you do.
  • Able to work remotely with access to a high-speed internet connection and located in the United States.

PREFERRED:

  • Experience supporting fully underwritten life insurance sales.
  • Knowledge of brokerage general agency operations and sales cycles.
  • Series 6, 7, 63, or 65/66 registration (if required by product line).
  • Experience with virtual sales and remote relationship management.

We value unique experience, skills, and passion for innovation. If your experience aligns with the listed requirements, please apply!

Work Flexibility: Remote

What you will do:

As our Principal Enterprise Architect, you will set the architecture direction for our Joint Replacement and Trauma & Extremities divisions and be accountable for the quality and consistency of architecture outcomes across the portfolio. Reporting to the Director of Enterprise Architecture, Orthopedics, you will serve as a recognized architecture authority, helping solve complex business challenges and defining strategies, standards, and patterns that influence decisions beyond a single project or platform.

You will connect business strategy to technology execution across products, platforms, data, AI, integration, cloud, digital customer experience, and operational capabilities. You will balance the speed and priorities of the divisions with enterprise needs for scale, reuse, security, compliance, and long-term sustainability.

Our technology landscape spans SAP, Salesforce, Oracle CPQ, Model N, ServiceMax, Genesys, Informatica, Varicent, Databricks, MuleSoft, and Microsoft Azure. You will help shape how these technologies and the capabilities they support come together, identifying opportunities for integration, reuse, simplification, modernization, and long-term scalability.

In this role, you will:

  • Lead architecture strategy for Joint Replacement and Trauma & Extremities, aligning business capabilities, growth priorities, operating-model needs, and customer outcomes with enterprise technology direction.
  • Translate business priorities into target-state architectures, transition plans, technology roadmaps, standards, and clear architectural tradeoffs.
  • Influence product and technology roadmaps, sequencing, and investment decisions by identifying dependencies, risks, reuse opportunities, and long-term implications.
  • Serve as a trusted architecture authority for complex decisions, constructively challenging assumptions and establishing approaches and patterns that can scale beyond an individual initiative.
  • Lead architecture assessments and decision forums, resolving issues within the divisions and escalating enterprise-impacting decisions with clear options, risks, and consequences.
  • Create, apply, and evolve reference architectures, standards, architectural principles, and reusable patterns that improve interoperability, security, quality, scalability, and consistency.
  • Assess portfolio health across lifecycle risk, redundancy, technical debt, resilience, and compliance, driving modernization, rationalization, consolidation, or decommissioning where appropriate.
  • Partner across Business, Product, Data & Analytics, AI, Cybersecurity, Infrastructure, Integration, Engineering, and delivery teams to build alignment and influence outcomes without relying on direct authority.
  • Evaluate emerging technologies and vendors through the lens of business value, organizational readiness, security, privacy, regulatory requirements, and sustainable enterprise scale.
  • Participate in strategic divisional and enterprise initiatives that require strong alignment between business strategy and technology architecture.
  • Maintain architecture roadmaps, decision records, capability and application views, and reference materials needed to support transparent, well-informed technology decisions.

What you need:

Required:

  • Bachelor’s degree from an accredited university in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Business, Data Science, or a related discipline preferred; applicable relevant professional experience may be considered in lieu of a degree.
  • 8+ years of progressive technology, architecture, digital, or related experience is preferred; scope and quality of experience are more important than tenure alone.
  • 4+ years of experience translating business needs into architecture decisions, target states, standards, roadmaps, and practical delivery guidance.
  • 2+ years of experience operating in a large, global, matrixed, or regulated environment
  • Experience operating in a large, global, matrixed, or regulated environment.
  • Strong written and verbal communication with the ability to tailor depth to technical, business, and executive audiences.
  • Demonstrated ability to collaborate and influence rather than rely solely on command and control.
  • Demonstrated success setting direction for a discipline, portfolio, or significant workstream.
  • Strong business judgment and ability to connect architecture choices to cost, risk, speed, and value

Preferred:

  • Master’s degree in a related field preferred for senior levels.
  • Certifications in TOGAF, cloud architecture, data, security, product management, or enterprise architecture preferred.

raw.description:
About us

At Viasat, the work you do helps people stay connected in ways that matter, from everyday moments to critical missions across air, land, sea, and space.

We’re a place for people who are curious, bold, and motivated by meaningful work. Here, you'll have the opportunity to make an impact, explore new possibilities, and grow your career in ways that align with your interests and goals. When you're ready to take on something new, you'll find leaders who support your development and help you turn your ambition into action.


What you'll do

The Key Markets Team is responsible for developing Viasat International Government's business in strategic growth markets. NATO is a fast growing market for Viasat with several campaigns being pursued in the Government sector.

This is a senior role that will cut across Viasat International Government and Viasat Government business. The candidate will be responsible for all business development activities that fall within NATO and be the key liaisons point for the business with NCIA and NSPA. They will be responsible for lead generation, opportunity development, campaign management with the business areas and stakeholder management with a focus on pipeline generation.

The candidate needs to have a good working knowledge of NATO setup, infrastructure and priorities as well as regional impact on NATO policy (Black Sea, High North, Eastern Flank, Baltics). A strong background in government sector business and the ability to work cross-domain, cross-functional and cross-business in virtual team set-ups is highly desirable.

The solutions that will be developed and delivered will allow government customers to deliver mission-critical communications and assure end users that they can operate with confidence to deliver outcomes, either as part of NATO programmes and/or capability procured by Member States through NATO frameworks.

The candidate will have the unique opportunity to work with business areas, business units, functional leaders and team members and corporate functions. Given the importance of the role there will be significant exposure with senior leadership.

Recruiting Assistant – Remote (Latin America)

Independent Contractor | Part-Time | USD $700–$900 Monthly

Grow Your Career in Talent Acquisition With Us!

Do you enjoy connecting with people, discovering talent, and helping others find meaningful career opportunities?

At Mendoza Companies, we're looking for a proactive, organized, and people-oriented Recruiting Assistant to support our Talent Acquisition efforts and help us create a positive experience for every candidate.

This opportunity is ideal for someone with some recruiting experience who enjoys learning, takes initiative, and is excited to develop professionally while supporting recruitment for U.S.-based operations.

You'll play an important role in keeping our hiring processes organized and moving forward, from reviewing applications and coordinating interviews to connecting with candidates and supporting their journey through the recruitment process.

We're not looking for someone who knows everything. We're looking for someone who is curious, dependable, detail-oriented, and genuinely motivated to grow with us.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Connecting with talent: Review applications, resumes, and screening responses to identify candidates who align with our job requirements.
  • Supporting the interview process: Coordinate AI-assisted interviews, communicate with candidates, monitor completion, and help them navigate the process.
  • Getting involved in interviews: Conduct structured first-round interviews for selected positions as you develop familiarity with our recruiting processes and expectations.
  • Exploring candidate assessments: Assist with researching, coordinating, and tracking approved job-related skills assessments and non-clinical psychometric evaluations.
  • Creating a great candidate experience: Maintain friendly, professional, and timely communication with candidates, including interview scheduling, updates, reminders, and follow-ups.
  • Keeping things organized: Maintain accurate candidate information, interview notes, and recruiting stages in BambooHR and other recruiting tools.
  • Helping us reach more candidates: Support approved job advertisements, sourcing activities, and recruiting outreach through LinkedIn, Facebook, job boards, and other platforms.
  • Supporting the hiring process: Assist with approved reference checks, recruiting updates, and basic coordination for new team members.

As you become more familiar with our company and processes, there may also be opportunities to support additional Human Resources administrative activities based on business needs and mutually agreed responsibilities.

What We're Looking For

  • Around 1 year of experience in recruitment, candidate screening, or Talent Acquisition support preferred.
  • Strong conversational and written English and Spanish, with the confidence to communicate professionally with U.S.-based candidates and conduct interviews in English.
  • Experience reviewing resumes, coordinating interviews, or communicating with candidates throughout a hiring process.
  • Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to prioritize multiple activities.
  • A proactive, dependable attitude and the ability to follow through on commitments.
  • Strong interpersonal skills, active listening, and a genuine interest in helping people.
  • Comfortable using Microsoft Teams, Outlook, Word, and basic Excel.
  • Willingness to learn new technology, including applicant tracking systems and AI-assisted recruiting tools.
  • Studies or a degree in Psychology, Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field are preferred.

Nice to Have (Not Required):

  • Experience using BambooHR or similar applicant tracking systems.
  • Familiarity with skills assessments or psychometric testing platforms.
  • Previous exposure to recruiting for U.S.-based companies.
  • Experience with Canva, LinkedIn, or social media recruiting.

What Makes This Opportunity Special?

We believe that great recruiting is about more than filling positions. It's about connecting the right people with meaningful opportunities while creating a respectful and positive experience throughout the process.

In this role, you'll have the opportunity to:

  • Gain practical exposure to recruiting for U.S.-based operations, including California and Nevada.
  • Develop your interviewing, candidate assessment, and recruitment coordination skills.
  • Explore how technology and AI can support modern Talent Acquisition.
  • Collaborate with people across different teams and professional backgrounds.
  • Contribute ideas, learn from feedback, and help us continuously improve our processes.

We value people who take ownership of their responsibilities, communicate openly, and are willing to learn and grow.

Engagement Details

Location: Remote – Latin America

Engagement Type: Part-Time Independent Contractor

Compensation: USD $700–$900 monthly service fee, depending on qualifications and relevant experience.

Initial Scope: Part-time services anticipated to be comparable to approximately 25 hours per week, with flexibility in organizing activities and coordination needs related to U.S. business operations.

Future Opportunities: The scope of services may expand to include additional recruiting or HR administrative responsibilities, depending on business needs, demonstrated capabilities, and mutual agreement.

Reliable internet access, suitable equipment, and a private environment for candidate communications are required.

A Little About Us

Mendoza Companies brings together businesses built around a shared mission, strong values, and a commitment to people.

Our companies include High-Light Electric, Inc. (HLE), a California-based electrical infrastructure contractor established in 1996, supporting public works and infrastructure projects that serve communities across California.

Guided by The Mendoza Way, we believe in professionalism, respect, service, collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement.

Our long-term Mission 2040 reflects our commitment to building businesses that create opportunities and positively impact families and communities.

We're proud of where we've come from, excited about where we're going, and always looking for people who want to contribute to something meaningful.

What to Expect During Our Recruitment Process

As part of our initial screening process, you may be invited to complete a short AI-assisted interview.

This helps us learn more about your experience and qualifications. It is one part of our overall evaluation process, which may also include conversations with our recruiting team.

If you need an accommodation or an alternative way to participate in an assessment or interview, please let our recruiting team know.

Interested in growing your Talent Acquisition experience while making a positive impact? We'd love to learn more about you!

Salary: USD $700–$900 Monthly

Come join out amazing team and work from home!

The Vice President, GSE Servicing will be responsible for serving as the company’s primary subject matter expert and point of contact for Fannie Mae and Freddie Mac servicing requirements, performance expectations, and strategic initiatives. Provides enterprise leadership and direction on government-sponsored enterprise (GSE) servicing procedures, scorecard performance, monthly business reviews, operational planning, and long-range strategy. Translates GSE guidance and performance feedback into clear business requirements, measurable action plans, and sustainable servicing practices across performing loans, default servicing, loss mitigation, investor reporting, claims, quality control, and related support functions. This position works closely with Servicing Operations, Compliance, Legal, Risk, Finance, Technology, Data and Analytics, and executive leadership to identify emerging risks and opportunities, drive accountability for corrective actions, and represent the company in formal and informal engagements with the GSEs. Performs all duties in accordance with company policies and procedures and applicable federal and state laws and regulations. The target pay for this position is $180,000-$225,000 plus Annual Bonus.

GSE Servicing Leadership and Relationship Management
• Serve as the primary servicing subject matter expert and point of contact for Fannie Mae and Freddie Mac, coordinating inquiries, escalations, reviews, and follow-up commitments.
• Establish and maintain productive relationships with GSE servicing, performance management, account management, and oversight teams.
• Represent the company in GSE meetings, examinations, onsite or virtual reviews, industry forums, and strategic discussions.
• Provide authoritative interpretation and practical application of GSE servicing requirements across the servicing organization.

Servicing Procedures, Governance, and Change Management
• Own enterprise governance for GSE servicing procedures and ensure operational practices align with current GSE guides, announcements, bulletins, directives, contracts, and approved variances.
• Lead cross-functional assessments of new or revised GSE requirements, define business impacts, assign accountable owners, and oversee implementation through documented completion and validation.
• Identify procedural gaps, control weaknesses, and inconsistent practices; sponsor corrective action plans and verify that changes are sustainable and embedded in daily operations.
• Partner with Compliance, Legal, Risk, Quality Control, Internal Audit, Technology, and business leaders to maintain defensible evidence of compliance and operational readiness.

Scorecard Performance and Remediation

• Lead oversight of Fannie Mae and Freddie Mac servicing scorecards, performance metrics, benchmarks, rankings, and related management reporting.
• Analyze performance trends and root causes across investor reporting, custodial accounting, loss mitigation, foreclosure, bankruptcy, claims, property preservation, customer service, and other applicable servicing functions.
• Establish performance targets, early-warning indicators, and operating tolerances; escalate material deterioration and recommend timely corrective action.
• Coordinate remediation plans in response to GSE findings or performance concerns, including milestones, owners, validation criteria, executive reporting, and closure evidence.

Monthly Business Reviews and Executive Reporting
• Plan and lead monthly GSE business reviews with internal executives and operational leaders, presenting scorecard results, portfolio trends, emerging risks, open findings, and strategic priorities.
• Develop concise, decision-oriented materials that connect servicing performance to financial, operational, compliance, reputation, and counterparty risk.
• Maintain an integrated inventory of GSE commitments, action items, exceptions, approvals, and due dates; drive timely completion and transparent status reporting.
• Prepare executives for GSE meetings by developing briefing materials, anticipated questions, performance narratives, and recommended positions.

Planning, Strategy, and Cross-Functional Execution
• Develop and maintain the GSE servicing strategy and annual operating plan, aligning portfolio objectives, capacity, technology, controls, and talent with GSE expectations and company priorities.
• Advise executive leadership on servicing policy changes, portfolio performance, emerging industry practices, counterparty risk, and opportunities to improve outcomes or reduce cost and exposure.
• Partner with Finance and Operations to evaluate the resource, technology, vendor, and financial implications of GSE initiatives and performance commitments.
• Sponsor strategic initiatives that improve borrower outcomes, operational effectiveness, data quality, automation, scalability, and scorecard performance.
• Support new client onboarding, servicing transfers, portfolio acquisitions, and product or process changes by validating GSE servicing requirements and readiness.
• Provide leadership, coaching, and subject matter guidance to team members and business partners; promote disciplined execution, accountability, and continuous improvement.

What you'll need:
• Bachelor’s degree in business, finance, accounting, risk management, or a related discipline preferred; equivalent relevant experience may be considered.
• Minimum fifteen (15) years of progressive mortgage servicing experience.
• Minimum ten (10) years of direct GSE servicing experience involving Fannie Mae and/or Freddie Mac requirements, performance management, or counterparty engagement.
• Executive-level experience leading GSE scorecard performance, business reviews, servicing procedure governance, remediation, and strategic planning.
• Prior experience leading cross-functional teams and influencing senior operational, risk, compliance, legal, finance, technology, and analytics partners.
• Servicing management, investor relations, compliance, risk, or related professional credentials are preferred.
• Ability to travel up to 25% to industry events and client onsite meetings.
• Expert knowledge of Fannie Mae and Freddie Mac servicing guides, announcements, performance frameworks, and counterparty expectations.
• Deep end-to-end knowledge of performing and default mortgage servicing, including customer service, escrow, investor reporting, custodial accounting, loss mitigation, foreclosure, bankruptcy, claims, property preservation, and quality control.
• Ability to function in a fast-paced, high-accountability environment requiring responsiveness, sound judgment, and adaptability.
• Demonstrated ability to interpret complex requirements and translate them into executable procedures, controls, training, technology requirements, and performance measures.
• Advanced analytical capability, including scorecard trend analysis, root-cause analysis, performance forecasting, and executive-level data storytelling.
• Ability to influence senior leaders and cross-functional teams without relying solely on direct authority and to drive timely resolution of complex issues.
• Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to act as the company’s principal spokesperson and trusted advisor in the area of GSE servicing.
• Strong executive presence and experience leading business reviews, regulatory or counterparty meetings, and formal presentations.
• Proven judgment in prioritizing material servicing, compliance, operational, and counterparty risks.
• Proficiency with Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, and enterprise reporting or business intelligence tools.

LearnTastic is seeking Fractional Chief Marketing Officer (CMO) - B2B & B2C Growth Strategy, to act as a true growth partner to our CEO and leadership team.

Key Responsibilities:

1. Overall Marketing Strategy & Business Growth

  • Develop and lead the overall marketing strategy across B2B and B2C business segments.
  • Identify new revenue opportunities, growth channels and market expansion opportunities.
  • Develop short-term and long-term marketing plans aligned with company revenue objectives.
  • Evaluate existing marketing strategies, identify gaps and recommend improvements.
  • Build a clear roadmap for increasing revenue, improving customer acquisition and maximizing marketing returns.
  • Provide strategic direction on brand positioning, market differentiation and competitive positioning.
  • Work closely with the CEO and leadership team on marketing budgets, revenue forecasts and growth priorities.

2. B2C Marketing Strategy & Revenue Growth

Current channels: Google Ads, Microsoft/Bing Ads, Meta Ads, email & SMS, affiliates and organic SEO.

  • Audit channel performance and set strategy to grow revenue while holding or lowering CAC.
  • Guide paid search and paid social scaling: budgets, bidding strategy, creative testing, new markets.
  • Lead conversion rate optimization across landing pages, checkout and funnels with a clear testing roadmap.
  • Build lifecycle marketing (renewals, recertification reminders, upsells, cross-sell across courses) to lift LTV.
  • Grow organic and AI-search visibility (SEO, content, LLM/answer-engine presence).
  • Test pricing, bundles and promotions with clear guardrails on margin.
  • Identify new channels and partnerships

3. B2B Marketing Strategy & Business Development

  • Define ICPs and buying committees: hospitals and health systems, clinics, staffing agencies, schools and universities, employers with compliance training needs.
  • B2B positioning and value propositions (group pricing, LMS/admin dashboard, compliance tracking, accreditation).
  • Strategize demand generation: LinkedIn, Google search, content, webinars, industry events and associations.
  • Launch account-based marketing (ABM) for high-value accounts.
  • Set up lead scoring, nurture and MQL → SQL handoff with sales; own pipeline contribution targets.
  • Develop channel and strategic partnerships (staffing, healthcare networks, training resellers).

4. Go-to-Market (GTM), Brand & Positioning

  • Develop go-to-market strategies for new products, courses and business offerings.
  • Strengthen brand positioning across all business segments.
  • Identify market trends, customer needs and competitive opportunities.
  • Develop differentiated messaging for B2B and B2C audiences.
  • Work with product, sales and marketing teams to ensure consistent positioning and communication.
  • Identify opportunities to expand into new markets and customer segments.

5. Marketing Leadership & Team Development

  • Provide strategic leadership and direction to existing marketing teams.
  • Guide teams across paid marketing, SEO, email and SMS, affiliate marketing, social media and analytics.
  • Establish clear objectives, priorities, KPIs and accountability across marketing functions.
  • Help build a performance-driven marketing culture focused on measurable business outcomes.
  • Identify skill gaps and recommend improvements in team structure, processes and capabilities.
  • Ensure marketing teams are aligned with overall business objectives.
  • Introduce best practices, experimentation frameworks and scalable marketing processes.

6. Marketing Analytics, Performance & ROI

  • Establish a clear measurement framework to evaluate marketing performance across B2B and B2C.
  • Ensure marketing investments are aligned with revenue and profitability objectives.
  • Review customer acquisition cost (CAC), customer lifetime value (LTV), conversion rates, pipeline contribution and marketing ROI.
  • Use data and customer insights to make informed strategic decisions.

Required Experience & Qualifications

  • 15+ years of experience in marketing, growth strategy, demand generation or senior marketing leadership roles.
  • Previous experience as a CMO, VP of Marketing, Head of Growth or senior marketing leader.
  • Proven experience developing and executing B2B and B2C marketing strategies.
  • Strong understanding of digital marketing, performance marketing and revenue growth.
  • Demonstrated experience in building and scaling demand-generation programs.
  • Strong understanding of go-to-market strategy, product positioning and brand development.

Preferred Experience

  • Experience in healthcare, healthcare education, EdTech, online education, e-learning or professional certification businesses.
  • Experience scaling both direct-to-consumer and enterprise revenue models.
  • Experience in the US market, particularly in B2B demand generation and enterprise customer acquisition.
  • Experience with account-based marketing, strategic partnerships and enterprise sales enablement.
  • Experience in SaaS, subscription or digital learning business models.
  • Experience with AI-driven marketing, automation and emerging customer acquisition channels.

What Success Looks Like

The Fractional CMO will be evaluated on measurable business impact, including:

  1. Development and execution of a clear B2B and B2C marketing growth strategy.
  2. Consistent growth in B2C revenue while improving customer acquisition efficiency and marketing ROI.
  3. Building a scalable B2B demand-generation strategy and increasing qualified leads and sales pipeline.
  4. Identifying new customer segments, revenue opportunities and marketing channels.
  5. Improving conversion rates, customer lifetime value and overall marketing efficiency.
  6. Building stronger brand positioning and market presence.
  7. Establishing clear marketing KPIs, reporting and accountability across teams.

Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate is a strategic marketing leader who combines strong business understanding with deep marketing expertise.

Someone who can think like a CMO, understand revenue and profitability, identify growth opportunities, challenge existing strategies and guide teams toward achieving business goals.

We are looking for someone who can bring fresh perspectives, introduce proven growth strategies, build a strong B2B business while continuing to scale B2C revenue, and act as a strategic marketing partner to the CEO and leadership team.

The ultimate objective is to build a scalable, measurable and revenue-driven marketing organization that supports the company's long-term growth across both B2B and B2C markets.

This is a remote opportunity.

Join Our Campus Community!

Thank you for your interest in joining the University of Wyoming. Our community thrives on the contributions of talented and driven individuals who share in our mission, vision, and values. If your expertise and experience align with the goals of our institution, we would be thrilled to hear from you. We encourage you to apply and become a valued member of our vibrant campus community today!

Why Choose Us?

At the University of Wyoming, we value our employees and invest in their success. Our comprehensive benefits package is designed to support your health, financial security, and work-life balance. Benefits include:

  • Generous Retirement Contributions: The State contributes 15.19% of your gross salary, and you contribute 3.93%, totaling 19.12% toward your retirement plan.
  • Exceptional Health & Prescription Coverage: Enjoy access to medical, dental, and vision insurance with competitive employer contributions, that include 4 deductible options to suit your needs.
  • Paid Time Off: Benefit from ample vacation, sick leave, paid holidays, and paid winter closure.
  • Tuition Waiver: Employees and eligible dependents can take advantage of tuition waivers, supporting continuous education and professional growth.
  • Wellness and Employee Assistance Programs: Stay healthy with wellness initiatives, counseling services, and mental health resources.

At the University of Wyoming, we are committed to creating a supportive and enriching workplace. To learn more about what we offer, please refer to UW’s Benefits Summary.

JOB TITLE: 

Associate Research Scientist

DESCRIPTION:

The Wyoming Coop Unit is seeking an Associate Research Scientist to conduct research on ungulate migrations and support regional efforts to map and characterize migration patterns across Wyoming and the American West. The position will manage and analyze GPS collar data from multiple ungulate species and study areas, identify seasonal migration dates, delineate migration corridors, and develop spatial data products to support state and federal wildlife management and conservation efforts. The position will also manage and improve databases and analytical workflows supporting regional migration assessments, including ongoing efforts across the Greater Yellowstone Area.

In addition to supporting established migration research and mapping initiatives, the Associate Research Scientist will contribute to and lead collaborative research projects that advance understanding of ungulate migration ecology and inform wildlife conservation and management across the West. This position offers an opportunity to work closely with state and federal agency partners, contribute to regional collaborative science, and translate wildlife movement data into actionable information for conservation and management.

This position provides services in collaboration with the USGS Northern Rocky Mountain Science Center (NOROCK) out of Bozeman, MT, so the successful candidate ideally would be available to work and perform essential job functions in Bozeman, MT. The selected candidate may be eligible for remote work outside of Bozeman, MT.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

Research and Creative Activity:

  • Manage, process, and analyze GPS collar data from multiple ungulate species and study areas to support regional efforts to identify and map ungulate migrations across Wyoming and the American West.
  • Identify seasonal migration dates, delineate migration corridors, and develop spatial data products that characterize migration patterns and support wildlife conservation and management.
  • Conduct spatial analyses of wildlife movement data using GIS and other analytical tools, and develop standardized workflows for processing, analyzing, and visualizing migration data.
  • Contribute to regional migration assessments, including efforts to characterize ungulate migrations across the Greater Yellowstone Area.
  • Develop technical reports, maps, and other scientific products, and lead or contribute to peer-reviewed publications and collaborative research projects.
  • Identify opportunities for additional migration-focused research and develop analytical approaches to address emerging research and management questions.

SUPPLEMENTAL FUNCTIONS:

Service:

  • Collaborate with state and federal wildlife management agencies, university researchers, and other partners to support regional ungulate migration research and conservation initiatives.
  • Respond to requests for migration data, maps, and spatial analyses from agency partners and other collaborators.
  • Provide technical assistance and expertise to researchers, graduate students, and collaborators working with wildlife movement data.
  • Participate in partner meetings, workshops, and collaborative research activities related to ungulate migration mapping and conservation.
  • Communicate research findings and spatial data products to management agencies and other partners to support the application of migration science in wildlife management and conservation planning.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Education: Masters level degree
  • 2 years’ experience as a field technician and spatial analyst
  • Proficiency with spatial analyses in Program R
  • Proficiency with modern database management and associated workflows
  • Proficiency with the Migration Mapper application  

DESIRED QUALIFICATIONS:  

  • Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills
  • Excellent skills in professional writing
  • Experience with ArcMap and ArcGIS and basic mapping
  • Experience working with State and Federal land management agencies
  • Experience with database management and spatial analyses in R and SQL
  • Experience conducting research in the Rocky Mountains area (Colorado, Wyoming, New Mexico, Montana, and Idaho)
  • Knowledge of ungulate ecology and migration literature
  • Experience with image processing workflows

REQUIRED APPLICATION MATERIALS: 

Complete the online application. The department additionally requests candidates upload the following document(s) for a complete application:

  1. Cover letter
  2. Resume or C.V.
  3. Contact information for four work-related references (references will only be contacted if you are selected as a finalist for the position).

WORK LOCATION:

Remote/Flexible Work: This position provides services in collaboration with the USGS Northern Rocky Mountain Science Center (NOROCK), so the successful candidate ideally would be available to work and perform essential job functions in Bozeman, MT, understanding the location is around 4,820 feet above sea level. The selected candidate may be eligible for remote work outside of Bozeman, MT depending on their evaluation.

WORK AUTHORIZATION REQUIREMENTS:

The successful candidate must be eligible to work in the United States, as sponsorship for any work authorization or work visas is not available for this position.

HIRING STATEMENT/EEO:  

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran. In compliance with the ADA Amendments Act (ADAAA), if you have a disability and would like to request an accommodation to apply for a position, please contact us at 307-766-2377 or email . 

ABOUT LARAMIE:

The University of Wyoming is located in Laramie, a charming town of 30,000 residents nestled in the heart of the Rocky Mountain West. The state of Wyoming continues to invest in its only 4-year university, helping to make it a leader in academics, research, and outreach with state-of-the-art facilities and strong community ties. We invite you to learn more about Laramie by visiting the About Laramie website.

Located in a high mountain valley near the Colorado border, Laramie offers both outstanding recreational opportunities and close proximity to Colorado’s Front Range and the metropolitan Denver area. Laramie’s beautiful mountain landscape offers outdoor enjoyment in all seasons, with over 300 days of sunshine annually. For more information about the region, please visit

  • We're passionate about the work we do.
  • And we're the kind of good humans who make you look forward to that morning coffee chat, who bring positive energy to every meeting, who go the extra mile to support one another, and who make work feel a little less like work.
Lots of job posts claim the same. We think you'll just notice the difference the first time we chat.

(But don’t just take our word for it. In this video, VP Customer Experience Ian Mitchell and a few members of the Technical Success team provide an overview of the role, what makes a great TAM at Creative Force, and what the culture is like in the team.)

What we offer YOU

  • A fast-growing, exciting, and fun scaleup environment — with multiple international Employer Awards — and not those awards you can pay for, but the kind of awards given based on Employee reviews. It just doesn’t get any better than that. 💜
  • A flat and transparent organizational structure — no bureaucratic red tape. Your ideas and initiatives will be heard and embraced!
  • True work-life balance — we see our team members as people, not numbers, and know that a balanced personal and professional life is critical to happiness and long-term fulfillment
  • A collaborative international environment with colleagues across Europe and USA
  • A growing Technical Success function with opportunities to influence processes, strategy, and customer experience
  • A vibrant work culture grounded in the belief that we’re better together
  • Company trips and events, and much more!

What’s the Role?

We're at a stage of growth where we need to raise the bar in Technical Account Management. That means bringing in someone who has been there, done that, and can help us take the function to the next level.
We're looking for an experienced Technical Account Manager - someone who has owned complex Enterprise implementations from start to finish, managed multi-stakeholder environments, and built the kind of trusted technical relationships that keep customers for years.

At Creative Force, our customers are some of the world's biggest brands and retailers. They operate at scale, move fast, and rely on our platform to power complex creative workflows across teams, regions, and markets. Our implementations are not off-the-shelf. They involve multiple stakeholders, layered integrations, global teams, and timelines of 3 to 6 months. They require someone who is technically sharp, exceptionally organized, and genuinely energized by being in front of the customer.

You'll be the primary technical partner for our Enterprise customers across their entire lifecycle with Creative Force - from pre-sales discovery through implementation and into long-term strategic partnership. You'll partner with Sales and the Customer Experience team to translate complex customer requirements into scalable, working solutions. And you'll stay involved long after go-live, helping customers optimize, grow, and get the most out of what we've built together.
This is not a support-adjacent role. This is a technically grounded, customer-facing, implementation-led position for someone who knows exactly what Enterprise Technical Account Management looks like at its best.

Technical Account Manager Self-Assessment

We know what makes a great Enterprise Technical Account Manager at Creative Force. Here's how to tell if that's you.
You've owned Enterprise implementations end to endYou've taken customers from contract signature to go-live — and you've done it more than once. You know what a 3 to 6 month implementation cycle looks like in practice: the discovery calls, the scope creep, the stakeholder who goes quiet, the integration that doesn't behave as expected. You've navigated it all, and you've delivered.
You don't need a playbook handed to you. You've built one. You're confident in your process, and you can bring that structure and expertise into a team that's ready to level up.
You're technical, but you love being in front of the customerYou're comfortable with APIs, integrations, system architecture, and cloud environments. But the technical knowledge isn't the point — it's the tool. You use it to create clarity, solve problems, and build trust in rooms where not everyone speaks the same language.
When something breaks, your first instinct isn't to disappear into a ticket queue. It's to get on a call, understand what's happening, and help the customer move forward.
You thrive in complexity Multi-stakeholder. Multi-region. Competing priorities. Complex product. Ambiguous requirements. You've worked in environments where nothing is one-size-fits-all, and you've stayed sharp and organized across long, layered project timelines.
When the information is incomplete or the situation is uncertain, you don't stall. You problem-solve, adapt, and keep things moving - without needing someone to tell you what to do next.
You own the room
You're comfortable leading customer conversations at every level - from technical discovery calls to executive business reviews. You set direction, challenge assumptions, and help teams make the right decisions.
You know how to adapt your communication style without losing precision. Whether you're speaking with an IT architect, an operations lead, or a C-suite decision-maker, you build credibility fast and you know that how you show up on these calls has a direct impact on adoption, retention, and everything that follows.

You challenge with grace
Being customer-focused doesn't mean saying yes to everything. Sometimes the most valuable thing you can do for a customer is push back. You know when the approach being suggested isn't the right one — and you know how to say so in a way that builds trust rather than breaking it.
High emotional intelligence is a core part of this job. You pick up on what's not being said. You know when a project is drifting, when a relationship needs attention, when a stakeholder needs to be brought along differently. And you act on it before it becomes a problem.
Who Isn't This Role For?
A few things worth being upfront about.
We're hiring for talent authorized and based in the USA. If that's not you, we'd love to chat when the right role opens up.
Here's where we'll be real honest with you: things at Creative Force change. A lot.
Our industry, our product, the world: rapid change is everywhere. Some people thrive on all the development opportunities, problem solving, innovation, and general rush that change offers. We're certainly those people, and it's one of our biggest competitive advantages and has been a critical ingredient of our success.
But we know that dynamism isn't for everyone. So if you are looking for a work experience that's a little more chill, hey, we don't blame you! But we probably aren't what you are looking for.
If you're still not sure whether Creative Force is for you, have a look at our Career Page, where you can read more about what it's like working here.
How to apply?
As part of your application, we'd love to receive a short video introducing yourself. No script needed, no production value required. Just you, being you.
But hey - you're applying for a customer-facing role. So think of it as your first pitch. Sell us on why this is the right move for both of us.
Authenticity wins over polish every time.
Once you've recorded your video, simply include the link in your application form.
We’re looking forward to hearing from you. 💜

Staff Software Developer (Mobile) - Remote

Intertek, a leading provider of quality and safety solutions to many of the world’s top-recognized brands and companies, is actively seeking a Staff Software Developer (Mobile) to join our People Assurance team as a Remote employee. This is a fantastic opportunity to grow a versatile career in Software Development.

Intertek's People Assurance teams empower your workforce to identify and close operational gaps and mitigate risk by assuring smart actions across your organization. Intertek Alchemy provides frontline worker training solutions for processors, manufacturers, packagers, and distributors of all sizes. Intertek Catalyst inspires and engages workforces with highly creative, custom-branded, asset protection communication programs tailor-made strategic solutions designed to leverage our clients' company brand, values, and objectives to optimize the culture of their people. Intertek Wisetail provides a custom branded training and communication platform built to engage today’s workforce with a complete learning management system, giving customers the tools to grow their passionate workforce. Intertek is continually innovating and evolving to reduce risk for consumers, brands and organizations in every sector and industry around the world.We go beyond Testing, Inspection and Certification of products: we are a Total Quality Assurance Provider to industries worldwide.Our Purpose: Bringing quality, safety, and sustainability to life.

What are we looking for?

As a Staff Software Developer on the Mobile team, you will be the senior technical authority for our mobile platform across iOS and Android. You will own mobile architecture end to end — driving our cross-platform .NET MAUI strategy, setting native implementation standards, and guiding the consolidation of multiple mobile applications onto a single, sustainable codebase. Working across teams, you will set technical direction, raise the engineering bar through design and code review, own the reliability and release health of applications in customers’ hands, and mentor developers at every level. This role has significant influence over our mobile technology choices, roadmap feasibility, and long-term platform direction.

Salary & Benefits Information

Individual compensation packages are based on a variety of factors unique to each candidate including skill set, experience, qualifications, and other job-related reasons.

In addition to competitive compensation packages, when working with Intertek you can expect benefits including medical, dental, vision, life, disability, 401(k) with company match, generous vacation / sick time (PTO), tuition reimbursement and more.

What you’ll do:

  • Own mobile application architecture across iOS and Android, establishing scalable standards, patterns, and best practices.

  • Lead cross-platform development strategy using .NET MAUI, defining shared components, platform boundaries, and native vs. cross-platform decision frameworks.

  • Drive application modernization, consolidation, and migration initiatives, ensuring seamless transitions with minimal customer impact.

  • Design, develop, and maintain secure, high-performing mobile applications using .NET MAUI, C#, Swift/SwiftUI, Kotlin, and Java.

  • Architect offline-first mobile solutions, including local data storage, synchronization, API integrations, and device management capabilities.

  • Establish and oversee mobile engineering standards, including code quality, security, accessibility, performance, testing, and design reviews.

  • Own end-to-end mobile release management, CI/CD pipelines, app store deployments, observability, monitoring, and production support.

  • Troubleshoot complex mobile platform issues, lead incident response efforts, and drive continuous improvement through technical debt reduction and modernization.

  • Mentor developers, conduct code reviews, and collaborate with product, design, architecture, and leadership teams to deliver scalable mobile solutions.

  • Stay current on emerging mobile technologies, industry trends, and competitive landscapes while ensuring compliance, documentation, and agile delivery excellence.

This position outline is a general guideline and does not represent all encompassing details. The position assumes that the incumbent has both the mental and physical requirements to carry out the above defined duties.

Minimum Requirements & Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related field (or equivalent experience) with 8+ years of software development experience and deep expertise in mobile application development.
  • Expert-level proficiency in .NET MAUI/Xamarin, C#, and .NET, with strong native mobile development experience in iOS (Swift/SwiftUI) and/or Android (Kotlin/Java).
  • Proven experience designing mobile architectures (MVVM, dependency injection, modularization), integrating REST APIs, implementing offline synchronization, and ensuring mobile security best practices.
  • Strong background in mobile DevOps, including CI/CD pipelines, release automation, app store deployments, code signing, provisioning, and performance troubleshooting.
  • Demonstrated leadership, mentoring, collaboration, and communication skills, with the ability to lead technical initiatives, solve complex problems, manage competing priorities, and deliver high-quality customer-focused solutions.

Intertek: Total Quality. Assured.

Intertek is a world leader in the Quality Assurance market, with a proven, high-quality business model and a global network of customer-focused operations and highly engaged subject matter experts. With passion, pace, and precision we work to exceed our customers’ expectations, while engaging with our employees to be 10X in their performance and professional growth.

Intertek is a drug-free workplace. As a condition of employment, certain positions may be required to pass a pre-employment drug test based on the type of work that will be performed.

We Value Diversity

Intertek’s network of phenomenal people are our greatest assets, and the diversity they bring fuels our success. raw.title: Information Security Lead
raw.excerpt: We've set the standard in kids entertainment.  Come help us raise it.
raw.description:
We've set the standard in kids entertainment.
Come help us raise it.

We're Lingokids, the #1 entertainment platform for young kids. Most kids content is designed to capture attention. We create experiences little ones genuinely love.

Everything we make is created in-house to be seriously fun, with the good stuff built in from the very beginning. We're KidSAFE certified, completely ad-free, and committed to giving families entertainment they can trust, with no compromise. Ever.

20 million kids come back to us every single month, and we’ve earned more than 50 awards along the way. Now we're going after something bigger: becoming the go-to entertainment destination for kids everywhere, and changing what content looks like for the generation growing up on it.

You in? Keep on reading.

The role

We're hiring a Security Lead to own information security at Lingokids, end to end. Millions of families trust us with their kids' time and data, and keeping that trust is part of the product.

This is a hands-on role. You'll be reporting to the Head of Infrastructure, and you'll look at the whole picture: the people, identities, devices and vendors around our product as much as the cloud it runs on. Because it's one person, you'll automate or outsource first and use AI tooling wherever it helps.

What you’ll do

  • Design and roll out identity and access management for our core tools and for the third-party vendors that hold customer data: SSO, enforced passkeys, least privilege, regular access reviews. Centralize it with IT.

  • Own our InfoSec risk register. Catalogue risks and help leadership decide what to fix and what to accept.

  • Keep an inventory of everything we expose, and keep it patched against known vulnerabilities (CISA and vendor advisories).

  • Secure the infrastructure around the product: AWS accounts, build systems, secrets, and email (DMARC, SPF, DKIM).

  • Put endpoint and package controls in place on engineers' machines.

  • Run penetration testing: the external firm once a year, and continuous automated testing in between, using AI agents or external services where you can.

  • Own our bug bounty program: scope, triage and payouts, focused on real risks like access to personal data.

  • Own the security incident log and postmortems. When an incident happens, you're the analyst and risk owner; the owning teams are the first responders.

  • Manage relationships with security third parties: pen testers, our DPO and security vendors.

  • Make security awareness practical: pick a tool, don't build a program. Controls like passkeys come before courses.

  • Make compliance evidence come out of the work (access reviews, patch logs, the incident log), automated where possible. Legal keeps the legal side.

Your first 90 days

  • SSO and enforced passkeys on our core tools and on the vendors holding customer data, with a first access review completed.

  • A first version of the risk register, reviewed with leadership.

  • An inventory of what we expose, with a patching process running.

  • One incident log, with a postmortem template in use.

  • A plan for endpoint and package management on our employee machines, and for continuous security testing.

What you’ll bring

  • 5+ years in hands-on security engineering in a product company.

  • Strong identity and access management experience across SaaS tools and cloud: SSO, MFA / passkeys, access reviews.

  • Hands-on AWS security experience (IAM, network controls, security services).

  • Experience running vulnerability management and patching over externally exposed assets.

  • Able to script and automate: infrastructure as code (Terraform) and Python, Bash or similar.

  • Experience leading security incidents from an analyst or risk standpoint, and writing postmortems.

  • Judgment to prioritize real risk over theoretical findings, and the communication skills to explain it to execs and get teams on board.

  • English is a must. We're a multicultural team building in English, so while certifications aren't necessary, fluency is.

Nice to have

  • Experience running a bug bounty program.

  • Using AI agents for security testing or automation.

  • Email security (DMARC, SPF, DKIM) and endpoint / MDM controls.

  • Software supply chain security (package controls, dependency pinning, signed builds).

  • Experience with privacy regulation affecting kids products (COPPA, GDPR-K, KidSAFE).

  • Certifications such as AWS Security Specialty, CISSP or OSCP.

Compensation

  • €60,000–€70,000 gross per year, plus equity. Where you land depends on your experience against the requirements of the role. If you bring significantly more experience, we may consider you for a more senior level with its own range.

Passion matters more than perfection

Don't check every box on this list? Don't worry about it. We're looking for people who are driven and believe in what we're building. If that's you, we want to hear from you.

Diversity, equity, and inclusion

At Lingokids, diversity isn't a checkbox, it's at the heart of everything we do. We teach kids to embrace what makes them different, and we hold ourselves to the same standard as a team, knowing the best ideas come from people who see things differently. That means a place where everyone feels valued, heard, and free to be exactly who they are. No matter your background or story, if you're passionate about making a difference for kids everywhere, we want you here.

*This role falls under the XIX Convenio Colectivo Estatal de Empresas de Consultoría, Tecnologías de la Información y Estudios de Mercado y de la Opinión Pública.

Full Time- Remote

Wholesale Commercial Insurance Broker;

National – Digital First Platform – Real Time Rate, Quote & Bind

The Operations Manager will serve as the operational backbone of iBynd, a digitally-enabled wholesale commercial insurance brokerage. This individual will oversee the day-to-day operational functions across both companies, ensuring that workflows, systems, processes, and teams are aligned and running at peak efficiency. The Operations Manager will work cross-functionally with sales, technology, underwriting, finance, and HR to support a seamless experience for agents, brokers, carriers, and internal team members.

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

OPERATIONAL OVERSIGHT & PROCESS MANAGEMENT

  • Manage and optimize the day-to-day operational workflows across both iBynd and Whole Co , including policy processing, submission tracking, document management, and carrier correspondence.
  • Identify operational bottlenecks, implement process improvements, and maintain standard operating procedures (SOPs) across all functional areas.
  • Serve as the internal point of escalation for operational issues, ensuring timely resolution and clear communication across teams.
  • Build and maintain an operational calendar that aligns team activities with company goals, deadlines, and carrier requirements.
  • Manage and respond to customer, partner, and carrier operational support workflows, including escalations related to quoting, binding, payments, technical and platform functionality.
  • Management of one team member who will be day to day for Whole Co support
  • Build and maintain relationships with customers, wholesalers, and carrier partners to support long-term operational success.
  • Identify recurring operational pain points and workflow inefficiencies to improve system, processes, and user experience proactively.
  • Oversee company’s external Email and Notification platform for communicating with Wholesale Agents.

SYSTEMS, TOOLS & TECHNOLOGY

  • Coordinate testing (including technical and live person), QA/UAT validation, and rollout support for new product features, carrier integration and platform enhancements.
  • Partner with the technology team to document system requirements, manage integrations, and support platform enhancements that improve operational efficiency.
  • Ensure data integrity and consistency across all platforms, flagging discrepancies and driving resolution with the appropriate teams.
  • Evaluate and recommend new tools or technologies that support the company's operational and growth objectives.
  • Troubleshoot API, carrier integration, and workflow-related issues across rate/quote/bind operations.

TEAM COORDINATION & CROSS-FUNCTIONAL SUPPORT

  • Coordinate daily operations across sales, underwriting, finance, HR, and technology teams to ensure alignment and accountability.
  • Support onboarding of new employees by managing operational setup including system access, tool provisioning, and process orientation.
  • Facilitate internal communication and documentation of decisions, project status updates, and cross-functional dependencies.
  • Assist leadership with special projects, company initiatives, and post-acquisition integration tasks as needed.

REPORTING, METRICS & COMPLIANCE

  • Build and maintain operational dashboards and reporting cadences that provide visibility into team performance, workflow health, and key business metrics.
  • Track and report on operational KPIs including submission turnaround times, policy issuance accuracy, onboarding completion rates, and system utilization.
  • Ensure the company maintains compliance with applicable carrier guidelines, state regulations, and internal policies across operational functions.
  • Support audits, carrier reviews, and compliance documentation requests as required.

Other duties as assigned.

QUALIFICATIONS

REQUIRED

  • 6+ years of experience in an operations, office management, or business operations role, preferably in a fast-paced or startup environment.
  • Strong organizational and project management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
  • Demonstrated ability to build, document, and improve processes across multiple functional teams.
  • Proficiency with business software including Google Workspace, CRM platforms, and HRIS or AMS systems.
  • Strong communication skills — written, verbal, and across all levels of the organization.
  • Analytical mindset with the ability to interpret operational data and report on key metrics.
  • Proven ability to work independently and take ownership in a remote or distributed team environment.
  • Management experience, particularly in Customer Service or Success

PREFERRED

  • Experience in insurance, insurtech, wholesale brokerage, or a related financial services environment.
  • Familiarity with MGA / MGU operations, commercial lines workflows, or carrier management processes.
  • Prior experience with agency management systems (AMS), rate/quote/bind platforms, or insurance CRM tools.
  • Exposure to post-acquisition or merger integration environments.
  • Experience supporting HR, finance, or compliance functions in an operations capacity.
  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Operations Management, or a related field.
  • Experience showcasing/demoing product updates/features and customer enablement initiatives.

At iBynd, we are committed to upholding the highest standards of employment practices in each jurisdiction we operate in. We ensure that all employees are fairly compensated for their work, in accordance with the provisions outlined by the Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA).

iBynd is an equal opportunity employer, committed to a diverse workforce. iBynd complies with federal and state law governing non-discrimination in employment practices.

Senior Clinical Trial Manager - Solid Biosciences

Remote

Solid Biosciences is a precision genetic medicine company focused on advancing a portfolio of gene therapy candidates targeting rare neuromuscular and cardiac diseases, including Duchenne muscular dystrophy (Duchenne), Friedreich’s ataxia (FA), catecholaminergic polymorphic ventricular tachycardia (CPVT), TNNT2-mediated dilated cardiomyopathy, BAG3-mediated dilated cardiomyopathy, and additional fatal, genetic cardiac diseases. We are advancing a diverse pipeline and delivery platform in the pursuit of uniting experts in science, technology, disease management, and care.

Patient-focused and founded by those directly impacted by Duchenne, Solid’s mission is to improve the daily lives of patients living with devastating rare diseases.

We are looking for a Senior Clinical Trial Manager to join our Clinical Operations organization. The successful candidate will manage clinical trial activities ensuring the timely completion of deliverables through development, management and oversight of the trial CROs, timeline and budget.

Must be comfortable independently managing internal study teams, as well as the outsourced activities and responsibilities delegated to CROs and/or other service providers for assigned clinical trials such as, study start-up, monitoring, site management, TMF, laboratories, drug supply and data management, and contribute to biostatistics, medical writing, safety, regulatory affairs and quality assurance activities, where needed. In addition, the successful candidate will interact closely with investigators and site staff through routine calls and site sponsor visits.

Key Position Responsibilities

  • Responsible for effective global management of a clinical study or multiple studies within a clinical development program.
  • Responsible for management of the study team for assigned studies or programs and of relationships with CROs, central labs, IRB’s, investigating sites and other external partners, as needed, for one or more clinical trials.
  • Coordinates the activities of all trial conduct partners and team members and proactively identifies and manages risks
  • Participate in the development and/or review of all supporting documents for a clinical study, registry or access program. including but not limited to Protocols, Informed Consent Forms, Investigator Brochures, Study Manuals, Statistical Analysis Plans, CRFs, Data Management Plans and Clinical Study Reports.
  • Manage and lead cross-functional clinical trial team meetings collaborating with team members regarding operational activities pertaining to the execution of one or more clinical trial(s)
  • Identifies, or assists in identifying, investigational sites and participates in reviewing and approving qualified sites
  • Create and review Request for Proposals, vendor specifications and participate in vendor selection process
  • Manages the negotiation of contracts, budgets, and timelines with CROs, vendors, clinical sites, and other external partners
  • Review study invoices and manage accruals for assigned studies monthly
  • Participates in the coordination of and training team members and external partners (vendors, sites, etc)
  • Prepare and maintain assigned study and program files, study documentation and other essential documents
  • Provide management with routine updates regarding the status of ongoing studies
  • May participate in internal/external study related audits
  • Ensure compliance to internal processes and GCP
  • Ensure Trial Master File documentation is collected and maintained
  • Attend Investigator Meetings and site visits as needed

Experience Requirements

  • Strong multi-tasking, time management, and organizational skills
  • Ability to take initiative and work both independently and in a team environment
  • Minimum BA/BS Degree
  • Minimum 5 years of clinical trial management experience
  • Must be willing to travel, both domestic and international.
  • Demonstrated knowledge and understanding of FDA/EMA/GCP/ICH regulations and guidelines.
  • Ability to provide appropriate leadership to clinical sites and CROs
  • Detail-oriented individual with good problem-solving capability
  • Able to travel 10-20% of the time

Compensation

The base compensation range for this role is: $150,000.00 - $175,000.00

Base salary offered is determined through an internal analysis utilizing a combination of factors including, but not limited to, relevant skills & experience, job location, and internal equity.

Regular employees are eligible to receive both short-term and long-term incentives, including cash bonus and equity incentive opportunities, designed to reward individual performance and align incentives to Solid’s long term company performance.

Benefits and Solid Advantages

At Solid Biosciences we offer a highly competitive total rewards and benefits package, intended to support all aspects of our employees’ lives and well-being. Additionally, for those employees working onsite at our Hood Park Headquarters, we offer a variety of onsite resources to support those working in our offices.

  • 401(k) program participation with competitive company matched contributions

  • Mobile phone subsidy for eligible employees

  • Vision Coverage
  • Life Insurance

  • Employee Assistance Programs
