Har du gedigen erfarenhet av offentlig upphandling och är van att arbeta självständigt i e-Avrop? Vi söker nu en erfaren upphandlare för ett längre konsultuppdrag hos en offentlig verksamhet. Uppdraget har huvudsakligt fokus på upphandling av varor och tjänster och erbjuder möjlighet att arbeta helt på distans.

Om uppdraget

Som upphandlare kommer du huvudsakligen att arbeta med upphandlingar inom varor och tjänster, men även andra upphandlingsområden kan bli aktuella utifrån verksamhetens behov.

Du förväntas kunna ta ett självständigt ansvar i upphandlingsarbetet och bidra med struktur och kvalitet genom processens olika delar. Arbetet sker i e-Avrop, vilket innebär att betydande tidigare erfarenhet av systemet är ett krav.

Uppdraget är planerat på 100 procent med önskad start 1 januari 2027 och löper till och med 31 december 2027. Under uppdragstiden kan annan sysselsättningsgrad överenskommas mellan parterna.

Det finns möjlighet att arbeta helt på distans.

Dina huvudsakliga ansvarsområden

I rollen kommer du bland annat att:

  • driva och genomföra offentliga upphandlingar med huvudsaklig inriktning mot varor och tjänster

  • självständigt hantera upphandlingsprocessens olika delar

  • arbeta med upphandlingar och tillhörande dokumentation i e-Avrop

  • säkerställa ett strukturerat och kvalitetssäkrat arbetssätt

  • samarbeta med relevanta verksamheter och kontaktytor

  • vid behov arbeta med upphandlingar inom andra områden

Vem är du?

Vi söker dig som har gedigen erfarenhet av offentlig upphandling och känner dig trygg i att självständigt hantera kvalificerade upphandlingsprocesser. Du behöver även ha betydande praktisk erfarenhet av e-Avrop.

För att lyckas i uppdraget tror vi att du är strukturerad och noggrann samt har förmåga att planera och driva ditt arbete självständigt, även när arbetet sker på distans. Rollen innebär också samarbete med olika kontaktytor, vilket ställer krav på en tydlig och professionell kommunikation.

Kvalifikationer

Krav för uppdraget:

  • betydande erfarenhet av offentlig upphandling

  • betydande erfarenhet av e-Avrop

  • relevant utbildning för uppdraget

  • förmåga att självständigt arbeta med upphandlingsprocesser

Om konsultuppdraget

  • Önskad start: 1 januari 2027

  • Uppdragsperiod: till och med 31 december 2027

  • Omfattning: 100 procent, om inte annan omfattning överenskommes

  • Arbetsform: möjlighet till helt distansarbete

Ansökan

Har du gedigen erfarenhet inom offentlig upphandling och e-Avrop och är tillgänglig för ett längre konsultuppdrag? Då ser vi fram emot din ansökan.

Urval och presentation av kandidater sker löpande, så skicka gärna in din ansökan så snart som möjligt.

Who are we and what do we do?

BrowserStack is the world’s leading cloud-based software testing platform, empowering over 50,000 customers—including Amazon, Microsoft, Meta, and Google—to deliver high-quality software at speed. Founded in 2011 by Ritesh Arora and Nakul Aggarwal, the company has grown to support more than two million tests daily across 22 global data centers, providing instant access to 35,000+ real devices and browsers.

With over 1,200 employees and a remote-first approach, BrowserStack operates at the intersection of scale, reliability, and innovation. Its suite of products spans manual and automated testing, visual regression, accessibility, and test management—all designed to simplify the testing process for modern development teams. Behind the scenes, BrowserStack continues to push the boundaries with AI capabilities like smart test case generation and design, flakiness detection, auto-healing and more —helping teams reduce maintenance overhead, debug faster, and catch issues earlier in the development lifecycle.

Recognized for its innovation and growth, BrowserStack has been named to the Forbes Cloud 100 list for four consecutive years. With backing from investors like Accel, Bond, and Insight Partners, the company continues to expand its product offerings and global footprint. Joining BrowserStack means being part of a mission-driven team dedicated to shaping the future of software testing.

Create career paths for your team members by strong mentoring and regular feedback/evaluation process. Set up best practices and identify areas for continuous improvement of the product development life cycle.

  • Experience: 8-12 years of experience in good product based companies and preferably product start-ups.

  • Deep understanding & expertise with highly transactional, large relational and complex web/desktop based systems.
  • Experience hiring and growing a top notch engineering team, and scaling the organization. Start-up experience will be highly preferred
  • Solid understanding of business processes and the application of technology to implement and thereafter streamline them.
  • Strong leadership and communication skills.Hands-on experience in Developing, designing & scaling complex systems both horizontally & vertically.
  • A strong vision and excitement for contributing in growth of an amazing product start-up.

What will you do?

  • Architect innovative solutions for critical, complex and challenging problems by designing and developing highly scalable, available and reliable applications.
  • Setup best practices and identify areas of continuous improvement of the
  • product development life cycle.
  • Develop roadmaps for system and product growth, ensure timely execution and quality delivery.
  • Manage stakeholders like designers, business analysts and product managers by providing them delivery plans and estimates in an Agile environment.

What You’ll Do:

  • Design and implement complex data models to handle our ever-increasing data volume.

  • Develop efficient algorithms to handle data synchronization across distributed systems.

  • Create clear and concise technical requirements and design documents.

  • Participate in system design discussions, proposing innovative solutions while considering scalability and maintainability.

Job Description:

GDIT is seeking a Cyber Solutions Architect Sr Principal to lead the design, integration, validation, and demonstration of innovative cybersecurity solutions supporting federal, defense, and intelligence customers. This role combines technical leadership, solution architecture, customer engagement, and capture support to help shape winning strategies and deliver mission-focused cyber capabilities.

The ideal candidate brings deep cybersecurity expertise, strong customer-facing skills, and experience translating mission requirements into practical, differentiated solutions.


HOW A CYBER SOLUTIONS ARCHITECT SR PRINCIPAL WILL MAKE AN IMPACT

  • Lead the architecture and engineering of cybersecurity solutions focused on Identity, Credential, and Access Management (ICAM), Zero Trust, cyber operations, and operational technology (OT) security.
  • Translate customer requirements, RFIs, and RFPs into technical solutions, implementation approaches, labor estimates, and proposal content.
  • Support strategic captures and business development efforts through technical reviews, customer workshops, demonstrations, and oral presentations.
  • Design, build, and integrate proof-of-concept environments, prototypes, and customer demonstrations using commercial and internally developed technologies.
  • Develop reusable solution architectures, reference designs, and technical accelerators that support future opportunities and delivery programs.
  • Provide technical leadership and guidance to engineering teams, helping mitigate risk and address complex mission challenges.
  • Collaborate across growth, capture, delivery, and partner organizations to develop innovative cybersecurity offerings and customer solutions.
  • Stay current on emerging cyber threats, technologies, federal security requirements, and industry best practices.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED TO SUCCEED

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • 10+ years of relevant experience in cybersecurity engineering, cyber operations, or technical solution architecture.
  • Deep expertise in ICAM, including identity federation, authentication, authorization, privileged access, and identity lifecycle management.
  • Strong knowledge of offensive cyber operations, adversary emulation, penetration testing, and threat-informed defense within authorized environments.
  • Experience securing OT/ICS environments, including industrial protocols, segmentation, asset visibility, and operational resilience.
  • Demonstrated experience with technical proposals, solutioning, customer presentations, and/or federal capture activities.
  • Hands-on ability to integrate security technologies, build prototypes, and demonstrate operational capabilities.
  • Strong technical writing, communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills. Must have an active Secret clearance to be considered and the ability to obtain and maintain a TS/SCI
  • Active Secret security clearance.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain a TS/SCI clearance.
  • U.S. Citizenship required.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting U.S. federal, defense, or intelligence missions; security clearance as required by the assigned program.
  • Knowledge of NIST SP 800-207, SP 800-82, SP 800-53, and DoD Zero Trust guidance.
  • Experience with ICAM/PAM platforms, OT security tools, cloud security, DevSecOps, and automation.
  • CISSP, GIAC, OSCP, CCSP, or comparable credentials; bachelor’s degree in a relevant discipline or equivalent practical experience.
  • Experience with internal R&D, partner integrations, and productizing repeatable cyber offerings.

GDIT IS YOUR PLACE

At GDIT, the mission is our purpose, and our people are at the center of everything we do.

  • Growth: AI-powered career tools that identify career opportunities and learning pathways.
  • Support: An internal mobility team dedicated to helping you achieve your professional goals.
  • Rewards: Comprehensive health and wellness benefits, competitive compensation, and 401(k) with company match.
  • Flexibility: A flexible work environment designed to help you balance work and life priorities.
  • Community: An award-winning culture that values innovation, collaboration, and service.

OWN YOUR OPPORTUNITY

At GDIT, you'll work alongside talented professionals solving our customers' most complex challenges. Join us and help deliver the next generation of cybersecurity solutions that protect critical missions and advance national security.

The likely salary range for this position is $170,000 - $230,000. This is not, however, a guarantee of compensation or salary. Rather, salary will be set based on experience, geographic location and possibly contractual requirements and could fall outside of this range.

40

Remote

Any Location / Remote

Additional Work Locations:

Total Rewards at GDIT:

Our benefits package for all US-based employees includes a variety of medical plan options, some with Health Savings Accounts, dental plan options, a vision plan, and a 401(k) plan offering the ability to contribute both pre and post-tax dollars up to the IRS annual limits and receive a company match. To encourage work/life balance, GDIT offers employees full flex work weeks where possible and a variety of paid time off plans, including vacation, sick and personal time, holidays, paid parental, military, bereavement and jury duty leave. GDIT typically provides new employees with 15 days of paid leave per calendar year to be used for vacations, personal business, and illness and an additional 10 paid holidays per year. Paid leave and paid holidays are prorated based on the employee’s date of hire. The GDIT Paid Family Leave program provides a total of up to 160 hours of paid leave in a rolling 12 month period for eligible employees. To ensure our employees are able to protect their income, other offerings such as short and long-term disability benefits, life, accidental death and dismemberment, personal accident, critical illness and business travel and accident insurance are provided or available. We regularly review our Total Rewards package to ensure our offerings are competitive and reflect what our employees have told us they value most.

Our Identity Verification Process:

As part of the hiring process, we will ask you to complete an identity verification process that leverages advanced biometrics and artificial intelligence to ensure authenticity and protect against identity fraud. You are expected to be on camera during virtual interviews. We reserve the right to take your picture to verify your identity and prevent fraud. By proceeding, you authorize the collection, processing, and use of your biometric data for identity verification and security purposes.

About Our Work:

We are GDIT. A global technology and professional services company that delivers technology solutions and mission services to every major agency across the U.S. government, defense and intelligence community. Our 26,000 experts extract the power of technology to create immediate value and deliver solutions at the edge of innovation. raw.description:
Als IT-Dienstleister treiben wir die Digitalisierung des öffentlichen Sektors voran und schaffen echten Mehrwert für Millionen Menschen in Deutschland. Wir können vieles richtig gut, aber eben noch nicht alles. Darum suchen wir immer wieder neue Kolleg:innen, die mit ihren Ideen, ihrem Können und Engagement etwas bewegen wollen. Fühlst du dich angesprochen? Dann gestalte Deine Welt zum Besseren und werde Teil unserer Cluster Unit Business Consulting.

DEINE MISSION

Als Business Analyst/Anforderungsmanager(m/w/d) sorgst du dafür, dass fachliche Anforderungen in der öffentlichen Verwaltung nicht nur gesammelt, sondern sauber strukturiert, abgestimmt und entscheidungsreif werden. Du bringst die richtigen Stakeholder an einen Tisch, moderierst zielgerichtet durch komplexe Themen und übersetzt Bedarf in klare, belastbare Anforderungsdokumente

Deine Aufgaben

  • Durchführung von regelmäßigen Anforderungsworkshops bei unterschiedlichen Stakeholdern zur Erarbeitung und Aufnahme fachlicher Anforderungen an IT-Projekte und IT-Verfahren, inklusive Vor- und Nachbereitung, Agenda und Ergebnissicherung

  • Aktive Unterstützung im Stakeholder-Management: Erwartungsmanagement, Abstimmungen, Klärungen und Nachhalten von Entscheidungen und nächsten Schritten

  • Verfassen schriftlicher Anforderungsdokumente (z. B. fachliche Spezifikationen, Anforderungskataloge) in klarer, nachvollziehbarer Form

  • Erarbeitung bzw. Mitwirkung an Entscheidungsvorlagen zu fachlichen Anforderungen (Optionen, Auswirkungen, Empfehlungen)

  • Moderation weiterer Meetingformate (z. B. Jahresmeetings, Leitungsmeetings) – strukturiert, verbindlich und ergebnisorientiert

  • Koordination der fachlichen Abnahme

  • Ansprechpartner:in für Rückfragen rund um fachliche Anforderungen

DAS IST UNS WICHTIG

  • Mehrjährige praktische Erfahrung (ab 2–3 Jahren) im Anforderungsmanagement, idealerweise in IT-Projekten

  • Relevante Erfahrung im Kontext öffentliche Verwaltung / Public Sector

  • Sehr starke Moderationsskills: du führst Gruppen durch komplexe Diskussionen und bringst Ergebnisse auf den Punkt

  • Projektmanagement- und Stakeholder-Management-Erfahrung: du übernimmst Verantwortung, priorisierst, koordinierst und hältst Themen in Bewegung

  • Erfahrung im Umgang mit Jira und Confluence

  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (mindestens C1-Niveau) sowie Englischkenntnisse auf Konversationsniveau

NICE TO HAVES

  • Kenntnisse im Umgang mit Auswertungssystemen und BI-Systemen (z. B. Reporting-/Analyse-Tools, fachliche Auswertungen, datenbasierte Ableitungen)

  • Design-Thinking-Ansatz

  • Kenntnisse in der Prozessmodellierung (z. B. BPMN, ARIS)

  • IREB-Zertifikat (z. B. CPRE) oder vergleichbar

  • PM-Zertifikat (z. B. PRINCE2, Scrum)

DEIN NEUER ARBEITSPLATZ

  • Was bei uns zählt? Klar definierte Rollen, echtes Miteinander und ein gemeinsames Ziel. Wir nennen das Responsiveness – transparent, wertschätzend und zielorientiert.

  • Hier bist du am Wandel direkt beteiligt, wenn du möchtest. – Nimm Teil an Projekten, die uns als Unternehmen weiterentwickeln.

  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten und Remote Work? – Sind selbstverständlich.

  • Individuelles Hardware-Budget? – Stell dir deinen Arbeitsplatz so zusammen, wie du dich am wohlsten fühlst.

  • Individuelles Weiterbildungsbudget? – Egal ob die nächste Zertifizierung oder ein lang ersehnter Sprachkurs – du entscheidest, worin und wann du dich weiterbildest.

  • JobRad oder Firmenwagen? – Wir helfen dir dabei, so mobil zu sein, wie du es brauchst.

raw.description:
About us

At Viasat, the work you do helps people stay connected in ways that matter, from everyday moments to critical missions across air, land, sea, and space.

We’re a place for people who are curious, bold, and motivated by meaningful work. Here, you'll have the opportunity to make an impact, explore new possibilities, and grow your career in ways that align with your interests and goals. When you're ready to take on something new, you'll find leaders who support your development and help you turn your ambition into action.


What you'll do

In this role, you will provide robust and efficient financial analysis and support to ANTS Management. This person will partner with the ANTS finance team to deliver a high quality, responsive and commercially focused financial management function, leveraging shared services across the wider Finance organisation. You will deliver high quality, timely and insightful reporting, analysis and business partnering. You will support the ANTs businesses in decision making through strategic and tactical business insights, including the development of business cases and financial analysis.This person will also ensure the financial operations of the business are aligned with the wider group, leveraging synergies and enabling seamless collaboration.


The day-to-day

Monthly Reporting and Forecasting:

  • Take ownership in delivering across the four key pillars of Planning, Reporting, Controlling and Analysis. Work closely with central Finance and ANTS business to ensure the upstream and downstream processes work appropriately such that the financial data and reporting required to deliver these four areas can be easily obtained and relied upon.
  • Support the ANTS finance team to ensure that the financial and operational results of the business are provided to the management team on an accurate and timely basis together with concise, action-oriented and business-focused commentary.
  • Support the ANTS finance team to prepare a, high-quality full year forecast that reflects all relevant material issues, opportunities and business plans.
  • Support the development and implementation of BI requirements related to ANTS operations, working closely with the Insights, Analytics & Reporting team (IAR) and other Group finance functions.

Operational and Business Planning (Budget & 5 year plan): Support the ANTS finance team to prepare a high quality full year budget and 5 year plan that reflects all relevant material issues, opportunities and business plans relevant to the wider ANTs business. Ensure the Plan is consistent with the strategic goals and delivers the results required by the business and Group.

Adhoc financial analysis: Support the ANTS finance team to provide ad hoc financial and operational analysis and advice to support ANTS leadership and their direct reports in making high-quality strategic and operational decisions.

Business partnering: Act as a business partner with business stakeholders to proactively deliver high-quality, commercially-focused financial advice in support of ANTS’ goals and performance.


What you'll need

  • Education: Bachelor's degree or higher in accounting or finance with professional accounting qualification or equivalent.
  • Experience: 8-10+ years progressive experience in accounting, financial modelling and analysis within quality companies.
  • Superior analytical skills coupled with good strategic business understanding leading to key business insight.
  • Creative problem solver and decision maker.
  • Ability to draw high quality analysis out of the results that drive decisions in the business.
  • Strong people skills, confident and comfortable at engaging collaboratively in an intellectual and multinational environment at all levels. Strong verbal and written communications skills.
  • Technically strong, and influential with the ability to operate at both strategic and operational levels.
  • Strong work ethic and ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment with a passion for excellence and innovation.
  • Proactive individual with the ability to effectively manage various projects while adhering to deadlines.
  • Strong understanding of best practice financial accounting standards, policies, processes and ability to apply these to commercial transactions
  • Ability to work across cultures and time zones.

What will help you on the job

  • Relevant industry experience including a working knowledge of Satcom, Telco or IoT market dynamics is good but not essential.
  • Experience of SAP, Tableau and Hyperion systems an advantage.

EEO Statement

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, marital status, genetics, age, or veteran status or any other applicable legally protected status or characteristic. About Hypergen

Hypergen is a lead generation partner for M&A firms, SaaS companies, and agencies. We build and manage high-performance outbound infrastructure, using data-driven tools like Clay and intent signals to identify and engage high-fit prospects.

We are looking for a disciplined SDR to join our team. This role is dual-focused: you will drive internal growth for Hypergen and execute lead generation and meeting booking for our clients as an outsourced partner.

The Role: You will act as a hybrid growth engine - fueling Hypergen’s own pipeline while also serving as an outsourced SDR for our clients (SaaS, M&A, and agencies) to help them scale their revenue.

✨What You’ll Do

  • Take full ownership of warm leads generated by our outbound systems. You will execute targeted follow-ups via personalized emails and phone calls to convert interest into booked meetings.

  • Nurturing & Follow-up: Build and manage high-touch sequences. You are responsible for keeping leads warm and persistent follow-up until a discovery call is booked.

  • Research & Personalization: Use Clay, Apollo, and AI tools to research prospects and personalize messaging at scale based on intent signals (funding, hiring, tech stack).

  • CRM & Pipeline Hygiene: Maintain meticulous records within our CRM (and our clients' systems). You will ensure every interaction is logged, lead statuses are accurate, and no opportunity falls through the cracks.

  • U.S. Market Alignment: Work a schedule that ensures significant overlap with U.S. EST business hours.

Requirements

🧠 What we’re looking for

  • 1+ Year of Experience: Previous experience in an SDR or BDR role, specifically focused on B2B sales or agency environments.

  • Outreach Specialist: Expert at managing follow-up cadences and handling objections over the phone.

  • Native-Level English: Flawless written and verbal communication is required for high-stakes professional conversations.

  • Process-Driven: Highly organized and able to manage follow-ups for multiple client accounts simultaneously.

  • Technical Aptitude: Experience with (or eager to learn) modern sales tools like Clay, Apollo, and HubSpot.
    Apply here, or send an email to with your CV along with short Loom video: introducing yourself, talking about your SDR experience, and outlining the first three specific moves you take when following up with a warm lead to ensure they book a meeting.

raw.excerpt: About Dr.  Berg Nutritionals Dr.  Berg Nutritionals is a leader in the health and wellness industry focused on addressing the root causes of health concerns.
raw.description:
About Dr. Berg Nutritionals
Dr. Berg Nutritionals is a leader in the health and wellness industry focused on addressing the root causes of health concerns. We offer a dynamic work environment with opportunities for growth, where you can contribute to helping millions achieve better health through education, premium supplements, and holistic practices like the Healthy Keto® diet.

Working with us, you’ll be part of a globally recognized brand with a social media presence reaching over 49 million followers across platforms.

Be a part of an innovative and fast-growing company that is passionate about transforming lives through education on health and wellness. If you thrive in a dynamic environment where your contributions make a real impact, this is the place for you.

Why This Role Matters
If you want to be the person who owns the truth in the data, sets the standard for how we test, and gives leadership the evidence they need to make big calls, this is the role for you.

We’re a nine-figure DTC brand with data spread across Shopify, Amazon, subscriptions, email, and content, and teams already running tests across the customer journey. What we don’t have yet is one person who owns how we measure, test, and learn. That’s you.

You’ll lead analytics and experimentation for our Customer Journey & Revenue division: the metrics, the definitions, the testing program, the analysis, and the insights. When someone asks “is this working, and how do we know?”, you’re the one with the answer. Working alongside the Director of Customer Journey & Revenue, you’ll make sure every major decision is backed by numbers everyone trusts.

This is a high-visibility, high-autonomy role with the freedom to build the functions the way they should be built.

What Success Looks Like

  • Leadership trusts one set of numbers, and you’re the one who defined them
  • Every test across the customer journey runs through a process you built, prioritized by impact
  • Leaders make faster, more confident decisions because your insights are clear and reliable
  • The impact of every major initiative is measured honestly, so we know what to scale and what to stop

What You’ll Own

The Numbers

  • Own our core customer and revenue metrics and definitions (conversion, retention, LTV, revenue, and more) and the metrics catalog teams rely on
  • Be the final check on data accuracy before it reaches decision-makers
  • Translate business questions from leaders into clear requirements, queries, and data models
  • Partner with our data engineering team to make sure the data platform captures what the business needs
  • Build and evolve reporting and dashboards, starting with our customer journey dashboard


The Testing Program

  • Own the cross-departmental experimentation roadmap, prioritized by revenue potential, traffic, and funnel drop-off
  • Set the standards for how every test is proposed, designed, run, and judged, including a shared intake process and KPI framework
  • Instrument the customer journey with the KPIs and data points needed to measure every stage
  • Lead all results analysis (statistical significance, incremental revenue, win rate)
  • Strengthen incoming test briefs by sharpening hypotheses and success metrics, and resolve conflicts when teams want to test the same page or audience
  • Run the regular test review cadence and keep a shared library of learnings across teams


The Insights

  • Be the trusted source of evidence behind major decisions: what’s happening, why, and what the data suggests
  • Turn analysis into clear, confident recommendations for the Director of Customer Journey & Revenue and executive leadership
  • Represent analytics and testing in cross-functional planning (dev sprints, content calendar, lifecycle) so data shapes decisions from the start
  • Roll up your sleeves when needed, whether that’s writing a query, configuring a test, or building a report yourself


Your First 90 Days

  • Partner with the Director of Customer Journey & Revenue to instrument the full journey with KPIs and data points
  • Stand up a Phase 1 metrics catalog and get it adopted
  • Deliver your point of view on where the journey is performing and where we’re leaving money on the table
  • Launch the test prioritization process and run the first tests through it

What You Bring
Required

  • 7+ years in analytics, BI, experimentation, CRO, or growth analytics, including leading a program or function across multiple teams
  • Experience at a high-volume DTC e-commerce brand
  • Experience with subscription or replenishment business models
  • Strong SQL and hands-on experience with Power BI
  • Deep comfort with statistics, funnel analysis, attribution, and measuring revenue impact across multiple data sources
  • Proven ownership of a testing program end to end: roadmap, prioritization model, KPI framework, and process
  • A track record of strong partnerships across departments (content, lifecycle/CRM, development, design) without directly managing those teams
  • Experience creating documentation, processes, and shared resources that teams actually use
  • The ability to turn analysis into clear, concise recommendations for leadership, in writing and in person

Preferred

  • Experience at a DTC e-commerce brand doing $100M+ in annual revenue
  • Health, wellness, or supplement industry experience
  • Experience with CRO/testing and analytics tools (A/B testing platforms, web analytics, session recording and heatmap tools)
  • Familiarity with WordPress, Shopify, Amazon, Klaviyo, Recharge, and/or FullStory
  • Experience partnering with data engineering on a data warehouse or data lake
  • Experience building or scaling an analytics or experimentation team

Work From Home Requirements

  • Up-to-date Mac or Windows computer with anti-virus protection
  • Reliable high-speed internet connection
  • Quiet, distraction-free workspace
  • Tech-savvy and comfortable learning new tools and software
  • Experienced using Microsoft Office tools (Excel, Outlook, Teams, Word, OneDrive)

Compensation & Benefits
We are intentional about creating a work environment that supports both high-quality work and the people doing it. We aim to provide our team with the structure, resources, and flexibility needed to do meaningful work while maintaining personal well-being.

We recognize that employees have responsibilities and priorities outside of work, and we respect and support that with our policies and benefits.

We are a fully remote team, allowing team members to work from where they are most comfortable and to avoid unnecessary commuting and overhead.

We offer competitive compensation and a benefits package designed to support health, stability, and balance, including:

  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance with 80% of premiums covered by the company
  • 80 hours of paid vacation after one year of employment, with additional PTO that grows as you grow with us (tenure-based increases)
  • 40 hours of personal days each year for rest, life, and everything in between
  • Paid gym membership to support your health and well-being
  • 7 paid holidays
  • 50% discount on all Dr. Berg products
  • Fully remote work with a strong emphasis on healthy work-life balance

Pay Range: $125,000 to $150,000 base, depending on experience. This is a senior, high-impact role, and we’re open to negotiating above this range for candidates whose experience and skill set go beyond what’s listed here.

Hoursof Operation: Monday to Friday 9 a.m. - 6 p.m. ET
Location: Fully remote within the US
Type: Full-time employment

Dr. Berg Nutritionals is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to any characteristics protected by applicable federal, state, or local law. We are committed to fostering an inclusive, respectful, and supportive workplace.

Note: We are not currently hiring international or California-based employees. Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States for any employer (W-2) positions.

Salary: $125,000 – $150,000 / year

raw.title: Software Architect
raw.excerpt: At DraftKings, AI is becoming an integral part of both our present and future, powering how work gets done today, guiding smarter decisions, and sparking bold ideas.
raw.description:
At DraftKings, AI is becoming an integral part of both our present and future, powering how work gets done today, guiding smarter decisions, and sparking bold ideas. It’s transforming how we enhance customer experiences, streamline operations, and unlock new possibilities. Our teams are energized by innovation and readily embrace emerging technology. We’re not waiting for the future to arrive. We’re shaping it, one bold step at a time. To those who see AI as a driver of progress, come build the future together.

The Crown Is Yours

As a Software Architect, you'll help design and scale the systems that power world-class digital experiences. You'll play a critical role in shaping architectural decisions while staying close to the code, ensuring our platforms are resilient, performant, and built to evolve. Working across Engineering, Product, Infrastructure, and Platform teams, you'll influence how we approach distributed systems at scale and elevate technical standards across the organization. Your work will strengthen our foundation today while enabling us to move faster and smarter tomorrow.


DKExchange is DraftKings' regulated prediction markets exchange. In this role you'll take technical ownership of the domain - market data, order entry and matching, request-for-quote trading, clearing and settlement. You'll shape how the platform scales into peak sporting events, how quickly we can add new markets and partners, and how a fast, externally-facing trading system stays correct and available under heavy load.


You'll also work with AI as a core part of how you deliver. We expect our architects to build and own the AI tooling for their domain - agents and automated workflows that handle the repetitive analysis, monitoring and drafting work - so your own time goes to the judgment calls. You'll be hands-on with it, you'll help your teams get good at it, and you'll stay accountable for the quality of what comes out.


What you'll do as a Software Architect


  • Define and evolve architectural solutions that improve system performance, scalability, reliability, and day-to-day operations.
  • Own the technical roadmap for the exchange, and produce the architecture and design for every major initiative in the domain.
  • Maintain the shared foundations - the core patterns, system boundaries, and data contracts that every team builds on, documented clearly enough that both people and AI tools can work from them.
  • Drive consistency in the technologies and patterns used across the exchange's services.
  • Partner closely with Product, Infrastructure, Platform and partner engineering teams - including brokers, market makers and our clearing partners - to build good architectural thinking into planning, design, and delivery.
  • Contribute hands-on to critical work: prototypes, proofs of concept, and production systems that show what scalable, maintainable design looks like.
  • Set and publish the performance and reliability targets for the domain, and lead the load and resilience testing that proves we can meet them before peak events.
  • Guide teams in using proven distributed system patterns, so fault tolerance, observability and operational readiness are built in from day one.
  • Own the operational health of the exchange, using automation and AI tooling to catch problems early and shift from reacting to incidents toward preventing them.
  • Bring architectural expertise to incidents, help drive resolution, and turn what you learn into fixes that stop the same class of failure recurring.
  • Keep an eye on cost, and find and pursue efficiency opportunities as the platform grows.
  • Give thoughtful design reviews and technical guidance that raise the bar across the team, using automated checks for the mechanical issues so review conversations focus on trade-offs.
  • Mentor engineers - on architecture, and on how to work effectively with AI tools in their own day-to-day.
  • Look for where AI can genuinely create leverage in the domain, treat it as a real option alongside traditional approaches, and measure adoption by results: faster delivery, fewer defects, lower cost, new capability.
  • Set sensible guardrails for AI-assisted work - quality checks, boundary validation, and standards that keep things coherent without slowing teams down.
  • Work with engineering leaders to keep architectural decisions aligned with business priorities and long-term platform strategy.

What you'll bring


  • Professional software engineering experience, including significant experience designing and evolving large-scale distributed systems in production.
  • Experience with fast, high-volume transactional or event-driven systems where getting the order and the outcome exactly right matters as much as speed. Background in exchanges, trading, payments or other financial systems is a strong advantage.
  • Extensive knowledge of messaging and streaming systems; hands-on expertise with Kafka is a strong advantage.
  • A solid grasp of how to manage state across a distributed system - how to split and shard data, when to keep it in memory versus a durable store, and the consistency trade-offs involved.
  • Proven understanding of microservices architecture, including containerization and orchestration. Our services are mostly Go and .NET/C#, so comfort working across more than one language stack matters.
  • Familiarity with the protocols and contract-first design this domain runs on - FIX, gRPC and Protobuf - and experience integrating with third-party systems you don't control directly.
  • Working knowledge of relational and NoSQL databases, tradeoffs and advantages based on the use case.
  • Proficiency with modern development practices, including continuous integration and delivery, infrastructure as code, and observability tooling; comfort running load tests and building capacity projections.
  • Real, practical experience using AI tools on production work - coding assistants, agents, automated review and analysis - not just experimentation.
  • A practical view of the economics - able to weigh an AI-based approach against building or buying as part of normal technical decision-making.
  • Exposure to building software in a regulated environment: auditability, data sensitivity, and designing for compliance.
  • Clear, structured communication, with the ability to document decisions and influence both technical and non-technical audiences, including internal and external engineering teams, and other stakeholders.
  • A genuine interest in mentoring engineers, giving useful design feedback, and continuously raising engineering standards.

Join Our Team

We’re a publicly traded (NASDAQ: DKNG) technology company headquartered in Boston. As a regulated gaming company, you may be required to obtain a gaming license issued by the appropriate state agency as a condition of employment. Don’t worry, we’ll guide you through the process if this is relevant to your role.

The US base salary range for this full-time position is 185,400.00 USD - 231,800.00 USD, plus bonus, equity, and benefits as applicable. Our ranges are determined by role, level, and location. The compensation information displayed on each job posting reflects the range for new hire pay rates for the position across all US locations. Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Your recruiter can share more about the specific pay range and how that was determined during the hiring process. raw.description:
About Us

At Medius, we believe managing finance should be about strategy, not stress. That same mindset shapes not only the solutions we build, but also the culture we create for our people. We remove complexity, embrace innovation, and give our teams the freedom to focus on what truly matters — whether that’s transforming the future of finance with AI or finding balance to go home on time.

Founded in Sweden in 2001, Medius has grown from a local startup into a global leader in cloud-based spend management solutions. Today, thousands of organizations worldwide trust us to simplify accounts payable and spend management processes. Our journey has been driven by continuous innovation, a passion for technology, and above all — the people who make it happen.

We’re more than a software company. We’re a team of problem-solvers, innovators and collaborators working together to reinvent the category of accounts payable. Our solutions use Artificial Intelligence to eliminate manual work, bring clarity, confidence, and control, and empower finance teams of the future.

At Medius,our values guide how we work and grow together:

  • Connect – We believe in the power of people—individually and collectively—and our success depends on understanding and respecting each other. We appreciate that ‘empowering finance teams of the future’ is an exciting endeavor, and we share it with everyone around us.

  • Question – We enjoy the challenge of our work and the thrill of collaboration. We are not afraid to question ourselves and each other because we believe diverse perspectives can lead to better outcomes and that there is great power in resolution.

  • Own – We are thorough, thoughtful, and decisive. We anticipate what’s next, what a customer might need, and then we deliver. That’s how we get things done. And that’s how we remain a leader. Customers trust us to do our job so that they can focus on what they do best.

At Medius, you’ll join a diverse, global community where curiosity is celebrated, ideas matter, and innovation never stops. If you’re passionate about technology, eager to make an impact, and ready to grow alongside a team that lives its values, Medius is where you can do your best work — your impact is global.

Learn more at

Job Overview

Medius is building an AI-native Product Marketing team, and this is a core Senior Product Marketing role within it. Reporting to the VP, Product Marketing, you will own positioning, messaging, and go-to-market strategy for our flagship Accounts Payable Automation solution — bringing together AP Automation, e-Invoicing, and Tax Engine integrations into a unified, market-leading offering.

Based in the United States, you will drive GTM strategy across our largest product area, turning sophisticated invoice capture, automated workflow processing, global e-invoicing compliance, and seamless tax engine integrations into clear, outcome-led narratives that win with CFOs, Controllers, and finance leaders.

AI is central to how we work. You will use it to scale your output and sharpen your thinking, not to replace the judgement that makes great product marketing. We want someone who already operates this way or is hungry to.

Product Marketing at Medius

  • We define how Medius wins in the market.

  • We turn product into narrative that lands with finance teams.

  • We partner across Product, Sales, and Marketing on positioning, launches, and the go-to-market bill of materials.

  • We measure success by outcomes: win rates, deal velocity, and adoption.

  • We are AI-native. Claude is our enterprise standard and core to how we operate.

  • We position Medius as a system that manages outcomes, not workflows.

How We Work with AI

  • AI is not a side experiment here. Claude is our enterprise standard, every employee has an enterprise licence, and we are actively transforming every part of the business to be AI-native. You will join a company that is genuinely rewiring how it works — not one bolting AI on at the edges.

  • Claude is your daily tool, alongside Microsoft Copilot across the M365 stack.

  • You can structure prompts, iterate quickly, and refine outputs to a high standard.

  • You use AI to accelerate thinking and research, not just to produce content.

  • You help build AI-native ways of working that lift the whole team.

Responsibilities and Duties

  • Own positioning, messaging, and end-to-end GTM strategy for the Accounts Payable Automation solution.

  • Lead the positioning strategy that unifies AP Automation, e-Invoicing compliance, and Tax Engine integrations into a cohesive, value-driven narrative for finance teams.

  • Translate complex automated invoice processing, AI-driven data extraction, tax determination, and global e-invoicing regulatory requirements into high-impact customer value propositions.

  • Build and continually refresh the sales-facing bill of materials, including primary pitch decks, competitive battlecards, solution briefs, cheat sheets, and ROI calculators.

  • Partner closely with Product Management and Engineering to influence product roadmap based on market dynamics, tax/compliance shifts, and buyer feedback.

  • Execute competitive intelligence research across the AP Automation, e-Invoicing, and enterprise tax compliance landscape using AI tools to accelerate analysis.

  • Establish reusable prompts, workflows, and content generation frameworks that scale team-wide productivity.

About You:

  • 5+ years in B2B SaaS product marketing, with experience owning positioning and messaging for complex enterprise finance or AP software offerings.

  • Strong domain background in Accounts Payable Automation, e-Invoicing, Tax Engine integrations (e.g., Avalara, Vertex, Sovos), or enterprise ERP workflows.

  • Demonstrated success in synthesizing multiple solution capabilities (AP, e-invoicing, tax) into a clean, integrated value proposition.

  • Exceptional written English and ability to translate technical and regulatory software capabilities into executive-ready narrative.

  • Proven ability to partner with high-velocity Enterprise Sales teams to drive win rates, deal velocity, and product adoption.

  • High curiosity, speed, AI-native operating standard, and an ownership mindset.

What Success Looks Like in this Role

  • At 6 months: you have established a unified positioning strategy across AP Automation, e-Invoicing, and Tax Engine capabilities, rolling out an updated sales bill of materials that elevates field execution.

  • At 12 months: you have driven measurable improvements in enterprise win rates and cross-sell adoption across the AP Automation portfolio, while establishing scalable AI workflows across the GTM team.

Job Title:

Manager, Outpatient Coding Quality and Compliance

Department:

Health System Shared Services | MIM CDI and Coding

Scope of Position

The Manager of Outpatient Coding Quality and Compliance is responsible for directing the outpatient coding quality, auditing, education, and staff-development program for facility-based outpatient services. This position provides direct oversight and strategic direction for outpatient coding quality analysts, coding leads, the outpatient coding educator, and assigned students. The manager ensures that coding quality activities support accurate and complete coded data, compliant billing, reimbursement integrity, denial prevention, audit readiness, documentation integrity, and continuous improvement across the outpatient revenue cycle.

The manager establishes a coordinated quality program across hospital enterprise emergency department, observation, ambulatory surgery, clinics, diagnostic services, therapeutic services, infusion, oncology, radiology, and other outpatient service lines, as applicable. This position serves as a liaison among Outpatient Coding, Revenue Cycle, Patient Financial Services, Compliance, Revenue Integrity, Clinical Documentation Integrity, Information Technology, Quality, Finance, clinical departments, providers, external auditors, coding vendors, and academic partners.

Position Summary

This role serves as the manager for outpatient coding quality. The manager is accountable for the design, execution, monitoring, and evaluation of the outpatient coding quality program. The manager establishes audit priorities, assigns and monitors quality work, validates audit methodology, ensures consistent interpretation of coding and billing requirements, and converts audit, denial, edit, and quality data into education and process improvement. The position oversees outpatient coding quality policies, audit procedures, education plans, reporting tools, corrective-action processes, and technology-related quality controls. The manager develops quality analysts, coding leads, the outpatient coding educator, and students through structured onboarding, competency assessment, coaching, mentoring, cross-training, and career-path development.


MINIMUM REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

Bachelor's Degree in Health Information Management, Business Administration or a Healthcare field. Credentialed as a Registered Health Information Technician, Registered Health Information Administrator, Certified Coding Specialist by the American Health Information Management Association, or Certified Outpatient Coder by AAPC, or Certified Professional Coder by the American Association of Professional Coders. 5 years of relevant experience of progressive experience in hospital-based outpatient facility coding, coding quality, auditing, coding education, coding compliance, or a closely related function, including experience reviewing complex outpatient records required.


Minimum two years of formal supervisory, project leadership, lead-level, audit-program, education-program, or quality-program responsibility.

Current coding or health information credentials from AHIMA or AAPC, such as RHIA, RHIT, CCS, CCS-P, COC, CPC, or an equivalent credential approved by the organization.


Advanced knowledge of ICD-10-CM, CPT, HCPCS Level II, modifiers, APC methodology, Official Coding Guidelines, CPT guidance, Coding Clinic, NCCI, OCE, MUEs, CMS requirements, payer policies, and outpatient reimbursement concepts.

Demonstrated ability to plan and conduct coding audits, document defensible findings, identify trends and root causes, communicate feedback, and monitor corrective actions.

Experience with an electronic health record, encoder, computer-assisted coding or coding-automation technology, audit tools, and Microsoft Excel or comparable analytics tools.

Strong leadership, judgment, written and verbal communication, presentation, organization, project-management, and analytical skills.

Preferred:

8-12 years of relevant experience preferred.

Experience leading coding quality, auditing, education, or compliance functions in a large academic medical center or multi-hospital health system.

Experience with Epic, 3M 360 Encompass or comparable encoder/CAC technology, coding automation, data visualization, and revenue-cycle analytics.

Experience supervising remote or hybrid employees, managing external coding or auditing vendors, and coordinating student or internship programs.

Ongoing:

Maintains required credentials, continuing education, competencies, and compliance training as applicable.

Job Relationships

Supervisory Responsibility:

Direct supervision of outpatient coding quality analysts, coding leads, the outpatient coding educator, and assigned students or interns. Responsible for accurate, timely, and consistent quality monitoring; coding education; technical guidance; audit documentation; corrective-action monitoring; and other coding quality activities that support compliant billing, data integrity, and appropriate reimbursement.

Contacts:

Outpatient Coding Operations, Medical Information Management, Compliance, Revenue Integrity, Patient Financial Services, Clinical Documentation Integrity, Quality, Finance, Information Technology, clinical departments, providers, Human Resources, payers, external auditors, consultants, vendors, academic partners, as necessary.

Administrative Assistant & Outreach Caller

About the Role

We are looking for a polished, phone-confident Administrative Assistant & Outreach Caller to support a private equity deal sourcing business focused on home services. You will handle the day-to-day administration of the deal pipeline and make outbound calls to business owners, brokers, and investment bankers. If you communicate clearly on the phone, stay organized, and handle rejection well, this role is a strong fit.

What You'll Do

Outbound Calling and Outreach

  • Make outbound calls to home service businesses (HVAC, plumbing, electrical, pest control, and similar) and to bankers and brokers, introducing the opportunity and setting up conversations.
  • Log every call outcome in the CRM, such as not interested, interested, or call back in six months.
  • Reach out to business owners, bankers, and brokers on LinkedIn.
  • Support email outreach campaigns to potential sellers.
  • Update and contact a list of private equity funds that buy home service businesses, and schedule meetings.

Deal Pipeline Administration

  • Send daily emails with the deal sheet and background information to contacts.
  • Review incoming emails to flag deals that fit the investment criteria.
  • Prepare and complete non-disclosure agreements (NDAs) for businesses of interest.
  • Keep the deal sheet current: add new deals, confirm NDAs are received and executed, and make sure each deal has a CIM with a balance sheet and financials.
  • Email or text brokers and bankers to request missing information.
  • Score deals and review the deal sheet regularly for gaps.
  • Schedule meetings with bankers and brokers.
  • Build prospect lists from Reference USA for home service businesses that fit the investment criteria.
  • Keep the Zoho CRM updated with new contact information.

What We're Looking For

Required

  • Strong spoken English and a professional, confident phone presence.
  • Comfort making outbound calls and handling rejection.
  • Administrative experience, including scheduling, email management, and follow-ups.
  • Strong organization and attention to detail, with the ability to work independently.
  • Reliable internet connection and a quiet workspace for calls.

Preferred

  • Experience with a CRM, ideally Zoho (HubSpot or similar is also valuable).
  • Private equity, finance, or business development background.
  • Experience with Excel or call-tracking spreadsheets.
  • Familiarity with LinkedIn outreach and email marketing.

Schedule and Tools

  • Hours: 9 AM to 5 PM Eastern Time. You will message the team when you start your day and send a midday update.
  • CRM: Zoho (current system).
  • Phone: A VoIP business line with a 404 area code is provided, with call logs, recordings, and call length available.
  • Communication: Zoom.
  • Tracking: Excel call tracker for outcomes and updates.

Why Join Us

  • Hands-on exposure to private equity deal sourcing.
  • Close collaboration with a small team and clear ownership of your work.
  • Room to learn outbound calling and deal pipeline management from the ground up.

raw.description:
Position Summary
DataSpring runs the largest healthcare data foundation in the U.S. The Sr. Data Engineer builds and owns the pipelines and data models behind our provider data platform and the ProView suite. You will spend most of your time writing production code on Azure Databricks and Azure SQL: ingesting provider data from many sources, modeling it with history and lineage, and deciding which source wins when they disagree. You will also own our data modeling standards and the automation that enforces them, and review the data model work of internal engineers and vendor delivery teams.

The Sr. Data Engineer is a full-time, remote, exempt position and reports to the Senior Director, Data Engineering & Architecture.

Specific Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and operate production pipelines on Azure Databricks and Azure SQL that ingest, integrate, and publish provider data from internal and third-party sources.
  • Design the data models those pipelines load, including integration and master-data layers with history (SCD Type 2), source lineage, and field-level survivorship rules.
  • Write production-grade SQL, PySpark, Python, and DDL, and tune performance and cost on large datasets.
  • Build data quality checks, reconciliation, monitoring, and alerting so problems surface before customers find them.
  • Own the data modeling and naming standards for SQL Server, Azure SQL, and Databricks (Delta Lake, Unity Catalog), and build the automated checks in Azure DevOps CI/CD pipelines that enforce them.
  • Review data models, schema changes, and pull requests from internal engineers and vendor teams, and record modeling decisions so they can be traced later.
  • Maintain source-to-target mappings, data dictionaries, and ERDs, generated from the systems themselves wherever possible so they stay current.
  • Partner with Data Science, product, billing, and application teams to turn business requirements into data models and clear data contracts.
  • Protect PHI (Protected Health Information), including classification of sensitive columns, and maintain compliance with HIPAA, HITRUST, and SOC 2 audit requirements.

Supervisory Responsibilities

None. This role sets technical direction for internal engineers and vendor delivery teams without direct reports.

Skills

  • Expert SQL and strong PySpark and Python, with a track record of building and running production pipelines, not only designing them.
  • Deep relational and dimensional modeling skills, including history (SCD), entity resolution, and knowing when each approach is the wrong choice.
  • Hands-on experience with Azure Databricks: Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, medallion architecture, job orchestration (e.g., Databricks Asset Bundles), and performance tuning.
  • Git-based workflows and CI/CD in Azure DevOps or an equivalent platform, including database deployment automation with gated promotion across environments.
  • Experience with data quality testing and pipeline observability.
  • Ability to explain design decisions clearly to engineers, product owners, and leadership, and to hold a technical line with vendor teams while keeping the relationship productive.

Experience

Required:

  • 8+ years in data engineering, including at least 4 years designing data models that reached production at scale.
  • Recent, hands-on production engineering. You will be expected to write and ship code, not only review it.
  • Demonstrated experience building master data management, entity resolution, or survivorship logic across multiple data sources.
  • Experience defining data modeling standards and automating their enforcement.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

Preferred:

  • Healthcare data experience, especially provider data, credentialing, or member eligibility data.
  • Experience reviewing or directing the work of vendor or offshore delivery teams.
  • Experience with data quality platforms (e.g., Ataccama) and data modeling tools (e.g., ER/Studio).
  • Experience using AI-assisted development tools to build engineering automation.

Who We Are

DataSpring is the trusted data connector at the core of healthcare. For more than 25 years, we have powered the industry with the largest and most complete healthcare data foundation in the U.S., including more than 4.8 million provider data records sourced directly from providers and member data representing 75% of covered lives supplied by health plans. By improving how essential information flows across the system, DataSpring helps healthcare operate more efficiently, accurately, and with greater confidence.

What You Get

At DataSpring, you will do meaningful work at the intersection of healthcare, data, and technology, helping solve complex problems that make the healthcare system work better. You will collaborate with experienced professionals who care deeply about accuracy, trust, and meaningful impact in a fully remote environment.

DataSpring offers competitive compensation and a comprehensive benefits package for full-time employees, including medical, dental, and vision coverage, a 401(k) with company contributions and matching, paid parental leave, tuition assistance, and generous paid time off. We are committed to investing in our people and supporting professional growth over time.

Equal Opportunity Employer

DataSpring is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and is committed to fostering a workplace where all individuals are valued, respected, and empowered.

Employment decisions at DataSpring are made without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin or ancestry, age, marital status, disability, protected veteran status, personal appearance, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, familial status, family responsibilities, matriculation, political affiliation, genetic information, source of income or any other characteristic protected by law. DataSpring does not tolerate unlawful discrimination or harassment of any kind.

Applicants have rights under the Family and Medical Leave Act (FMLA),Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO), and the Employee Polygraph Protection Act (EPPA). If you need a reasonable accommodation to apply for a posted position, please contact the DataSpring People & Culture team at or 202-517-0436.

raw.description:
Duration: 12 months, anticipated from 4th January 2027 to 15 December 2027
Application deadline: 11:59 p.m. Eastern Time on November 27, 2026

Organization Unit: Securing Digital Rights
Reports To: Director, Securing Digital Rights

Supervises: This position does not supervise staff.

ABOUT EQUALITY NOW:

At Equality Now, we aspire to create a world in which women and men have equal rights under the law and full enjoyment of their human rights. Our mission is gender equality. And how we get there matters. Here are the values behind everything we do.

Founded in 1992, we are an international human rights organization that works to protect and promote the rights of all women and girls around the world. Our campaigns are centred on four program areas: Legal Equality, End Sexual Violence, End Harmful Practices, and End Sexual Exploitation, with a cross-cutting focus on the unique needs of adolescent girls. We are truly global, and we have a team of 80+ people located all around the world. We have team members in Benin, Beirut, London, Geneva, San Jose, El Salvador, Argentina, Nairobi, Tbilisi, New York and Washington, DC among others. We offer a great experience for talented people who are passionate about equality. To work here, you’ll need to share our core values of integrity and accountability, inclusiveness, resilience, and empathy. For more information, visit

MISSION OBJECTIVE:

The Senior Legal Advisor, Digital Rights advances Equality Now’s mission to achieve digital rights, safety, privacy and freedom law by providing expert legal leadership, driving strategic litigation and national level advocacy by accompanying partners and governments, and shaping impactful advocacy across international and regional human rights mechanisms.

As a thought leader and catalyst for change, the Senior Legal Advisor, Digital Rights develops innovative legal interventions, leads high-quality legal research and policy development, and delivers timely, contextually informed outputs that strengthen Equality Now’s advocacy impact at national, regional, and global levels. The role supports feminist, rights-based campaigns to technology-facilitated gender-based violence (TFGBV)and advance universal digital rights, while forging strategic partnerships and amplifying the voices of women and girls in key policy arenas.

PORTFOLIO/TEAM OVERVIEW:

This role ensures that legal international laws and standards are fit for purpose and are applied in the digital realm and develops strategies to dismantle systemic discrimination, prevent gender-based harms, and secure access to justice for women and girls on digital platforms - paying particular attention to TFGBV, sexual exploitation and abuse and the relationship between digital and physical harms.

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

The Consultant will undertake the following activities and deliver the agreed outputs. This scope provides a general outline of the assignment and may be refined in consultation with the Director, Securing Digital Rights to reflect evolving organisational needs and priorities.

Purpose: Analyze with Insight

  • Identifies legal and policy design frameworks to inform strategic advocacy on TFGBV and digital rights.
  • Develops and applies conceptual models to support global campaigns and organizational learning.
  • Analyzes national, regional and international legal systems to identify opportunities for policy change, legal reform, and advocacy leverage.
  • Applies feminist and human rights frameworks to assess gaps and recommend policy and legal responses across multi-jurisdictional contexts.

Engagement: Collaborate

  • Collaborates with Communications to ensure strategic coherence and message alignment.
  • Supports the preparation of internal strategy documents, campaign updates, funding proposals, and reporting deliverables.
  • Engages stakeholders internationally to promote legal and policy change.
  • Builds strategic partnerships and participates in steering committees, national and global forums, and advocacy coalitions (e.g., AUDRi).
  • Strengthens collaborative research and advocacy initiatives by aligning key messages and priorities with regional and thematic partners.

Delivery: Manage the Project Cycle

  • Manages workstreams and deliverables related to two core campaign areas (OSEA and AUDRi), ensuring timely delivery aligned with agreed milestones and donor timelines.
  • Tracks and updates audience/stakeholder mappings, campaign timelines, and implementation schedules.
  • Delivers accurate, evidence-based legal research and analysis aligned with Equality Now’s strategic goals and campaign standards.
  • Produces compelling policy briefs, stakeholder communications, and legal recommendations that support international standard-setting efforts and country-level advocacy.

CONSULTANT REQUIREMENTS & TARGET SKILLS PROFILE:

Substantive Knowledge

  • Demonstrated expertise in international human rights law, legal responses to gender-based violence, and regulation of digital technologies.
  • Understanding of TFGBV and online sexual exploitation and abuse as a form of gender-based violence rooted in structural inequality.
  • Knowledge of legal frameworks governing platform accountability, extraterritorial jurisdiction, digital content regulation, and international cooperation.
  • Familiarity with feminist legal theory and intersectional policy frameworks.
  • Deep understanding of the digital rights landscape, including regulation of digital platforms, online harms, and protections for vulnerable populations.
  • Legal familiarity with tensions between digital freedoms (e.g., expression, privacy) and the obligation to prevent and respond to online violence.
  • Experience developing or contributing to international legal frameworks and cooperative mechanisms.

Communication Skills

  • Fluency in English required; working knowledge of Arabic, French, Spanish, or Russian highly desirable.
  • Adept at fostering cross-cultural collaboration and cultivating trust-based relationships consistent with the mission and values of Equality Now.
  • Excellent legal writing and editing skills, able to produce persuasive and precise submissions, reports, and advocacy tools.
  • Strong oral advocacy and presentation skills, with experience conveying legal arguments to diverse audiences including policymakers, UN bodies, donors, and the media.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with internal and external partners, maintaining strong relationships with civil society coalitions and legal experts.

Execution Skills

  • Demonstrated project management experience, including planning, executing, and tracking complex legal projects across multiple jurisdictions.
  • Ability to coordinate multi-stakeholder legal initiatives, including pro bono partners, consultants, and regional teams.
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills with attention to detail, ensuring timely delivery of high-quality outputs.
  • Capacity to document and systematize legal work for organizational learning and donor accountability.
  • Flexibility to adapt to changing advocacy priorities and international legal developments.
  • Willingness and ability to travel internationally and domestically, sometimes on short notice, to support regional teams, engage with partners, and represent Equality Now.

Targeted Specialized Knowledge

  • Law degree (LL.B/J.D.) with demonstrated expertise in women’s rights, gender equality, or violence against women.
  • Advanced degree (Master’s or equivalent certification) strongly preferred.
  • 7+ years of progressively responsible experience in international human rights, legal advocacy, or women’s rights law.
  • Strong academic background in law, international human rights, gender studies, or a closely related discipline - or equivalent professional experience.

CONSULTANCY FEE AND TERMS:

The advertised amount of $53,000 to $61,000 represents the available budget for the full assignment, based on an estimated 220 working days. The final fee may be lower than this amount, depending on the consultant’s location, relevant local market rates, experience and expertise, and the agreed scope and level of effort. Equality Now and the selected consultant will agree to the fee before signing the consultancy agreement.
The Consultant is responsible for ensuring they are legally authorised to provide the services from their jurisdiction and for maintaining any required registrations, licences, or permits. The Consultant is also responsible for applicable tax filings, payments, and statutory contributions arising from the consultancy. Equality Now will meet any withholding or reporting obligations required by applicable law. Any extension is subject to available funding and mutual written agreement. Renewal is not guaranteed.

HOW TO APPLY

The Consultant must submit a resume or CV and a cover letter. Incomplete applications will not be considered. The application period will close at 11:59 p.m. Eastern Time on November 27, 2026. Due to the anticipated volume of applications, only shortlisted candidates will be contacted for an interview.

Due to the volume of applicants anticipated for this role, only shortlisted candidates will be contacted for an interview.

Equality Now is strong because it is diverse. We actively seek a diverse applicant pool and encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply. Equality Now offers a competitive compensation package, including base salary, savings, health and vacation benefits, and is an Equal Opportunity employer. Equality Now employees are selected on the basis of ability without regard to race, colour, religious beliefs, sex, gender identity and expression, language, political or other opinion, nationality, ethnic or social origin, disability, pregnancy, mental status, HIV status, age, marital status, or sexual orientation.

We welcome all kinds of diversity. Candidates are selected on the basis of ability, in accordance with all country and location-specific laws.

Overview:

The MSP Program Specialist contributes to revenues, profit, client strategy and client retention. He or she will support strategy, operational initiatives and growth as defined by their leaders. Reporting to the Program Manager and serving as a member of the operations team of PeopleScout, the Program Specialist will provide operations support to the MSP division. This role is responsible to support the PeopleScout strategic business plan targets for both sales growth and segment profit contribution. This position serves in collaboration with other divisions across the organization. In addition, this position requires an extremely perceptive person, who is capable of relating to individuals at all levels. As unique situations present themselves, the Program Specialist, MSP must be sensitive to corporate needs, employee goodwill, and the public image.

Location: Remote

ESSENTIAL DUTIES and RESPONSIBILITIES include the following.

Client Delivery

  • Ensure that all customers derive maximum value from their relationship with PeopleScout.
  • Dedicated to supporting the expectations and requirements of internal and external customers.
  • Gets first-hand customer information and uses it for improvements in products and services.
  • Escalate to leadership and work with others to ensure that when disruptions/issues occur in service delivery these situations are resolved quickly to win repeat business.
  • Support revenue growth objectives for a strategic portfolio of accounts by handling client needs to ensure satisfaction and retention.
  • Expected to meet or exceed client satisfaction expectations and SLA’s.
  • Conducts periodic status checks with customers and team to assess progress against the plan

Operational Processes

  • Intake call with the manager to qualify the request (mostly for IT and professional)
  • Supplier/manager call for questions from the supplier
  • Shortlisting of the top 5 candidates (mostly for IT and professional)
  • Follow-up for resume feedback
  • Interview follow up with management
  • Requalification of the request when needed based on feedback from the suppliers or a change in the requirements
  • Supplier sourcing calls
  • Provide weekly end date report
  • Must monitor invoicing and aging on a weekly basis
  • Support LI managers through selection, hiring and assignment process
  • Being a business advisor for req fulfillment
  • Identify, recommend and implement changes to improve revenueFacilitate change through new initiatives, processes, expectations, etc.
  • Hands on involvement with the design, delivery, coordination, and implementation of initiatives and best practices.
  • Understands and is highly competent in data analytics and using that data to tell an impactful story.
  • Manages tactical relations with Suppliers; acts as a liaison between the customer’s and supplier’s senior management
  • Utilizes program management skills of communication, presentation, time management, organization and planning to successfully achieve program goals and objectives
  • Contributes to weekly and monthly status reports to Peoplescout and customer senior management on all program activities and issues
  • Assist in implementation of the Workforce Management Solution at new customer engagements
  • Support business delivery of QBR’s monthly dashboards
  • Contributes to supplier and account manuals are completed and maintained throughout the relationship
  • Attend weekly team calls with customer and team with an agenda that has action items
  • Contribute to weekly/bi-weekly client sponsor calls
  • Contribute to all SOP's are completed and manage posting them to shared drives

Planning

  • Contribute to development and formulation of long and short-range planning, policies, programs and objectives with the leadership team.
  • Search for opportunities to be creative, improve and grow the business.
  • Work in partnership with other TrueBlue brands to achieve and/or maintain dominant positions where applicable.
  • Partners with leader and allocates job responsibilities, ensures training of new resources
  • Supports Implementation for program staffing, operational processes and resource training the (responsible for being on every call while implementation process is being conducted to ensure a successful implementation is completed).

Leadership

  • Acts with the best interests and perspectives of the total enterprise in mind; avoids narrow business unit, functional or team interests in favor of doing the right thing for the enterprise
  • Sets personal example for expectation of others. Spends time and energy making certain that people adhere to the principles and standards agreed upon. Follows through on promises and commitments.
  • Encourage a culture of creativity and continued organizational learning.

Key metrics

  • Support Revenue and Profit growth
  • Customer Retention
  • Identify, implement and measure key performance metrics of client delivery teams.

QUALIFICATIONS

EDUCATION and/or EXPERIENCE

  • Absolute and uncompromising integrity with the ability to instill trust, honesty, fairness, credibility and a sense of purpose throughout the company.
  • 1+ years of experience in MSP.
  • Minimum 1 years of experience in a team role.
  • Understanding of P&L management.
  • Demonstrated high level of energy, initiative, internal motivation and an ability to work collaboratively across all levels of the organization.
  • Willingness to serve on various cross-functional teams that address operational and cultural change opportunities available throughout the organization.
  • Ability to make well planned, clear and concise communications and to uphold the necessary supporting actions through to completion of action plans.
  • Must be 18 years of age or older

Salary Range: $48,000 - $57,500 annually, depending on experience and geographic location.

Please note that actual compensation offered may vary based on local pay requirements and will meet or exceed state-specific minimum wage or salary thresholds.

Benefits and Well-Being:

We offer a competitive benefits package, including 6 paid holidays, 1 paid floating holiday and up to 20 days of Paid Time Off per year, Medical/Dental/Vision insurance, Company-matching 401(k) and Employee Stock Purchase Program, in addition to other programs and perks. More details about our benefits can be found here.

We consider qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records in accordance with applicable law.

You must be work authorized in the United States on a full-time basis without the need for employer sponsorship now or in the future. The Company cannot offer employment to F-1 (student) visa holders who require employer sponsorship in the future or cannot work now on a full-time basis.

TrueBlue, Inc. and its brands welcome and encourage applications from candidates with disabilities. Accommodations are available upon request for candidates taking part in the application or interview process. If you require disability-related accommodation during the application or interview process, please contact your Recruiter directly, Employee Relations at , or 1-800-610-8920. TrueBlue, Inc. and its brands will consult with all applicants who request disability-related accommodation during the application or interview process to ensure that the accommodation provided takes into account the applicant’s individual accessibility needs.
