Position: Account Executive (100% Remote) Position Type: Full Time, Permanent (Existing Vacancy) Location: 100% Work‑from‑Home (Must be based and eligible to work in Canada) Brands: Postmedia - Powering Canada’s Digital Future The Opportunity: High-Tech, High-Touch, High-Growth We’ve spent 100 years building Canada’s most trusted media brands. Today, we are leveraging that authority to build the country’s most sophisticated digital sales engine. We are looking for a Digital Account Executive who is a pure hunter. You won't be bogged down by account maintenance or manual data entry. You will be supported by an SDR team, Marketing Solutions Team, and an AI-driven tech stack that allows you to focus on one thing: Closing. Why This Role is Different

100% Remote Freedom: Work from where you are most productive. No commute, more life. Candidates must be eligible to work in Canada. AI-Powered Sales Superpowers: We use leading-edge AI software that summarizes your virtual meetings, automates your follow-ups, and provides real-time coaching to help you sharpen your edge. A "Pod" Support Model: You are the closer. You have SDRs to fuel your pipeline and Sales Engineers to build your technical, data-backed pitches. Zero-Friction Hand-offs: Our tech automatically captures every commitment you make in a meeting and syncs it with our service delivery teams, ensuring your clients get exactly what you promised without you doing the paperwork.

A Day in the Life: The Virtual Hunter

  • 00 AM – Strategy & Lead Review: From your home office, you review high-intent leads generated by our SDR team and inbound marketing.

10:00 AM – The "Deep Dive" Prep: You hop on a virtual sync with a Marketing Solutions Expert. You analyze first-party audience data to build a custom, high-impact digital strategy for a marquee prospect. 11:30 AM – The Virtual Pitch: You lead a high-stakes proposal via video. While you focus on the relationship and the "ask," our AI Sales Assistant is in the background, transcribing the call, noting action items, and analyzing sentiment.

  • 00 PM – Automated Follow-Up: You review the AI-generated meeting summary. With two clicks, a personalized, professional follow-up is sent to the client, and the project details are automatically pushed to our Service Delivery Team.
  • 00 PM – Growth Coaching: You spend 15 minutes reviewing AI-driven insights from your morning calls—identifying "power words" that worked and opportunities to improve your objection handling.
  • 30 PM – Strategic Outreach: You leverage our proprietary market data to target "whale" accounts, knowing you have the best tech in the industry to support your outreach.

Who You Are

The Virtual Closer: You are a pro at building rapport and closing deals over video. You know how to command a "virtual room." Tech-Forward: You embrace AI and CRM tools as assets, not chores. You want to use data to win. Pure Hunter: You are motivated by new business acquisition and thrive on an uncapped commission structure. B2B Sales Expert: You have a track record of selling complex digital solutions (SEO, SEM, Programmatic, Social).

The Rewards

Compensation: $60,176 - $75,220 Base + Uncapped Variable Compensation. Employment offers presented to the selected candidate are based on a combination of qualifications, experience, responsibilities of the role and the candidate's location. Work-Life Integration: 100% Work from Home with the tools and hardware provided to succeed. Future Security: A rare Defined Contribution Pension Plan starting on day one, plus a comprehensive health benefits package. Operational Excellence: You focus on the sale; our Service Delivery layer handles the fulfillment and execution.

We thank in advance all applicants for their interest, however only those candidates under consideration will be contacted. Only candidates legally eligible to work in Canada will be considered. No phone calls or agencies please. Postmedia Network Inc. is committed to providing accommodations for people with disabilities in all areas of the hiring process. If you require accommodation during the hiring process, please make your needs known in advance. Accommodation requests will be provided on an individual basis. Postmedia Network Inc. is committed to employment equity and an inclusive barrier-free selection process and work environment. Postmedia Network Inc. encourages applications from women, indigenous peoples, persons with disabilities and members of visible minorities.

LanguageLine Solutions is Hiring!

At LanguageLine, we strive for a world in which language and cultural barriers no longer exist. Use your language skills to dramatically improve the lives of limited-English speakers, as well as the Deaf and Hard-of-Hearing. Even better, you can do this while working from your own home.

LanguageLine has been certified as a Great Place to Work, and is regularly listed as one of America’s top work-from-home employers.

Our interpreters serve clients across numerous industries, including health care, 911, first responders, education, government agencies, and all walks of business.

As an interpreter, you will receive training that is the best in the industry. We’ll ensure that you learn new skills while further developing your skillset. We provide numerous opportunities for advancement. You’ll be in a certified ASTM and ISO environment. You'll also be supported by a Senior Language Specialist, as well as our Interpreter and Technology Help Desks.

Join our team now!

Job Description

Work at Home Bilingual Farsi-English Video-Phone Interpreter


Job Title: Farsi Interpreter (for speakers of Iranian Farsi)

Location: Work at Home position in United States

Position: Video-Phone Interpreter

Pay: $17 - $21 per hour.

  • Compensation will not be less than any applicable state or local minimum wage.

We Offer:

  • Paid professional interpreter training and continuous development.
  • Incentives for meeting attendance targets.
  • Benefits include: Paid Sick Leave in accordance with applicable law, Medical, Dental, Vision, Employee Assistance Program (EAP), Accident, Critical Illness & Life, AD&D, Insurance Package, Inpatient Hospital, Short Term Disability, and 401K Retirement.
  • Employee Referral Program.
  • Advancement opportunities within the organization.
  • Interpreter support.
  • An inclusive and diverse work environment.

Position Overview:


The Farsi Video-Telephone- Interpreter is responsible for handling calls on demand, and renders the meaning of conversations between Farsi and English speakers. The interpreter breaks the communication barrier in a wide range of industries that LanguageLine Solutions serves: Healthcare, Government, Insurance, Financial, Utilities, Travel & Hospitality, General Business, Law Enforcement, Court, and 911.


The interpreter processes information quickly, concisely and recognizes sensitive cultural differences. The interpreter is professional and courteous at all times and uses appropriate terminology and understands common industry procedures and practices. The video and audio interpreting sessions may involve simple or complex, technical or non-technical subjects.


This position does not involve written translation however translators and other skilled linguists are encouraged to apply. The interpreters translate verbally.


**This is a remote position. The Interpreter works from his/her home-office. It is essential to ensure a quiet & secure environment**


Essential Job Functions:

  • Respond to video and audio interpreting sessions promptly and conduct interpretation in a friendly and professional manner.
  • Participate in online, video and audio training sessions.
  • Deliver interpretation services via video and expediently type data on a dedicated device, such as a laptop, desktop computer, mobile phone, or tablet, in order to perform the essential functions of the job.
  • Render correct concepts and meanings according to the conventions of established interpretation protocol, avoiding omissions or additions.
  • Speak clearly in both languages using proper pronunciation, enunciation and polite expressions.
  • Maintain a professional demeanor throughout the video and audio interpreting sessions at all times.
  • Remain calm during video and audio interpreting sessions in the event that one of the primary speakers is incoherent or upset, especially in emergency situations such as 911 calls.
  • Maintain punctuality and availability during scheduled work hours.
  • Follow client instructions, in compliance with protocol to ensure client expectations are met with the Limited English-speaking Person (LEP), avoiding interaction with the LEP without client’s permission.
  • Understand protocol and terminology for various industries including, but not limited to, Medical, Insurance, Finance and Law.
  • Demonstrate commitment to cultural sensitivity and working in a diverse environment.
  • **Some calls may be highly emotional and/or stressful in nature. The interpreter may need to remain on a call for extended periods without breaks due to the nature of the call or may, at times experience high call volumes. The interpreter must have the ability to provide the required, company standards of service within this dynamic environment. **

Qualifications

  • Fluency inFarsi and English and skilled in the associated cultural dynamics.
  • Ability to provide cultural competency and assess regional and accent differences to find ways of communicating with the LEP.
  • Excellent listening, retention and note-taking skills to maintain a high level of accuracy during interpretation.
  • Ability to concentrate, stay detached from the conversation, remain neutral and objective at all times, and remain on calls that involve sensitive subjects such as end of life conversations, pregnancy termination, vaccinations, and matters concerning sexual orientation and/or gender expression.
  • Education or work experience in language-related fields such as teaching, language assessment, translation or interpretation preferred.
  • Must be able to adapt to any LLS technology enhancements that improve service delivery and meet client demands.
  • Must be at least 18 years of age.
  • Legally authorized to work in the United States.
  • Applicants for employment in the US must have work authorization that does not now or in the future require sponsorship of a visa for employment authorization in the United States and with LanguageLine Solutions (i.e., H1-B visa, F-1 visa (OPT), TN visa or any other non-immigrant status).
  • High school diploma or equivalent.
  • Candidates who are currently employed by a client of LanguageLine Solutions or an affiliated LanguageLine Solutions business may not be eligible for consideration.
  • Ability to read and write the requested languages – highly preferred.

**Based on your location, a post-offer, a pre-employment background check and/or drug screen may be required**


Technical Requirements:

  • Dedicated personal device for business purposes.
    • Desktop / Laptop Computers with any of the following Operating Systems: Windows, MacOS, or ChromeOS.
    • Tablets (iPadOS or Android) are acceptable.
    • Smartphones (iOS or Android) are also acceptable.
  • Restricted brands:
    • Kaspersky products.
    • Huawei hardware.
  • High speed Internet connection for work related electronic communication. This internet connection should provide download speeds of no less than 5 Mbps, upload speeds of 3 Mbps, Ping value of no more than 300 ms, Jitter value of no more than 30 ms.
  • Must have access to a quiet space free from background noise or distraction.

Physical Requirements:

  • Must be able to operate a keyboard and mouse and remain in a stationary position in front of a computer and webcam the majority of the workday.
  • Must use a headset for prolonged periods of time.
  • Must be able to operate company provided software and systems to perform all aspects of the job.
  • Must have sufficient manual dexterity to type or write.
  • Able to lift up to 26 lbs.
  • May be exposed to moderate noise levels; i.e. computer, audio, telephone.

raw.description:
AnewHealth is one of the nation’s leading pharmacy care management companies that specializes in caring for people with the most complex, chronic needs—wherever they call home. We enable better outcomes for patients and the healthcare organizations who support them. Established in 2023 through the combination of ExactCare and Tabula Rasa HealthCare, we provide a suite of solutions that includes comprehensive pharmacy services; full-service pharmacy benefit management; and specialized support services for Program of All-Inclusive Care for the Elderly. With over 1,400 team members, we care for more than 100,000 people across all 50 states.

Job Details


Promotes the success of clients by providing clinical credibility, training of clinicians and others on key aspects of payment methodologies, medical diagnosis, documentation and coding related to health plan management processes and clinical outcomes. Also to help clients analyze challenges in data submission into the Risk Adjustment Processing System and Encounter Data Processing System.


Responsibilities


  • Under direction of Chief Medical Officer, is responsible to support client organizations effectively to optimize processes related to diagnosis documentation, coding, data management, and related processes that impact revenues.
  • Identify deficiencies in client knowledge, skills or attitudes that allow ineffective processes.
  • Identify trends or gaps in data and troubleshoot data flow processes.
  • Collaborate with Client Success Liaisons to:
    • Develop and maintain effective relationships and communications with clients to assure early detection of adverse situations and successful implementation of corrective actions.
    • Establish goals for clients as needed for improvements.
    • Develop effective corrective action plans with clients.
  • Create and modify effective training materials (PowerPoint presentations, written material, video recordings or other media) for clients on relevant topics.
  • Provide training to Providers (physicians, nurse practitioners, physician assistants) and other clinically oriented staff members on all aspects of risk adjustment methodologies used in various value-based contracts, basic documentation principles, and Clinical Documentation Excellence.
  • Assist Chief Medical Officer to develop and maintain a curriculum of topics with appropriate support materials to meet client needs for training and education.
  • Assist Director of Coding/Auditing Services in training of Nurses to become Nurse Auditors, and in training and onboarding of new Client Service Liaisons.
  • Collaborate with Clinical Service Liaisons, Auditors, and when applicable, coders assigned to a given client to identify issues and challenges to be addressed during an upcoming training webinar with the client’s clinical staff members.
  • Collaborate with AnewHealth Project Managers coordinating the provision of various AnewHealth services so that the client receives contracted AnewHealth services in an orderly and coordinated manner.
  • In concert with AnewHealth Project Managers, explore and communicate when it’s realized that clients could benefit from more comprehensive AnewHealth services than currently being employed.
  • Work with the Marketing Department with updated sales material as requested.
  • Responsible to support the organization to further its mission and values, grow market share, and refine existing or develop additional products and services.
  • Collaborate with Project Managers during exploratory calls with potential clients. Act as subject matter experts during presentations explaining the scope of the business’ services.
  • Review and update reference materials for staff and clients.
  • Provide articles for website and newsletters.
  • Represent the business well to external organizations.
  • Support coding and auditing department with medical expertise as required.
  • In collaboration with other physician consultants and Learning Services, maintain and curate the “On-Line Clinical Documentation Excellence” educational material.
  • In collaboration with other physician consultants and Learning Services, create update and maintain video recordings of all presentations including the four-hour general overview (“survey” presentations) and all specialty specific topics.
  • Embody AnewHealth’s Core Values in all communications and interactions.
  • Other duties as assigned.

The above essential functions are representative of major duties of positions in this job classification. Specific duties and responsibilities may vary based upon departmental needs. Other duties may be assigned similar to the above consistent with knowledge, skills and abilities required for the job. Not all of the duties may be assigned to a position.


Qualifications: These represent the desired qualifications of the ideal candidate. They are not meant to limit consideration for candidates who do not meet all of the standards listed. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.


Education


  • Required:
    • MD or DO
    • Board Certified in Internal Medicine or Family Medicine
  • Preferred:
    • Board Certification in Geriatrics
    • Board Certification in Hospice and Palliative Care Medicine
    • CMD or other medical leadership certification

Experience


  • Required:
    • 3 years’ PACE experience
    • Alternatively, 5+ experience in Risk Adjustment Models of Care and deep familiarity of the PACE Model
    • Articulate and comfortable teaching in front of an audience (live or virtual).

raw.excerpt: Get to know us better CodiLime is a software and network engineering industry expert and the first-choice service partner for top global networking hardware providers, software providers and telecoms.
raw.description:
Get to know us better

CodiLime is a software and network engineering industry expert and the first-choice service partner for top global networking hardware providers, software providers and telecoms. We create proofs-of-concept, help our clients build new products, nurture existing ones and provide services in production environments. Our clients include both tech startups and big players in various industries and geographic locations (US, Japan, Israel, Europe).

While no longer a startup - we have 250+ people on board and have been operating since 2011 we’ve kept our people-oriented culture. Our values are simple:

  • Act to deliver.

  • Disrupt to grow.

  • Team up to win.

The project and the team

We develop software for modern platforms and operating systems for leading networking equipment manufacturers, as well as various other cloud-native, containerized services and solutions. In this project, you will join a 3-person team (consisting of 1 C Developer and 2 QA Engineers) responsible for migrating the support of dozens of OpenConfig (OC) data models in an enterprise network operating system. We are moving from a legacy C-based mapping engine to a new proprietary declarative mapping DSL.

What else you should know:

  • The client is a global company with employees based in Europe, the US, and Asia.

  • The project will be managed by the client, but the Codilime Engineering Manager will be assisting in the project management and coordination.

  • Frequent collaboration with a US-based team will be required.

  • Periodical sync calls with the customer may be required in the US-friendly hours (17:00 - 20:00)

Your role

As the Senior QA Automation Engineer, you will provide crucial technical support in Python, data models, and consistency verification between the old and new mapping mechanisms. Your responsibilities will include:

  • Running, maintaining, and handling existing Python-based regression tests that configure the system via OpenConfig models.

  • Debugging test failures and analyzing test logs to ensure stability.

  • Verifying the correctness of mappings and diagnosing validation errors on the device side.

  • Collaborating with the C Developer to look into the removed legacy module to catch hidden logic or corner cases and ensure full test coverage.

  • Working directly with feature teams and infrastructure creators

Do we have a match?

As a Senior QA Automation Engineer, you must meet the following criteria:

  • Python Proficiency (Must-have): Excellent Python programming skills to efficiently run tests, debug failures, and analyze logs.

  • YANG / OpenConfig & Networking (Must-have): Practical ability to read YANG (OpenConfig) schemas and solid grasp of essential networking concepts (L2/L3, Interfaces, Routing, ACLs) to verify schema translation mappings.

  • Environment & Independence (Must-have): Comfort working independently in Linux-based development environments, including Git, CI/CD pipelines, and lab environments.

  • Communication Skills: Strong communicativeness enabling direct collaboration with cross-functional technical teams.

A perfect match candidate will also possess the following experience (Nice-to-have):

  • C Proficiency (Strong asset): Ability to read and understand existing C code. You will not write production C code, but this skill will help you analyze legacy codebases alongside the development team to catch edge cases.

  • Experience with Network Operating Systems (NOS): Prior exposure to enterprise or service-provider platforms (e.g., SONIC, Arista EOS, Cisco IOS-XR, Nokia SR OS, Junos) or CPE systems (e.g., prpIOS, OpenWrt).

  • Automated testing workflows: Experience with automated validation pipelines and network test frameworks in enterprise environments.

More reasons to join us

  • Flexible working hours and approach to work: fully remotely, in the office or hybrid

  • Professional growth supported by internal training sessions and a training budget

  • Solid onboarding with a hands-on approach to give you an easy start

  • A great atmosphere among professionals who are passionate about their work

  • The ability to change the project you work on

ELAW Defenders Program Director

Location: Remote (fully remote based anywhere) or in-person in Eugene, Oregon

Hiring Range: $130,000 - $145,000

Reports to: Executive Director/Deputy Executive Director
Supervises: Defenders Team Attorneys and Interns

Status: If in the U.S., this position is for an exempt, full-time employee. If outside the U.S., ELAW may use a Contractor of Record provider.

About the Organization

Environmental Law Alliance Worldwide (ELAW) is an international NGO, registered in Oregon as a nonprofit. At ELAW, we believe that environmental protection and human rights are inseparable—and that the best solutions come from those closest to the problem. That’s why we support a global network of public interest lawyers and scientists in 80+ countries working to protect communities and ecosystems through law.

Headquartered in Eugene, Oregon, ELAW connects local expertise with global impact—empowering people on the front lines of environmental and human rights challenges.

About the Role

The Defenders Program Director provides vision, strategic direction, and oversight to the Defenders Team. The Defenders Team supports public interest environmental lawyers around the world to prevent and deter threats and attacks, and defend against legal, personal, and organizational attacks that occur as a result of their advocacy.

What You’ll Do

  • Project development, implementation, management and reporting;
  • Work with others at ELAW to identify, cultivate and steward prospective funders for the Program;
  • Meet with funders and potential funders to describe ELAW work and discuss priorities;
  • Help Executive Office and Fundraising and Communications Teams with fundraising;
  • Coordinate the Defenders Team's recommendations for regranting and emergency support to defenders (e.g. through ELAW's Action Partnership), ensuring due diligence, timely decisions and alignment with partner-led approaches;
  • Ensure that requests for the Defenders Team are recorded and assigned (if applicable) as they come in, and that deadlines are met;
  • Manage Salesforce data entry for the Defenders Team;
  • Participate in Leadership Team when matters relating to Defenders Team and organizational risk arise;
  • Review or ensure review of legal work and guide Defenders Team members including lawyers and interns;
  • Supervise work of other team members;
  • Participate in strategic planning meetings to represent the Defenders Team;
  • Participate in identifying, recruiting, and hiring new Team members and interns along with the Executive Office;
  • Collaborate on Defenders Team administration;
  • Help to on-board new Team members;
  • Facilitate reporting to the Board on Defenders Team work when requested to do so;
  • Review draft funding proposals that implicate work for the Defenders Team
  • Meet with representatives of other teams to ensure smooth collaboration across teams
  • Lead a monitoring, evaluation and learning (MEL) system for the Program, including indicators, documentation of outcomes and periodic reflection on lessons learned.
  • Integrate gender, Indigenous and intersectional perspectives across the Program, and ensure a partner-led, non-extractive approach to collaboration with defenders and their lawyers.
  • Develop and evolve program tactics to meet emerging needs of ELAW partners and advance movement strategies in consultation with colleagues.

What your team does

Each member of the ELAW Defenders Team contributes to fulfilling the team’s mandate, which is periodically updated to reflect evolving priorities. Defenders Team members collaborate closely with partners, support global legal efforts, and help advance ELAW’s mission through research, capacity building, legal engagement, and resource referrals.

Every member of the ELAW Defenders Team will contribute to delivering work described in the Defenders Team mandate that will be revised from time to time.

The Defenders Team:

  • Provides legal support to ELAW partners to mitigate risks, prevent attacks, and defend themselves and their organizations when they are threatened or attacked for their advocacy;
  • Supports environmental law colleagues who are pressed into service representing clients that are threatened or attacked for their advocacy;
  • Cultivates and supports relationships with ELAW partners who are themselves representing clients under threat and attack or otherwise working to address attacks on environmental defenders to continually learn and develop the ELAW Defenders Program
  • Reviews work by other team members and supports their work;
  • Maintains and cultivates referral partnerships that provide other forms of non-legal defender-related support, e.g. psychosocial, digital security, financial

Who You Are

You are an experienced professional with 10+ years’ experience working with public interest legal advocacy. You thrive in a collaborative, cross-cultural environment and are eager to support a mission-driven global community. You live in or have significant experience living and working with colleagues in the Global South. You bring humility, curiosity, and an openness to new ideas and learning from colleagues, as well as confidence and experience.

Qualifications

  • Minimum 5 years leading a department or program;
  • Significant experience in a nonprofit organization;
  • Experience working in an international organization;
  • Excellent communication and leadership skills;
  • Knowledge of trends of attacks on environmental defenders around the world, and movement strategies to fight back on those trends;
  • Experience working to defend environmental defenders and awareness of protection mechanisms at the national and international levels to activate protections;
  • Law Degree (JD in United States, equivalent in other countries) or other advanced degree or experience related to protecting environmental defenders

Leadership Competencies

Strategic thinking; executive presence; change management; collaboration; coaching and talent development; integrity; systems thinking; sound judgment; commitment to justice, equity, diversity, inclusion, and mission.

Why Join Us

At ELAW, you’ll be part of an international network advancing justice and sustainability —while helping keep our Eugene base running as the heart of that mission.

This is a chance to contribute to meaningful global change every day.

The expected hiring range for this position is $130,000 - $145,000. U.S.-based team members who are hired as employees are eligible for a full benefits package. ELAW considers experience and total compensation for team members when determining exact salaries or contract rates.

How to Apply: To apply, please click on 'apply for this job' and complete the form, and upload your resume and cover letter in one document. The position will remain open until filled with Application Review beginning December 7, 2026. No phone calls, please.

Our Commitment to Equity

We actively seek applicants from diverse backgrounds and encourage applications from those historically underrepresented in this field.

ELAW is committed to equity, inclusion, and justice in our work and in our workplace. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, gender, age, disability, immigration status, sexual orientation, or any other protected identity.

At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode - pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next.


The Demand Science team within Ads Data & Insights plays a crucial role in Netflix Ads growth by equipping the business to efficiently attract, activate, and scale advertiser demand. As the lead Analytics Engineer for demand analytics, you would own the metrics, analytical roadmap, and hands-on analysis that power Netflix’s advertiser demand strategy.


If you enjoy tackling complex, open-ended analytical projects that drive product and commercial strategy and are exceptional at crafting compelling data-driven stories - this is the role for you.


What You'll Do

As the lead Analytics Engineer for Demand Science, you'll own the vision and lead execution across areas such as:


  • Own and evolve the demand analytics roadmap, prioritizing the questions that matter most to the business and successfully illuminating new opportunities for Netflix Ads through your work.
  • Lead end-to-end analytical investigations into ambiguous, high-stakes demand questions — from framing the hypothesis through data development, analysis, and presentation of findings.
  • Leverage your analytical findings and storytelling ability to successfully influence demand strategy at the senior leadership level across Product, Strategy, and Commercial teams.
  • Guide and influence the roadmaps of other analytics engineers and data scientists in service of this learning agenda, forging strong cross-team partnerships where needed.

Who You Are

  • Experience independently scoping and leading complex and ambiguous analytical projects that have org-wide impact — not just executing on defined projects, but identifying which questions matter most and driving them from ambiguity to measurable business influence and impact.
  • Strong strategic acumen and interest: You are curious about and have the ability to deeply understand business objectives (ranging from product strategy to commercial challenges) and can translate them into a prioritized analytical roadmap.
  • Comfort with ambiguity and a proactive, curious approach to problem-solving — you can operate effectively in a space where the path is not laid out for you and where the "right" metric or analytical approach may not exist yet.
  • You excel at synthesizing complex data into compelling, data-driven narratives that influence company strategy and business goals at the senior leadership level; you are proactive and effective at building strong cross-functional relationships.
  • You may have had titles in the past like Staff/Senior Data Scientist or Staff Data Analyst.
  • Proficient in SQL and a scripting language (e.g., Python); excellent at producing high-quality, impactful analysis with AI assistance, and able to lead colleagues as best practice evolves.

  • The Netflix Culture Memo resonates with you: you hold a high bar for yourself and your colleagues, you are comfortable receiving and giving candid feedback, and you are usually responsible: self-motivated, self-aware, and self-disciplined.

raw.description:
Karman is a fast-growing NVIDIA-backed AI company enabling AI data centers to dynamically orchestrate power and unlock more compute capacity from existing energy infrastructure. For over a decade, we have applied AI to the electric grid — bringing real-time visibility and power-flow control to complex energy infrastructure. Our Karman platform, built on a custom NVIDIA module, brings that same capability to AI data centers, giving operators a way to better use the power already available to them.

We are looking for an Application Engineer, Data Center Software to join our Technical Programs team. This is a founding role in a new Application Engineering function, responsible for building the integration layer — custom API connectors, configuration checkers, and test frameworks — between Karman and the diverse software environments operated by our data center customers. This person will work directly with customer operations and engineering teams to define requirements, lead technical discussions, and translate customer needs into integration designs. Because the integration surface is still being defined, this role carries real influence over how Karman's software integrations take shape, including the processes, tools, and standards that future engineers will build on. We are looking for candidates who are technically deep, customer-savvy, and energized by the challenge of building new integration surfaces in a fast-moving product environment.

Responsibilities
  • Work directly with customer data center operations and engineering teams to assess software environments, lead integration discussions, and translate requirements into actionable designs across DCIM platforms, custom dashboards, hypervisors, and management APIs
  • Design, develop, and validate custom API connectors between Karman and customer-specific data center software systems
  • Validate server builds against Karman's software requirements; write and execute configuration checkers and test suites for installation across customer environments
  • Conduct benchmark-driven and exploratory performance testing to identify and resolve bottlenecks
  • Debug integration issues and installation failures independently, leveraging deep familiarity with the Karman platform built through close collaboration with internal software engineering teams
  • Drive execution and sign-off of software installation requirement checklists for each customer engagement
  • Take an AI-first approach to automating processes and generating test frameworks, configuration checkers, integration artifacts, and deployment documentation
  • Build the software integration playbook — repeatable processes, templates, and documentation that scale the function beyond individual customer engagements
  • Create and maintain software integration artifacts, including SW validation checklists, test plans, configuration guides, KPI trackers, and After-Action Reports
  • Participate in roadmap meetings, engineering design reviews, and sprint planning to maintain a current understanding of the Karman platform
  • Serve as the feedback loop between customer deployments and core engineering, translating integration learnings into platform improvements
  • Support the TechOps team with software integration expertise for escalated production incidents related to initial installation
  • Participate in on-call rotation to provide 24x7 customer support

Minimum Qualifications
  • 6+ years of experience in systems integration, application engineering, solutions engineering, platform engineering, or related technical roles supporting enterprise software deployments in data center environments
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or similar field OR equivalent training and on the job experience
  • Strong working knowledge of Linux-based environments, including software installation, system configuration, troubleshooting, and validation
  • Demonstrated ability to design and implement API integrations between disparate software systems, including REST APIs and other common patterns
  • Experience working with containerized and virtualized environments, including the ability to understand and troubleshoot customer deployment architectures
  • Experience developing integration validation tools, configuration checks, test automation, or deployment verification processes for enterprise software environments
  • Ability to develop scripts, automation, and integration tooling using Python or Rust
  • Familiarity with APIs, messaging frameworks, and integration technologies such as REST, gRPC, Kafka, Protobuf, or similar technologies
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to engage customer data center operations teams and translate requirements into integration designs
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently and own complex technical problems end-to-end
  • High learning agility across diverse customer software environments
  • Experience integrating with DCIM platforms, hypervisors, or data center management APIs (e.g., Redfish, IPMI, or vendor-specific management interfaces)
  • Experience working directly with customers, stakeholders, or cross-functional technical teams to gather requirements, design solutions, and troubleshoot complex integration challenges
Enhanced Qualifications (Nice to Have)
  • Familiarity with observability and monitoring tooling common in data center environments (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana)
  • Experience building or contributing to structured software integration processes, checklists, or validation frameworks
  • Experience with GitOps-based deployment workflows (e.g., ArgoCD, Helm)

Salary Range: $175,000 to $245,000 base compensation depending on experience and level, plus stock options. This role spans multiple job levels; final level and compensation will be determined based on the candidate's experience.

Location: This position can be performed remotely from within the United States. Preference will be given to candidates based in or around the Bay Area, CA. Periodic travel to customer data center sites (including international customers) and the company’s HQ in Ann Arbor, MI is required.

Our Commitments
Karman values the diversity of our team. We provide equal employment opportunities without regard to race, color, religion, creed, sex, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, pregnancy or childbirth, sexual orientation, genetics, genetic information, marital status, or status as a covered veteran or any other basis protected by applicable federal, state and local laws.

We are committed to:
  • Creating a diverse and inclusive workplace that is welcoming, supportive, affirming and respectful
  • Empowering employees to solve problems and work together to make a difference
  • Providing mentorship and growth opportunities as part of a collaborative team
  • A flexible work environment with flexible paid time off
  • Competitive compensation and benefits, including health, dental, vision, and employer-match 401k

The Manager, US Payroll leads accurate, timely, and compliant end-to-end payroll operations for employees across the United States. The Cardiac Technician plays a vital role in delivering high-quality ambulatory cardiac monitoring services by reviewing, analyzing, and processing cardiac studies with accuracy and attention to detail. This position is responsible for identifying and documenting cardiac rhythms, arrhythmias, and clinically significant events, preparing preliminary reports for physician interpretation, and escalating urgent findings in accordance with established clinical protocols. Cardiac Technicians provide patient support by assisting with monitor use, troubleshooting device issues, and ensuring successful study completion while maintaining excellent customer service. Working in a fast-paced, collaborative environment, they adhere to quality standards, departmental procedures, and regulatory requirements while effectively managing multiple priorities. The ideal candidate possesses strong ECG interpretation skills, critical thinking abilities, exceptional attention to detail, and a commitment to delivering safe, efficient, and patient-centered care. Cardiac Monitor Technicians perform patient monitoring duties in the telemetry areas and is responsible for informing physicians of any arrhythmias or changes in patient's rate or rhythm.

What You'll Do

• Review patient's ECG data and related algorithm findings for clinical accuracy and completeness
• Effectively communicate ECG abnormalities by notifying physicians as required according to physician notification protocol
• Perform 100% of the quality assurance behind the final report delivered to the physician, and provide report format modifications and additions as requested
• Maintain compliance with job specific proficiency requirements, including CCT certification
• Answers calls for assistance from patients and inquiries concerning patients from physicians
• Continuously develop clinical knowledge, particularly ECG rhythm interpretation skills
• Communicate with internal and external customers

This individual must possess the following knowledge, skills and abilities and be able to explain and demonstrate that he or she can perform the essential functions of the job, with or without reasonable accommodation, using some other combination of knowledge, skills, and abilities:

• Proficient in MS Internet Explorer, Excel and various MS office programs

• Excellent phone manner

    • Excellent organizational skills

A minimum of 3-5+ years of experience as a telemetry/monitor technician or equivalent combination of education and experience.

raw.description:
About InvestEngine

InvestEngine is everything the modern investor should need: unbeatable value, market-leading automation, and a platform built for easy, long-term investing.

We’ve built a strong foundation, with over £3.5 billion invested, award-winning service, and a passionate team. We’re an FCA-regulated investment platform growing fast — and we want every customer to understand our communications and act on them with confidence.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Compliance Analyst, Financial Promotions to join our Compliance Advisory team. This is a growth role: ideal for someone with around two years in compliance, or with transferable experience, who wants to build a career in financial promotions.

Your mission is to help InvestEngine deliver financial promotions that are fair, clear and not misleading. You’ll review our own promotions and, within the firm’s permitted scope, third-party (Section 21) promotions — starting with training and supervised reviews and growing towards handling appropriately delegated work independently, while keeping a clear audit trail and escalating uncertainty.

You’ll work closely with Marketing, Partnerships and Product, including on affiliate and influencer content, providing independent second-line review and constructive challenge.

What You’ll Do

  • Complete a structured learning plan on our products and the rules that apply to them (fair, clear and not misleading, COBS 4, Consumer Duty, Section 21)

  • Review promotions across channels — website, app, social, email, affiliate and influencer content — identifying claims, missing evidence and customer risks

  • Give clear, actionable written feedback: what the issue is, why it matters, what evidence is needed and a practical alternative

  • Keep an audit-ready record for every case in Adclear: final version, channel, evidence, decision and rationale

  • Support timely decisions by managing competing submissions, tracking outstanding information and flagging urgent or complex cases

  • Support Section 21 lifecycle controls: partner reviews, live-promotion checks and attestations, escalating concerns promptly

  • Spot recurring issues and help improve the workflow

What We’re Looking For

  • Around two years’ experience in compliance, or transferable experience in operations, financial services, customer communications, legal, marketing or a similar setting

  • Strong analytical judgement and attention to detail — and you know when to ask for help

  • The ability to learn rules quickly and apply them to real examples

  • Clear writing and the confidence to challenge respectfully, holding the line under pressure

  • Well organised, with strong record-keeping and evidence discipline

  • Customer focus: you think about how a retail investor might understand a message, its risks and costs

  • Confident with digital workflow tools and a sensible, responsible approach to using AI — checking output against evidence and rules

  • English fluency at C1 level or above — we are a UK-based company and you’ll review content for UK customers

Nice to Have

  • Experience reviewing financial promotions or marketing content in an FCA-regulated firm

  • Familiarity with COBS 4, Consumer Duty or Section 21 approvals

  • Knowledge of investment products such as ETFs, ISAs or SIPPs

  • Experience with Adclear or similar review tools

How We Work

We’re a lean, fast-moving team that values clarity, ownership and transparency. You’ll have the freedom to improve how things work, the responsibility to follow through, and the backing of a team that values clear thinking and open dialogue. We believe in solving problems at the root rather than simply treating the symptoms.

What We Offer

Impact from day one
Your reviews directly shape what our customers see and help them make informed investment decisions.

Room to grow
A clear development path, from supervised reviews towards scoped independent approval, with exposure to regulation and every part of a growing fintech.

Transparent and open culture
We share information openly, keep communication clear and encourage collaboration across the business.

Supportive, high-calibre team
Work alongside talented people who care about the quality of their work and are generous with their knowledge.

Remote and flexible
Georgia-based with flexibility. We focus on results and trust you to manage your time effectively.

Our Hiring Process

  • Introductory call with our Talent team

  • Interview with the hiring manager

  • Practical exercise: review a short sample promotion

  • Final interview with senior leadership

We aim to keep the process straightforward, transparent and efficient.

Eaton’s IS AER FED division is currently seeking a Vapor Cycle/Refrigeration Specialist. This position can be located at our Jackson, MI facility or can be based remotely. Candidates must currently reside in the U.S. and work from a U.S.-based remote location.

The Vapor Cycle System (VCS) [Refrigeration] Specialist Systems Engineer will lead complex systems development providing direction for the, design, development, analysis, interface, integration, and verification of actively controlled thermal management solutions for the Aerospace market. This role requires subject matter expertise in Vapor Cycle System architecture definition, technology selection, and component selection trade-offs to oversee the design and strategic development of the thermal system and integration in an aircraft. The role will require the specialist to apply strong team leadership skills, knowledge of market trends, and VCS domain expertise to lead and guide a team through clean sheet system design, or innovation of existing products to meet evolving market demands. The selected candidate must be experienced with System Engineering practices as defined by INCOSE such as system requirement definition and derivation of requirements, system architecture design, system performance budgeting and allocation, development planning, verification planning and specification to sub-system and LRUs, system controls objectives, as well as the aircraft system development process per ARP4754.

​

The expected annual salary range for this role is $113000 - $165000 a year.

Please note the salary information shown above is a general guideline only. Salaries are based upon candidate skills, experience, and qualifications, as well as market and business considerations.

What you’ll do:

  • Architect and develop new systems to meet customer requirements utilizing the AgileStartsTM development process via cross functional collaboration with customers and an internal team including Systems engineers, product engineers, Manufacturing, Quality, Supply Chain, Program Management as well as product or process subject matter experts within functional centers of Excellence (CoE) for modeling and simulation, reliability, maintainability, safety, motors, electronics, firmware and software.
    • Execute on systems engineering functional capabilities including requirements development including decomposition, flow-down, and traceability; system architecture design and analysis; project engineering; control system design; system integration and verification; requirements compliance; certification compliance.
    • Prepare and review project related documentation to ensure completeness and quality.
    • Identify and mitigate project technical and schedule risks and quantify impact of realizing the risk.
    • Evaluate design trade-offs using Design for Six Sigma tools.
    • Apply statistical and analytical tools towards effective problem-solving and completion of project activities.
    • Direct and support other global engineering resources for timely completion of project objectives.
    • Lead structured problem-solving efforts and/ or failure analysis to solve issues in a timely manner.
    • Conduct internal, supplier, and customer design reviews.
    • Decompose system level requirements to sub-system and component level critical to quality (CTQ) requirements.

• Generation of intellectual property.

  • Prepare presentations for Eaton leadership and representation at customer meetings as a technical expert. Highlight issues and manage customer requirements when necessary.
    • Develop standard processes, design standards, working instructions and best practices including the Eaton Aerospace Common Engineering Standards (ACES).
    • Lead cross functional proposal preparation including creation of technical proposals, risk identification and mitigation planning, strategic project execution planning, engineering schedules, and quote the labor, material, and other direct costs required to execute development programs.
    • Serve as VCS domain expert for Product Engineering team. Could be called upon as a consultant for complex assignments across the Division. Provide technical leadership and guidance for an internal system and product engineers and provide technical leadership as part of the IPT to execute on programs.
    • Develop tools, design methods, analysis and verification techniques to ensure efficient and accurate system architectures and predictions.
    • Provide mentoring to systems and product engineers.

• Complete other duties as assigned.

Qualifications:

Required (Basic) Qualifications:
• Bachelor’s degree in Engineering from an accredited institution.
• Minimum of ten (10) years experience in systems, product design, or development in a technical role related to Vapor Cycle Systems (Refrigeration).
• Eaton will not consider applicants for employment immigration sponsorship or support for this position. This means that Eaton will not support any "CPT, OPT, or STEM OPT plans, F-1 to H-1B, H-1B cap registration, O-1, E-3, TN status, I-485 job portability, etc.".
• This position requires access to export-controlled information. To conform to U.S. Government export regulations applicable to that information, applicant must be a U.S. person, defined as a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (green card holder), (iii) refugee under 8 U.S.C. 1157, or (iv) asylee under 8 U.S.C. 1158.

Preferred Qualifications:
• Advanced degree in Thermal Systems with specialty in Vapor Cycle Systems from an accredited institution.
• Minimum of fifteen (15) years experience with Vapor Cycle Systems and components.
• Minimum of five (5) years experience developing Aerospace Vapor Cycle Systems.

• INCOSE certified.

  • Experienced in Model Based Systems Engineering (MBSE) and SysML.
    • Design for Six Sigma (DFSS) Green Belt certified.
    • Experience with fluid conveyance related products, manufacturing techniques and materials.

Position Success Criteria:

  • Working knowledge of analysis tools, boundary conditions, and constraints to direct and review supporting team member’s work.
    • Ability to compose clear and concise written communication.
    • Technical leadership skills working with a cross-functional team assigning and delegating tasks to achieve objectives.
    • Strong communication and collaboration with internal and external customers.
    • Detail a system development plan addressing self and cross functionally identified risks.
    • Demonstrated knowledge of market trends specifically associated with the vapor cycle domain.
    • Requirement development including authoring, derivation to lower level requirements through to components with clear traceability, change control, validation, verification, and auditing (DOORS or Jazz).
    • System architecture design and analysis.

• Systems project engineering.

• System Safety (FHA / SSA / FTA).

  • System control objective and associated tolerance specification.
    • System integration and verification.
    • Certification compliance – SAE ARP 4754A.
    • Product design and certification aligned with hydraulic and/or electrical actuation components.
    • Analytical tool knowledge of System (1D) and Component (3D) analyses.
    • System Performance Simulation – (EES, Simulink/ Simscape, Amesim, GTsuite).
    • FEA.
    • CFD.
    • Heat transfer analyses.
    • Liquid and multi-phase thermal management component knowledge and performance characteristics.
    • Ability to read and understand Drawings, Specifications, and Requirements.
    • Working knowledge of Geometric Dimensioning and Tolerancing (GD&T).
    • Basic review capabilities in CAD (CATIA).
    • Understanding of design evaluation techniques such as reliability analysis, statistical tolerance stack up, Failure Mode and Effect analysis (FMEA), etc.
    • Proficiency in Product Data Management systems for document control and workflow management (ENOVIA).
    • Proficiency in using Microsoft Office Suite tools.

About Trafilea

Trafilea is a Consumer Tech Platform for Transformative Brand Growth. We’re building the AI Growth Engine that powers the next generation of consumer brands.

With over $1B+ in cumulative revenue, 12M+ customers, and 500+ talents across 19 countries, we combine technology, growth marketing, and operational excellence to scale purpose-driven, digitally native brands.

We own and operate our own digitally native brands (not an agency), with presence in Walmart, Nordstrom, and Amazon, and a strong global D2C footprint.

Why Trafilea

We’re a tech-led eCommerce group scaling our own globally loved DTC brands, while helping ambitious talent grow just as fast.

🚀 We build and scale our own brands.

🦾 We invest in AI and automation like few others in eCom.

📈 We test fast, grow fast, and help you do the same.

🤝 Be part of a dynamic, diverse, and talented global team.

🌍 100% Remote, USD competitive salary, paid time off, and more.

Job Responsibilities

As a Security Engineer, you’ll own security within our Platform team: continuously reducing Trafilea’s attack surface, detecting quickly whatever slips through, and making security scale with our platform and our use of AI, without slowing down product teams. This is a role for someone who thinks like an attacker and builds like an engineer.

If you go looking for holes before an incident forces the issue, turn repeated findings into automated controls, and take full ownership of problems from discovery to fix, this is your opportunity to make an immediate global impact.

  • Build and maintain a live inventory of our public attack surface across all AWS accounts (domains, endpoints, APIs, load balancers, buckets, and admin panels), and coordinate closing whatever shouldn’t be exposed.

  • Review and test web applications and APIs (REST and GraphQL) against the OWASP Top 10 and the OWASP API Security Top 10, and run threat modeling for new services and architectural changes.

  • Integrate low-noise security controls into CI/CD (GitHub Actions): SAST, SCA, secret scanning, IaC analysis, and container image scanning.

  • Strengthen AWS security at the Organization level: IAM, SCPs, Security Hub, GuardDuty, Config, networking, encryption, and secrets management, and harden ECS and EKS workloads.

  • Design and operate our detection layer on Datadog (Cloud SIEM, Cloud Security, App and API Protection), with per-service alert routing through PagerDuty and response runbooks.

  • Participate in the security on-call rotation and lead security incident investigations and postmortems end to end.

  • Review authentication and authorization flows (Cognito, SSO, MFA) and the security posture of critical third-party platforms.

  • Secure our own AI adoption (agents, MCP, prompt injection, data exfiltration through tools) and use AI offensively, in a controlled way, to test our applications before others do.

  • Partner with product teams to remediate findings, bringing concrete proposals, not just reports, and drive a 12-month security roadmap aligned with Platform.

Requirements

  • Senior profile with 5+ years of experience in security engineering, with solid expertise in AppSec and web security: OWASP Top 10, API security (REST and GraphQL), OAuth, OIDC, and JWT. (Mandatory)

  • Deep AWS security knowledge: IAM, Organizations and SCPs, Security Hub, GuardDuty, Config, VPC, KMS, and Secrets Manager. (Mandatory)

  • Experience with SIEM and detection engineering, ideally on Datadog, including writing detection rules.

  • Practical knowledge of Terraform and CI/CD (GitHub Actions) to automate security controls.

  • Proven experience leading security incidents end to end, autonomously.

  • Offensive mindset: recon, pentesting, bug hunting, and thinking like an attacker.

  • Daily, fluent use of AI tools applied to security, with the judgment to validate what they produce.

  • Strong communicator—able to explain risk in terms both engineers and leaders understand, and to align multiple teams to get fixes done.

  • Autonomous and ownership-driven: you build your own plan and move forward without step-by-step direction.

raw.description:
Job Description:

Director of Professional Services

Integrations and Custom Development


Company: MyMediabox Reports to: VP, R&D

Position type: Individual contributor with no direct reports or staff management responsibilities

The Company

MyMediabox provides software for consumer products licensing, including product approvals, digital asset management, and rights, contracts and royalty management. Our products are delivered as multi-tenant Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) solutions serving licensors and their licensee partners worldwide.

Company website: www.mymediabox.com


The Role

The Director of Professional Services – Integrations and Custom Development is responsible for scoping, planning, coordinating and financially managing customer engagements for integrations and custom software development. Integration work connects MyMediabox products with customer systems, including SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics 365, third-party contract management systems and other enterprise applications.

Reporting to the VP, R&D, this role provides business analysis and project management throughout each statement of work (SOW). The Director serves as the primary coordination point between the customer and MyMediabox, turning business needs into deliverables, delivery plans and measurable acceptance criteria. The role coordinates developer and quality assurance (QA) resources with their managers and the VP, R it carries no hiring, performance management or supervisory responsibilities.


Job Responsibilities

  • Lead customer scoping sessions with business, technical and executive stakeholders. Document workflows, requirements, system interfaces, decisions, assumptions and dependencies, and confirm a shared understanding of the expected outcomes.
  • Write SOWs and change orders defining scope, exclusions, individual deliverables, acceptance criteria, customer responsibilities, milestones, fees and payment schedules. Coordinate internal review and customer approval before work begins or scope changes.
  • Break each SOW into actionable work items, specifications and acceptance criteria. Work with developers to estimate delivery hours and costs, and with QA to estimate testing hours and define how accuracy will be verified.
  • Coordinate and schedule developer and QA resources with their managers. Build realistic delivery plans, confirm capacity and dependencies, and escalate scheduling conflicts or resource constraints to the VP, R&D.
  • Provide business analysis throughout delivery, including process documentation, data mapping, business rules, user stories and clarification of requirements. Maintain traceability from agreed requirements to delivered and tested functionality.
  • Manage project schedules, milestones, risks, issues and changes across concurrent SOW engagements. Maintain action and decision logs, resolve obstacles with the appropriate owners, and communicate the impact of proposed changes on hours, cost and timing.
  • Maintain regular customer and internal communication throughout each engagement. Facilitate meetings, distribute written outcomes and action items, and explain progress or delivery issues clearly to technical personnel and executive stakeholders.
  • Track developer, QA and other delivery hours against each deliverable and SOW budget. Report actual hours, remaining effort, completion status and forecast overruns to internal stakeholders and the customer as appropriate to the engagement.
  • ·Forecast and manage the professional services budget for integrations and custom development, including expected revenues, delivery costs, margins and timing. Use approved labor cost rates, update estimates to complete, and coordinate billing inputs with Finance.
  • Prepare weekly management reports for the VP, R&D and other designated stakeholders covering active engagements, milestones, hours and budget variances, revenue and cost forecasts, resource needs, risks and decisions required.
  • Coordinate QA testing and certification of work accuracy, including data reconciliation and integration behavior where applicable. Organize customer user acceptance testing, track defects to resolution, document acceptance and coordinate release and handover with R&D and Support.
  • Work with R&D to ensure proposed changes suit the shared multi-tenant SaaS environment, including tenant data isolation, security, regression testing and maintainability. Improve SOW templates, estimating practices and delivery processes using completed-project results.

Job Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information systems, business or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Demonstrated experience in business analysis and project management for enterprise software or SaaS, including SOW preparation, requirements documentation, estimates, budgets, change control and customer acceptance.
  • Strong knowledge of MyMediabox products and licensing workflows, particularly product approvals and rights, contracts and royalty management, and the ability to apply that knowledge to customer requirements.
  • Technical competency sufficient to discuss APIs, data imports and exports, authentication, data mapping and system dependencies with developers and customer IT teams. Developer-level coding expertise is not required.
  • Ability to forecast services revenue and delivery costs, monitor billable hours and explain project financial performance. Experience coordinating QA, regression testing and user acceptance testing.
  • Clear written and verbal communication, sound judgment and confidence working with customer technical teams and executives. A reputation for honesty, reliability, responsiveness and ease of collaboration.
  • Strong organization and follow-through; ability to coordinate shared resources without direct authority. Experience with tools such as Jira, Confluence, Smartsheet and Excel; Scrum or project management certification is beneficial.

Jonas Software is a leading provider of enterprise management software solutions, serving a wide range of vertical markets including hospitality, healthcare, construction, education, personal care, fitness, leisure, moving and legal services, to name a few. Within these markets, Jonas is comprised of over 65 distinct brands, each a respected leader in its domain.

Jonas’ vision is to be the branded global leader across these verticals and to be recognized by customers and industry stakeholders as the trusted provider of “Software for Life.” We are committed to technology, product innovation, quality, and exceptional customer service.

Jonas Software supports over 60,000 customers in more than 30 countries. We employ over 6,000 skilled professionals, including industry experts and technology specialists. Across our broader network, we support a global workforce of more than 30,000 employees.

Headquartered in Canada, Jonas Software has a global footprint with offices around the world. We’re a 100% owned subsidiary of Constellation Software Inc., based in Toronto, publicly listed on the TSX (CSU.TO), and a member of the S&P/TSX 60 Index.

Das ist dein Job bei uns

Du möchtest die operativen Systeme einer wachsenden Agentur verantworten und Prozesse bauen, die auch ohne dich funktionieren? Operations ist bei EVOLVE der Hebel, der das ganze Team schneller macht. Deine Aufgabe ist es, dafür zu sorgen, dass Ziele, Prozesse und Automationen im Alltag perfekt ineinandergreifen.

Wie dein Arbeitsalltag aussehen kann:

Im wöchentlichen Check-in fällt dir auf, dass drei Quartalsprojekte seit zwei Wochen stillstehen. Du fragst nicht nach dem Status, sondern schaust dir den Prozess dahinter an. Gemeinsam mit dem Teamlead gehst du den Ablauf durch: Die Zahlen liegen verteilt an 3 unterschiedlichen Orten und müssten jeden Montag von Hand zusammengetragen werden. Kein Wunder, dass es nicht passiert.

Du baust den Ablauf neu. Es entsteht ein Workflow mit klaren Verantwortlichen und Fristen, die Zahlen laufen automatisiert in ein Dashboard. Umgesetzt mit unserem Prozess-Team.

Im Reporting an die Geschäftsführung liegt der Zielfortschritt jetzt jede Woche auf dem Tisch. Einen Tag später nimmst du dir schon den nächsten Bottleneck vor. Nicht weil sich jemand beschwert, sondern weil dir ineffiziente Abläufe von selbst auffallen.

Genau das ist der Job.

Wofür wir arbeiten

Wir sind einer der führenden ganzheitlichen Wachstumspartner für E-Commerce-Brands im DACH-Raum.

Denn was wir immer wieder sehen: Agenturen und Dienstleister betreuen Brands nischig und siloartig, Kanal für Kanal, ohne Blick aufs Ganze. Dabei bleiben enorme Potenziale auf der Strecke.

Wir verstehen uns deshalb nicht als Dienstleister, sondern als Teil des Unternehmens unserer Kunden. Dafür arbeiten bei EVOLVE 30 Spezialisten in sechs Fachbereichen zusammen, vollständig remote seit Tag 1. Weekly Recaps, Coffee Chats und Team-Events sorgen dafür, dass Remote bei uns kein Einzelkämpfertum bedeutet.

So funktioniert Operations bei EVOLVE

Nur Prozesse, die nachgehalten werden, haben Wirkung. Diese Rolle lebt deshalb vom Tagesgeschäft und von Details, nicht von reiner Strategiearbeit. Genau darin liegt ihr Hebel.

  • Ziele bis in den Alltag. Jahres- und Quartalsziele werden zu Maßnahmen, Meilensteinen und Check-ins, die wirklich stattfinden

  • Automation statt Handarbeit. Was zweimal manuell passiert, läuft danach über Make, n8n oder Claude

  • KI als Werkzeug im Alltag. AI ersetzt bei uns niemanden. Jeder nutzt KI wie einen Junior an seiner Seite, um besser und effizienter zu arbeiten

  • Das EVOLVE OS hält all das zusammen. Ziele, Prozesse, Automationen und KI sind bei uns kein Flickenteppich, sondern ein System hinter unserer Dienstleistung. Du sorgst dafür, dass es im Alltag funktioniert und laufend besser wird

Was dich hier erwartet

  • Ziele operativ machen: Du übersetzt Jahres- und Quartalsziele in konkrete Maßnahmen, Meilensteine und Checklisten. So bleibt die Strategie im Alltag greifbar

  • Operative Abläufe: Du steuerst die Abläufe innerhalb der Agentur, bei Bedarf zusätzlich in Finance und People Ops, von Rechnungswesen bis Onboarding

  • Automationen: Du führst neue Automationen und Prozesse über Claude, Make und n8n ein. Du setzt selbst um oder mit Unterstützung unseres Teams

  • Datenanalyse: Du entwickelst KPI-Dashboards und Übersichten dort, wo sie gebraucht werden, und betreibst das OKR-System im Alltag mit Check-ins und Remindern

  • Bottlenecks: Zusammen mit den Teamleads gehst du Engpässe im Tagesgeschäft durch und löst sie an der Wurzel, nicht mit einem Pflaster

Deine Rolle und deine Ressourcen: Du arbeitest mit den Teamleads aller sechs Fachbereiche auf Augenhöhe, ohne sie disziplinarisch zu führen. Für die technische Umsetzung von Automationen steht dir unser AI- und Prozess-Team zur Seite. Du entscheidest, was gebaut wird.

Das solltest du mitbringen

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Projektgeschäft oder Prozessmanagement, idealerweise im Agentur- oder E-Commerce-Umfeld

  • Du kennst Projektmanagement-Tools wie ClickUp oder Asana und verstehst Automation-Tools wie Make oder n8n

  • Analytisches und systemisches Denken mit Controlling-Grundlagen. Du siehst nicht nur die Kennzahl, sondern auch, was dahinter steckt

  • Klare, strukturierte Kommunikation nach innen und außen. Du arbeitest mit Teamleads auf Augenhöhe an ihren Prozessen

  • Sicherer Umgang mit Google Tabellen und Excel für Auswertungen und Datenstrukturen

  • Hohe Affinität für AI-Tools wie Claude und ChatGPT. Du nutzt sie, um Systeme zu bauen und Probleme zu lösen, nicht nur um Texte zu erstellen

  • Sehr gute Selbstorganisation, weil wir vollständig remote arbeiten

Der Rahmen

  • Klare Entwicklungsperspektive Richtung Head of Operations

  • 100 % Remote, kein Hybrid-Kompromiss

  • 30 Tage Urlaub

  • Zweimal jährlich Team-Events und Workations, in Person und an wechselnden Orten

  • Wöchentliche Team-Recaps und Coffee Chats, damit Remote nicht heißt, den ganzen Tag allein zu arbeiten

  • Betriebliche Altersvorsorge, Jobrad und Firmenfitness über Wellpass

  • Steuerfreier Sachbezug von 50 € monatlich als Gutschein deiner Wahl

  • Laptop deiner Wahl und hochwertige Homeoffice-Ausstattung

  • Weiterbildungsbudget sowie interne und externe Quellen und Mentoren an deiner Seite

  • Voller Zugriff auf unseren internen AI-Stack

Deine Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten

Die ersten zwei Monate. Du lernst die Abläufe unserer sechs Fachbereiche kennen und übernimmst das Zielsystem im Alltag mit Check-ins, Remindern und Dashboards.

Mittelfristig. Du verantwortest Prozesse und Automationen in deinen Bereichen eigenständig. Dazu kommt die operative Steuerung der Finance- und People-Ops-Abläufe.

Langfristig. Fachlaufbahn mit Schwerpunkt Systeme und Automation oder Führungslaufbahn in Richtung Head of Operations, sobald Zielsystem, Prozesslandschaft und KPI-Landschaft stehen. Beide Wege entstehen durch Ergebnisse und nicht durch Wartezeit.

Deine Ansprechpartnerin

Vanessa, unsere HR Managerin, ist dein erster Kontakt und freut sich auf deine Bewerbung.

00715-26

Mid-Level Federal IT Sales Associate
Location and Travel: Remote, with regular travel to client and project sites. Candidates in or near the Warner Robins, Georgia area may be especially well positioned for the role. Significant travel to Huntsville, Alabama may be required.

Career Opportunity
A joint venture is seeking a motivated Mid-Level Sales Associate with federal or Department of Defense IT sales experience to help turn qualified leads into strong client relationships and successful technology opportunities. This client-facing role is ideal for a sales professional who understands government technology needs, communicates business value clearly, and coordinates technical expertise throughout the sales process.
You will take ownership of qualified leads and introductions, lead discovery conversations, assess opportunity fit, and guide viable pursuits through development, proposal preparation, negotiation support, award, or closure. You will work closely with senior leadership, technical personnel, administrative support, and delivery teams while traveling to client and project sites as needed.

What You'll Do
  • Own qualified opportunities: Review lead handoffs, confirm key contacts and stated needs, and establish the next client conversation promptly.
  • Lead technical discovery: Explore each client’s technology environment, operational challenges, requirements, purchasing process, anticipated budget, and timeline.
  • Coordinate technical expertise: Engage joint venture specialists to validate technical fit, feasibility, and the right solution approach.
  • Qualify the pipeline: Evaluate alignment with verified capabilities, access to decision-makers, requirements, and pursuit potential; recommend whether to advance, nurture, or close each opportunity.
  • Build trusted relationships: Engage IT leaders, program managers, procurement contacts, and other stakeholders; translate technical capabilities into business benefits and secure clear next steps.
  • Contribute to opportunity development and proposals: Help shape pursuit strategies, develop proposal content, coordinate presentations and demonstrations, respond to information requests, and manage reviews and submission deadlines with senior leadership and technical personnel.
  • Manage pipeline data: Maintain accurate CRM stages, estimated values, client requirements, timelines, actions, and forecasts; provide weekly updates and flag stalled pursuits or barriers.
  • Support effective handoffs: Share feedback on lead quality, coordinate scheduling, and document awarded scope, commitments, and client contacts for delivery teams.
  • Support negotiations: Participate in pricing discussions and negotiations within delegated authority, securing required approvals before making pricing, technical, or contractual commitments.

What You Bring

  • Professional IT experience and a practical understanding of IT service delivery and technical terminology.
  • Demonstrated sales experience supporting federal government or Department of Defense IT customers and opportunities.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead discovery, qualify opportunities, and communicate effectively with technical and nontechnical stakeholders.
  • Experience coordinating proposals, maintaining accurate CRM records, and managing follow-up across multiple opportunities.
  • Sound judgment, accountability, and the ability to work collaboratively across sales, technical, administrative, and delivery functions.

Preferred Experience

  • Experience supporting federal or DoD IT proposals, capture activities, or solicitation responses.
  • A relevant degree or equivalent professional experience.
  • Exposure to government IT procurement.
  • Experience coordinating technical teams and transitioning newly awarded business to delivery.
Who Will Thrive in This Role
You are consultative, organized, and comfortable discussing technology with both business and technical audiences. You can balance relationship development with disciplined opportunity management, know when to bring in subject-matter experts, and consistently move conversations toward clear decisions and next steps.

Explore This Opportunity
This opportunity offers the chance to build client relationships, contribute directly to opportunity development and proposals, and advance federal and DoD technology pursuits. If you combine government IT sales experience with consultative selling skills and enjoy coordinating people and resources to solve client challenges, we encourage you to explore this remote, travel-based 1099 opportunity supporting a joint venture.
SIS, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity / Affirmative Action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, or national origin. We are also an equal opportunity employer of individuals with disabilities and protected veterans.
