raw.description:
At 2U, we are all in on purpose. We are motivated by our mission – to eliminate the back row in education – and connected by our shared passion to deliver world-class digital education at scale. As the parent company of edX, the world’s leading online learning platform, 2U powers more than 4,000 online higher education offerings – from free courses to full degrees. Together with more than 230 colleges, universities, and corporate partners, we are helping to unlock human potential.

What We’re Looking For:

The Product Support Specialist – Level 2 is a skilled frontline support professional responsible for delivering high-quality, multi-channel support to learners and instructors across multiple products. This role demonstrates strong independent problem-solving ability, consistent performance against service metrics, and growing influence in improving team workflows and customer experience.

Responsibilities Include, But Are Not Limited To:

Customer Support & Issue Resolution

  • Deliver timely, accurate, and empathetic support across multiple communication channels while resolving moderately complex product issues.
  • Provide support to learners and instructors via phone, chat, and email.
  • Resolve Tier 1 issues related to platform navigation, technical errors, enrollment and course access, and account concerns.
  • Demonstrate strong product fluency across multiple platforms and support tools.
  • Troubleshoot technical and functional issues independently and guide users through solutions.
  • Ensure accurate and thorough documentation of cases in CRM systems (Salesforce, Zendesk, etc.).
  • Maintain high data accuracy and detailed case records.

Critical Thinking & Accountability for Results

  • Demonstrate strong ownership of customer issues and consistent achievement of performance expectations.
  • Analyze patterns and identify root causes for recurring issues.
  • Escalate issues appropriately with clear documentation and context.
  • Consistently meet or exceed SLAs, CSAT, quality, and productivity metrics.
  • Take ownership of cases from intake through resolution.
  • Manage competing priorities while maintaining high service quality.

Process Improvement & Operational Support

  • Contribute to improving workflows, support processes, and documentation.
  • Identify workflow inefficiencies and provide actionable improvement suggestions.
  • Contribute to updates and improvements to knowledge base content and documentation.
  • Support testing, pilots, or workflow updates by providing feedback and operational insights.
  • Share recurring issue trends that may indicate product or process improvements.

Communication & Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work effectively with internal teams to resolve customer issues and improve the overall experience.
  • Translate technical information into clear, learner-friendly language.
  • Partner with internal teams such as Product, Engineering, and Escalations to resolve issues.
  • Communicate updates clearly and professionally to customers and internal stakeholders.
  • Manage sensitive or frustrated customer interactions with professionalism and empathy.

Team Contribution & Professional Development

  • Support team success and continuous learning.
  • Support peer learning by sharing knowledge and best practices.
  • Adapt to new tools, workflows, and product updates.
  • Demonstrate a growth mindset through ongoing skill development.

Things That Should Be In Your Background:

  • 2–4+ years of experience in customer support, technical support, or a related field.
  • Demonstrated success meeting or exceeding support performance metrics.
  • Proficiency with CRM systems such as Salesforce or Zendesk.
  • Strong troubleshooting skills across Apple, Microsoft, and mobile environments.

Other Attributes That Will Help You In This Role:

  • Experience supporting online education or SaaS platforms preferred.

Working Conditions

This role supports a 24/7 global operation and requires schedule and location flexibility under a rotational shift agreement, which may include irregular hours and rotating weekends (no more than one per month) as needed to meet business requirements.

Benefits & Culture

Our global employee base is a diverse collection of innovators, dreamers, and doers working together to transform lives through higher education. We believe that every employee can advance our shared purpose, and that life at 2U should be fun and meaningful. If you’re excited by the opportunity to provide over 40 million learners and counting with access to world-class online higher education, then join us – and do work that makes a difference. #NoBackRow

We offer comprehensive benefits (unique per country) and excellent work/life balance.

Full-time, ZA benefits include:

  • 2 complimentary Getsmarter short courses per year
  • Subsidised medical aid with Discovery Health Medical Scheme
  • 4% 2U contribution towards Discovery Life Pension Fund and Group Risk Benefit
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • Generous leave policy including time off to volunteer for non-profit organization, study leave, sports leave and a company-wide festive season break

2U Diversity and Inclusion Statement

At 2U, we are committed to building and sustaining a culture of belonging, respect, and inclusion. We are proud of the steps we’ve taken to bring together an employee base that embodies diverse walks of life, ideas, genders, ages, races, cultures, sexual orientations, abilities and other unique qualities. We strive to offer a workplace where every employee feels empowered by what makes us different, as well as by how we are alike.

2U is committed to providing reasonable accommodations during our recruitment process. If you need assistance or accommodations, please reach out to us at: .

About 2U, Inc.

For more than a decade, 2U, Inc. has been the digital transformation partner of choice to great non-profit colleges and universities delivering high-quality online education at scale. As the parent company of edX, a leading global online learning platform, 2U provides over 45 million learners with access to world-class education in partnership with more than 230 colleges, universities, and corporations. Our people and technology are powering more than 4,000 digital education offerings — from free courses to full degrees — and helping unlock human potential. To learn more: visit 2U.com.

About edX

edX is the education movement for restless learners and a leading global online learning platform from 2U, Inc. Together with the majority of the world’s top-ranked universities and industry-leading companies, we bring our community of over 45 million learners world-class education to support them at every stage of their lives and careers, from free courses to full degrees. And we're not stopping there — we're relentlessly pursuing our vision of a world where every learner can access education to unlock their potential, without the barriers of cost or location. Learn more at edX.org.

12. Maintain adherence to patient privacy and confidentiality standards at all times.

1. Minimum of High School diploma, GED or equivalent required.

3. MOAB certification obtained within 3 months of hire.

Job Family

Regulatory Compliance

About Us

At Transamerica, hard work, innovative thinking, and personal accountability are qualities we honor and reward. We understand the potential of leveraging the talents of a diverse workforce. We embrace an environment where employees enjoy a balance between their careers, families, communities, and personal interests.

Ultimately, we appreciate the uniqueness of a company where talented professionals work collaboratively in a positive environment — one focused on helping people look forward and plan for the best life possible while providing tools and solutions that make it easier to get there.

   

Who We Are

 

We believe everyone deserves to live their best life. More than a century ago, we were among the first financial services companies in America to serve everyday people from all walks of life.

Today, we’re part of an international holding company, with millions of customers and thousands of employees worldwide. Our insurance, retirement, and investment solutions help people make the most of what’s important to them.

We’re empowered by a vast agent network covering North America, with diversity to match. Together with our nonprofit research institute and foundation, we tune in, step up, and are a force for good — for our customers and the communities where we live, work, and play. United in our purpose, we help people create the financial freedom to live life on their terms.

What We Do

Transamerica is organized into three distinct businesses. These include 1) World Financial Group, including Transamerica Financial Advisors, 2) Protection Solutions and Savings & Investments, comprised of life insurance, annuities, employee benefits, retirement plans, and Transamerica Investment Solutions, and 3) Financial Assets, which includes legacy blocks of long term care, universal life, and variable and fixed annuities. These are supported by Transamerica Corporate, which includes Finance, People and Places, General Counsel, Risk, Internal Audit, Strategy and Development, and Corporate Affairs, which covers Communications, Brand, and Government and Policy Affairs.

Transamerica employs nearly 7,000 people. It’s part of Aegon, an integrated, diversified, international financial services group servingapproximately 23.9 million customersworldwide.* For more information, visit transamerica.com. 

Job Description Summary

As a member of Transamerica Financial Advisors (TFA), conduct processing of cashiering, trading, asset transfers, and other operations functions on the Fidelity National Financial Services platform for brokerage and advisory accounts. Assist financial professionals and staff on use of the Wealthscape platform. Serve as a central source of information and support for TFA financial professionals who directly service the client and address business issues and questions to help with their practice.

Job Description

Responsibilities

  • Support business processing on the Fidelity National Financial Services (NFS) Wealthscape platform
  • Provide guidance and training to financial professionals on platforms/technologies, processes, compliance, best practices, etc.
  • As a member of the Call Center, respond to requests for trading, account maintenance, order entry, platform navigation, cashiering functions, opening and closing accounts, etc.
  • Provide support and guidance for the eMoney and Docupace platforms.
  • Produce reports from Wealthscape and Avaya required for TFA to oversee service and processing metrics, and identify areas for optimization.
  • Partner with NFS Middle Office on account management services.
  • Identify and develop operational impact metrics, including collecting, analyzing, and reporting.
  • Keep up to date on rules and regulations governing firm procedures.
  • Identify and develop operational service improvements.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in finance or business, or equivalent work experience
  • Five years of securities/financial services experience in call center and operations roles
  • Detailed knowledge and expert processing proficiency on the NFS Wealthscape platform
  • Demonstrated experience utilizing Avaya or similar telephony management system
  • Thorough knowledge of securities products, FINRA, SEC, and DOL regulations
  • Ability to analyze complex issues and recommend solutions
  • Excellent written and oral communication and interpersonal skills
  • Attention to detail and ability to prioritize multiple responsibilities
  • Proficiency using MS Office, including advanced Excel skills

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working with eMoney, Docupace, Envestnet, and Salesforce platforms

Working Conditions

  • Remote Environment
  • Occasional Travel <10%
  • Travel for field office visits and conferences

The Salary for this position generally ranges between $62,000 – 72,000 annually. Please note that the salary range is a good faith estimate for this position and actual starting pay is determined by several factors including qualifications, experience, geography, work location designation (in-office, hybrid, remote) and operational needs. Salary may vary above and below the stated amounts, as permitted by applicable law.


Additionally, this position is typically eligible for an Annual Bonus of 7.5% based on the Company Bonus Plan/Individual Performance and is at the Company’s discretion.

raw.description:
Senior Partner, Learning Solutions

OPPORTUNITY

Nationally recognized venture philanthropy seeks a visionary, entrepreneurial Senior Partner to lead its Learning Solutions strategy, combining deep expertise in K–12 education, AI and emerging technologies, and venture investing to identify, fund, and accelerate breakthrough learning solutions that improve student outcomes.

ORGANIZATION

NewSchools is a venture philanthropy that builds a better K-12 education system by connecting people, resources, and ideas. We bridge the gap between those with capital and those with the courage to put that capital to work on the frontlines of education. We envision an education system that keeps its promise to all students. That’s why we invest in the ideas and energy of education leaders and entrepreneurs who are advancing innovative solutions that expand the definition of what works. There’s a better way to advance education through philanthropy—one that is more equitable, more collaborative, and more courageous–and we’re proving it every day.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Reporting to the CEO, the Senior Partner will help shape the next generation of learning solutions. As AI transforms how students learn and educators teach, schools need solutions grounded in strong instructional practice, responsive to students' needs, and backed by credible evidence of impact. Promising innovations are emerging, but too few have demonstrated consistent results or reached the students and schools that could benefit most.

The Senior Partner will lead NewSchools' efforts to close that gap: identifying where innovation is needed most, investing in promising ventures, helping them demonstrate impact earlier, and translating what we learn into actionable insights about what works, for whom, and under what conditions. We seek a leader who combines deep expertise in K–12 education with strong technical fluency in AI and emerging technologies, exceptional strategic judgment, and investment acumen. The ideal candidate can distinguish meaningful technological innovation from incremental improvements, assess the potential and limitations of emerging solutions, and build a team that combines technical expertise with rigorous research, deep venture support, and a commitment to equity. The Senior Partner will bring the entrepreneurial mindset, partnerships, and leadership needed to translate promising innovations into measurable student impact.

This is a remote position open to candidates anywhere in the U.S., with up to 25% travel for team meetings, retreats, and conferences.

Your legacy at NewSchools will include:

Shaping a bold strategy to accelerate student outcomes through math and AI-powered learning solutions

  • Develop and lead a compelling Learning Solutions strategy aligned with NewSchools' 2027–2029 priorities, with an initial emphasis on accelerating K–8 math outcomes and advancing effective, responsible uses of AI in teaching and learning.
  • Build deep market and technical insights across K-12 learning, emerging technologies, and edtech markets to identify unmet needs, evaluate technological advances and anticipate where innovation could meaningfully improve student outcomes. Translate these insights into a focused, proactive strategy that defines the problems worth solving, the solutions needed, and where NewSchools is uniquely positioned to catalyze progress.
  • Engage entrepreneurs, district and school leaders, funders, and other experts to challenge assumptions, inform strategic choices, and position NewSchools at the forefront of emerging opportunities.
  • Establish clear goals, learning questions, and performance measures to assess progress, generate insights, and continually refine the strategy.

Leading the development of a high-impact portfolio of innovative learning solutions

  • Set the direction for a proactive sourcing strategy that identifies promising early-stage entrepreneurs through targeted funding opportunities, design challenges, and strategic partnerships.
  • Oversee rigorous due diligence that assesses ventures' alignment with our charitable purpose, instructional effectiveness, technical capabilities and differentiation, product-market fit, leadership, business models, and potential for adoption and impact. Ensure the team can critically evaluate AI-powered solutions, including their performance, reliability, safety, and potential to deliver meaningful advantages over existing approaches.
  • Lead portfolio construction and investment decisions, making intentional bets across solution types, approaches, and stages of development to advance NewSchools' strategic priorities, maximize impact and mitigate risk.
  • Establish a disciplined approach to reinvestment decisions, making choices about which ventures warrant deeper, longer-term support based on their impact, adoption and strategic fit.
  • Guide the strategic deployment of philanthropic grants and other capital instruments to meet ventures' needs at different stages of development and growth.
  • Ensure strong stewardship of financial resources, balancing thoughtful risk-taking with clear expectations for performance, learning, and measurable results.

Accelerating venture efficacy, adoption, and scale through management assistance and evidence generation

  • Set the vision and oversee execution of a differentiated management assistance strategy that helps ventures strengthen their solutions, generate credible evidence of impact, and achieve greater adoption and scale.
  • Guide and support the team's venture advising and coaching, while maintaining direct relationships with a select group of high-potential ventures to inform strategy and accelerate their impact.
  • Oversee a portfolio of research and implementation pilots that connect promising solutions with schools, including those in the NewSchools portfolio, to test effectiveness, strengthen implementation models, and generate evidence in authentic instructional settings. Partner with NewSchools' Research & Learning team to guide evidence generation across the venture lifecycle, ensuring rigorous study designs that assess what works, for whom, and under what conditions.
  • Build access to technical expertise that helps ventures strengthen AI product development, evaluation, and implementation, including model performance, instructional quality, data infrastructure, and responsible AI practices. Leverage internal talent and external partners to provide targeted support that accelerates product improvement and readiness for adoption.
  • Establish clear goals and performance measures for venture efficacy, implementation quality, adoption, and scale, using portfolio insights to refine support, inform investment decisions, and identify solutions ready for growth.
  • Build strategic partnerships with researchers, school systems, implementation organizations, and/or other experts to strengthen venture capabilities, improve implementation quality, and create pathways to broader adoption.

Influencing the field to mobilize partnerships and capital

  • Position NewSchools as a trusted voice on learning solutions, particularly in math, AI-powered solutions, research, and implementation.
  • Translate portfolio insights into compelling publications, convenings, presentations, and practical guidance that educators, entrepreneurs, funders, and policymakers can use.
  • Build and sustain relationships with influential leaders across K–12 education, research, technology, philanthropy, and the broader innovation ecosystem.
  • Cultivate strategic partnerships that expand the reach and effectiveness of NewSchools' investments, research, and implementation efforts.
  • Partner with the CEO and NewSchools’ philanthropic partnerships team to develop compelling investment theses, demonstrate NewSchools’ differentiated technical and education expertise, and cultivate new funding partnerships that expand our capacity to accelerate high-impact innovation.
  • Represent Learning Solutions in organizational strategy discussions, Board presentations, and external engagements, bringing a clear point of view and compelling evidence to inform decisions.

Leading a high-performing team and delivering ambitious results

  • Build a multidisciplinary team with complementary strengths in AI and emerging technologies, K–12 instruction, venture investing, research, implementation, and portfolio management. Develop internal technical capabilities and cultivate external expertise to ensure NewSchools can evaluate and support increasingly sophisticated AI-powered solutions.
  • Lead, coach, and develop team members, establishing a culture focused on strategic thinking, collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement.
  • Develop clear team priorities, annual goals, resource plans, and execution milestones, ensuring the team consistently delivers high-quality work.
  • Foster strong collaboration across NewSchools' investment areas and shared service functions, particularly where solutions, schools, and educator practices intersect.
  • Set a high bar for performance, provide timely feedback, make difficult decisions when necessary, and create the conditions for team members to grow and succeed.
  • Serve as a member of NewSchools' senior leadership team, contributing to organizational strategy, culture, and overall effectiveness.

SKILLS AND QUALIFICATIONS

We seek an exceptional leader with significant senior-level experience in edtech, AI-powered product development, venture investing, K–12 education or related fields. The ideal candidate combines strong technical and investment judgment with a deep commitment to improving outcomes and brings many of the following capabilities:

  • AI and technical product expertise. Demonstrated experience developing, investing in, evaluating, and/or scaling AI-powered products or technologies. Strong understanding of AI capabilities, limitations, and emerging developments, with the technical judgment to assess product architecture, model performance, differentiation, and responsible implementation. Ability to engage credibly with technical founders and product teams, challenge assumptions, and identify opportunities to strengthen solutions.
  • Deep K–12 instructional and sector expertise. Strong understanding of effective teaching and learning, particularly in math, and the opportunities and challenges of AI-enabled solutions. Ability to assess an innovation's instructional value, not just its technological promise.
  • Strategic vision and market intelligence. Ability to assess complex landscapes, identify unmet needs and emerging opportunities, develop a distinctive point of view, and translate strategy into action.
  • Investment judgment and entrepreneurial mindset. Experience evaluating organizations, products, or innovations; allocating resources under uncertainty; and balancing bold bets with disciplined assessment of performance and potential.
  • Research and evidence fluency. Strong understanding of education research, measurement, and evaluation. Ability to assess study designs, interpret findings, and translate evidence into actionable decisions. Advanced research credentials are welcome but not required.
  • Implementation and scaling expertise. Understanding of what it takes for education solutions to achieve effective adoption and sustainable growth, including instructional integration, educator support, organizational change, and business models.
  • Exceptional leadership and management. Demonstrated success setting direction, developing high-performing teams, managing complex initiatives, exercising sound judgment, and delivering ambitious results.
  • Influence and relationship building. Ability to build trusted partnerships across educators, entrepreneurs, researchers, funders, and institutional leaders, and communicate compelling ideas and recommendations to diverse audiences.
  • Commitment to innovation, equity, and impact. Deep belief in the potential of innovation to improve public education and expand opportunities for students furthest from opportunity.
  • Adaptability and entrepreneurial leadership. Ability to navigate ambiguity, take thoughtful risks, and move fluidly between big-picture strategy and hands-on execution. Brings self-awareness, intellectual curiosity, and openness to feedback and continuous improvement.

COMPENSATION

A competitive compensation package including base salary, performance bonus and employer-funded benefits is available. The starting salary range for this role is $200,000-220,000 with the potential for an annual bonus of up to 10%. Final salary will be determined based on experience level and qualifications.

Applications submitted by December 7th will receive priority review. We encourage interested candidates to apply early, as the position may close once we’ve received a strong pool of applicants.

NewSchools Venture Fund has a strong commitment to diversity. Candidates of all backgrounds are encouraged to apply.

Please note, applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa at this time.

Salary: $200,000-$220,000

Job Title: Client Account Manager, Client Success Department: Client Success FLSA Status: Exempt Job Status: FT Reports To: Manager, Acct Mgrs Small & Mid Positions Supervised: N/A Work Schedule: Monday – Friday, Shift Varies between 8:00 AM – 8:00 PM EST

POSITION SUMMARY

The Client Account Manager (CAM), Client Success, is responsible for owning and managing the day‑to‑day client relationship for a designated book of retirement plan clients. Client books may include PEO MEPs, PEO PEPs, Advisor‑sponsored PEPs, and single‑employer plans, as well as the financial advisors associated with any of these arrangements. Serving as the overall primary point of contact, the CAM is accountable for ensuring clear, consistent, and effective communication between clients, advisors, and Slavic401k. Information flowing into and out of the organization is generally coordinated through the CAM, who is responsible for maintaining alignment, setting expectations, and driving timely resolution of client needs. The CAM delivers high‑quality, execution‑focused service while maintaining a strategic mindset centered on plan health, client satisfaction, and long‑term retention. While the role is predominantly tactical in nature, the CAM is expected to proactively communicate with clients and advisors, identify relationship risks, trends, or service gaps, and recommend or escalate actions as appropriate. In partnership with internal teams, the CAM supports positive client outcomes and a strong overall client experience. Client book size and complexity will vary based on the size, structure, and needs of the plans and advisor relationships supported. Success in this role requires strong ownership, sound judgment, and the ability to balance transactional service delivery with proactive relationship management across a diverse client base. The CAM must be comfortable engaging with a variety of stakeholders and business representatives while independently managing priorities in a fast‑paced, client‑centric environment.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS

Own and manage the day‑to‑day client relationship for a designated book of retirement plan clients, which may include PEO MEPs, PEO PEPs, advisor‑sponsored PEPs, and single‑employer plans. Client book size and complexity will vary based on client needs, plan structure, and market segment. Serve as the overall primary point of contact, coordinating information flow between clients, advisors, and Slavic401k, and ensuring clear, consistent, and timely communication across all interactions. Build and maintain strong client relationships with a focus on client satisfaction, trust, and retention, independently managing client expectations and ensuring a high‑quality service experience. Provide comprehensive administrative and client service support, leveraging a strong working knowledge of Slavic401k systems, tools, and resources for plan tracking, plan management, and service delivery. Maintain current knowledge of industry regulations, plan design considerations, and regulatory updates in order to effectively support clients and communicate relevant impacts to their plans. Act as the end‑to‑end owner and coordinator of client issues and escalations, striving for first‑contact resolution when possible and partnering with internal teams and leadership as needed to drive timely and effective outcomes. Establish and maintain regular client touchpoints based on client needs and complexity, including service, planning, and administrative discussions related to plan changes, amendments, disclosures, and ongoing operational items. Proactively assess relationship health by identifying service gaps, relationship risks, trends, and retention indicators; track and report on relationship health metrics to support informed decision‑making and escalation when appropriate. Recommend proactive engagement, education, and support strategies, including collaboration with Strategic Consultants within the Strategic Services team, to improve plan health, client outcomes, and long‑term retention. Support Strategic Services initiatives by partnering on plan health efforts, engagement strategies, and outcome‑driven activities aligned with client and organizational goals. Develop and deliver customized reporting, client communications, and supporting materials based on client needs and service objectives. Conduct research on plan designs, ERISA requirements, and 401(k) rules to accurately communicate plan nuances, options, and constraints to clients. Facilitate client and prospective client demonstrations of all Slavic401k platforms and portals, as requested. Remain adaptable and responsive in a dynamic regulatory and operational environment, supporting ongoing changes related to compliance, plan enrollment, and plan administration. Contribute to departmental initiatives focused on operational efficiency, process improvement, cost reduction, plan growth, and client retention; may also serve as an owner of small initiatives or process improvements within Client Success. Accurately document client interactions, activities, and outcomes using Salesforce and other internal systems to support visibility, reporting, and continuity of service.

SKILLS & ABILITIES

Strong analytical skills, including the ability to assess trends, risks, and relationship health indicators. Adaptability and keen attention to detail. Superior customer service skills with a focus on long-term client satisfaction and retention. Highly articulate with excellent interpersonal skills. Ability to build internal relationships and communicate effectively across teams and levels of the organization. Ability to work independently and exercise sound judgment in managing client relationships and expectations. Effective organizational skills and ability to handle multiple assignments simultaneously. Ability to prioritize competing tasks in a fast-paced, client-centric environment. Self-motivated, enthusiastic, and takes initiative. Strong written and oral communication skills. Proactive problem-solving skills, including the ability to identify issues, recommend solutions, and coordinate resolution Continuous improvement mindset aligned with organizational goals related to efficiencies, cost reductions, plan health, and client retention. Proficiency using Microsoft Office, especially Excel.

Experience

3-5 years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, Business Development, or another client-facing role. 3+ years 401(k) industry experience 2+ years of Salesforce experience preferred

Education

Bachelor’s degree in Business or related field preferred, or equivalent work experience.

Certificates & Licenses

RPF certification completed within 6 months of hire. Relevant industry credential obtained (such as QKA or QKS) within 18 months of hire New hire 401k compliance course passed within 90-days of hire with 70% or higher

Work Environment

Extended sitting and computer work For all virtual remote positions, in order to ensure associates can effectively perform their job duties with no distractions, we require an uninterrupted virtual workspace. Additionally, there is an internet work speed requirement of 100 MBps or better. If you are unsure of your internet speed, please check with your service provider. Please ensure that you are able to meet these expectations before applying as adequate home work environment and the required internet connection is a non-negotiable requirement of remote employment.

raw.description:
Impact Advisors, LLC is a nationally recognized healthcare management consulting firm delivering Best in KLAS advisory, implementation, and optimization services. We are driven by a commitment to exceed client expectations and are proud to be a trusted partner to many of the nation's leading healthcare organizations. Our mission to drive patient-centered, value-driven outcomes has earned us prestigious industry accolades. To learn more about us, visit

We are seeking an experienced Contact Center Technologist to lead the design, implementation, and optimization of our omnichannel contact center environment within a healthcare setting. This strategic role requires a deep understanding of multi-channel communications including voice, chatbots, SMS, and conversational AI and a passion for integrating cutting-edge technologies to enhance patient engagement and operational efficiency.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and Implement: Lead the architecture and deployment of end-to-end contact center solutions, ensuring seamless omnichannel integrations across voice, messaging, and chatbot platforms.
  • Conversational AI Integration: Incorporate the latest conversational AI and natural language understanding technologies into call flows to deliver improved, automated, and personalized customer interactions.
  • Platform Management: Hands-on management and optimization of contact center platforms such as Amazon Connect, Avaya, Cisco, Genesys, Talkdesk, or other leading solutions.
  • Project Leadership: Collaborate with stakeholders (clinical, administrative, IT) to gather requirements, develop technical specifications, and deliver scalable solutions aligned with healthcare compliance standards (e.g., HIPAA).
  • Technology Evaluation: Stay current on emerging contact center trends, tools, and best practices; evaluate new technologies for implementation.
  • Troubleshooting & Maintenance: Provide technical guidance and support for system issues, integration challenges, and platform upgrades.
  • Documentation & Training: Develop detailed technical documentation and lead training sessions for staff and agents on new or updated contact center solutions.
  • Compliance & Security: Ensure all solutions meet healthcare regulatory requirements, including data privacy and security protocols.

Qualifications & Skills

  • Experience: Minimum of 10 years hands-on experience in contact center design, implementation, and management, preferably within healthcare organizations.
  • Omnichannel Expertise: Proven experience with voice, chatbot, SMS, and emerging communication channels.
  • Platform Proficiency: Strong working knowledge of at least two of the following platforms: Avaya, Cisco Contact Center solutions, Genesys, Talkdesk, Amazon Connect, or equivalent.
  • Conversational AI: Deep understanding of integrating AI-driven chatbots and voice assistants, including tools like Amazon Lex or proprietary AI engines.
  • Technical Skills: IVR development and scripting, API integrations and cloud-based contact center deployment, Scripting languages (e.g., JavaScript, Python) for customization, Data security and HIPAA compliance.
  • Project Management: Ability to lead cross-functional projects and manage multiple priorities.
  • Communication: Strong stakeholder engagement, presentation, and technical documentation skills.
  • Certifications (Preferred): CCXP, CCNA, AWS Solutions Architect, or platform-specific certifications.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, Healthcare Informatics, or a related field (Master’s preferred).

Additional Information: Travel is based on client needs and typically between 25-50% per engagement; however, it can be up to 75%.

For salaried positions, this role may also be eligible for an annual performance bonus. Additional benefits and perks may also be available, depending on the position and employment terms. CX Operations Analyst - Remote - Pakistan

Company Overview:

Hiring for one of our North American based Trasnportation System in Pakistan.

Highlights of the Post

Experience: 3–4+ years in CX / support operations, reporting or systems administration — ideally at a SaaS company

Location: Remote from Pakistan

Time/ Days: Remote, Pakistan — 4-hour daily overlap with North American Eastern hours ( 7:00–11:00 PM PKT)

Job Description:

1. Essentials (Must-Have Requirements)

  • Candidates should have at least 3–4 years of experience in CX Operations, Support Operations, Reporting, or Systems Administration, ideally within a SaaS company.
  • They must have advanced Excel skills along with genuine reporting and analytical capabilities. We will validate their skills through a short practical exercise.
  • Hands-on AI fluency is extremely important, particularly practical and self-driven experience using Claude.
  • Candidates must demonstrate excellent spoken and written English. They should be confident, fluent, and able to communicate directly with clients and colleagues, as the working environment is English-only.
  • A bachelor's degree in Business, Information Systems, or a related field is required.
  • Candidates must also be comfortable with the required working-hour overlap and capable of performing in a fast-paced, high-ownership environment where priorities may sometimes be ambiguous.

2. Candidate's Nature

  • Above everything else, we are looking for genuine high achievers who are growth-oriented, hardworking, and eager to take ownership of responsibilities. They should be willing to move quickly while maintaining quality, even under pressure.
  • The ideal candidate should be a growth-oriented high achiever who is hungry to learn, willing to take on additional responsibilities, and consistently sets high standards for their work.
  • They should be hardworking and resilient, comfortable working in a demanding environment and occasionally putting in longer hours when required.
  • Strong multitasking abilities are essential. Candidates should be capable of managing multiple priorities and quick-turnaround requests without compromising quality or composure.
  • They must thrive in ambiguous situations, demonstrate self-direction, and take ownership of tasks from beginning to end rather than waiting for step-by-step instructions.
  • A systems-minded approach is also important. The candidate should naturally document, standardize, and improve existing processes.
  • We are particularly interested in AI-first operators who proactively use automation and artificial intelligence in their daily work rather than treating these tools as an afterthought.
  • Finally, candidates must be clear and client-ready communicators who can simplify complex information and maintain a calm, positive, trustworthy, and professional approach when handling sensitive data.

3. Must-Have Skills

Experience: Candidates must have 3–4+ years of experience in CX Operations, Support Operations, Reporting, or Systems Administration, preferably within a SaaS environment.

Helpdesk Administration: Candidates should have hands-on experience building triggers, automations, and dashboards within helpdesk tools.

Advanced Excel and Reporting: Strong knowledge of pivot tables, lookups, and nested formulas is required. Candidates should be capable of independently converting messy data exports into clean and accurate reports.

Analytical Ability: Candidates must understand how to define and track operational metrics such as SLA, CSAT, time-to-value, capacity, and utilization. They should also be able to identify trends, inefficiencies, and operational bottlenecks.

Finance Literacy: A solid understanding of basic financial and operational metrics, along with reporting logic, is expected.

AI Fluency (Claude): Candidates must demonstrate practical, hands-on experience using Claude and other AI tools for automation, documentation, and analysis.

English Communication: Excellent written and spoken English is essential. Candidates should be confident communicating directly with North American colleagues and clients.

Judgment and Discretion: Candidates must demonstrate sound judgment when handling confidential customer information, including sensitive student and family data.

Education: A bachelor's degree in Business, Information Systems, or a related field is required.

Working Style: The ideal candidate should be proactive, systems-minded, independent, and comfortable taking ownership of responsibilities.

4. Technical Expertise:

  • Experience with Zendesk and Rocketlane specifically would be a strong advantage compared with experience using other helpdesk or project management tools.
  • Working knowledge of SQL and/or a business intelligence tool such as Power BI is desirable. Candidates should demonstrate technical capability rather than simply knowing how to operate the tools.
  • Familiarity with Salesforce and Jira would also be beneficial.
  • Graduation is Must, Having strong communication skills.
  • Experience with Power Automate, Confluence, and SOP documentation would be an additional advantage.
  • Exposure to other tools such as Dialpad, Fathom, Chatbase, SimpleSat, Workable, Geotab Admin, or ElevenLabs would also be valuable.
  • Previous experience in K-12, EdTech, or working with North American clients would be a strong advantage.

5. Our AI Expectation (Very Important)

  • We are an AI-forward team, and whoever takes this position will use tools like Claude every day to automate reporting, documentation, and analysis.
  • General familiarity with AI tools is not sufficient. We are looking for candidates who already have practical experience using AI in their daily workflows and demonstrate an AI-first mindset.
  • During screening, recruiters should go beyond asking whether candidates have used AI and explore their actual experience.
  • Ask candidates which AI tools they use daily and specifically how they have used Claude.
  • Ask them to explain an automation or workflow they have built using AI, including the problem they were trying to solve, how they developed the solution, and the impact it created.
  • Candidates should also be encouraged to show or describe an actual output they have created using AI, such as a report, script, SOP, or process.
  • Explore how they decide when to use AI versus completing something manually and how they validate AI-generated outputs for accuracy.
  • Finally, ask what they would automate first using Claude if they joined the company and how they would approach that task.

What a strong answer should demonstrate: Candidates should provide specific, self-initiated examples with measurable or clearly explained outcomes rather than vague answers or one-time AI tool usage.

About HR Ways

HR Ways is an award-winning Technical Recruitment Firm helping software houses and IT Product companies internationally and locally to find IT Talent. HR Ways is engaged by 300+ Employers worldwide, ranging from worlds biggest SaaS Companies to the most competitive Startups. We have entities in Dubai, Canada, US, UK, Pakistan, India, Saudi Arabia, Portugal, Brazi,l and other parts of the world. Join our WhatsApp Channel to stay updated or visit to know more

raw.description:
Our Why At Dotmatics

At Dotmatics, a Siemens company, we believe science, data, and decision-making must be deeply intertwined for innovation to thrive. Our Portfolio includes Luma, LumaLab Connect, ELN Platform, Graphpad Prism, Geneious, SnapGene, Protein Metrics, OMIQ, FCS Express, LabArchives, NQuery, EasyPanel, SoftGenetics and Virscidian.

We have a vision for a new Lab of the Future that will change the future of scientific research.

We have created the world’s most comprehensive digital science platform – best-of-breed software applications already used by more than 2 million scientists, together in a single ecosystem united by a powerful, flexible enterprise data platform. This is not flat data buried away in digital graveyards. This is dynamic, multi-dimensional decision-making.

Scientific enterprises need a new level of effectiveness to achieve tomorrow’s breakthroughs. Illness will not wait. The biosphere will not wait. We are tireless in our vision, because the time for innovation is now.

Shaping the Future of Science At Dotmatics

Our global team of more than 800 colleagues are dedicated to supporting our customers in over 180 countries. Together, with our scientific community of users, we accelerate scientific innovation in order to make the world a healthier, cleaner, and safer place to live.

You’ll join a collaborative, global team pushing the boundaries of scientific innovation. Your ideas and efforts will have a tangible impact, accelerating scientific progress and discovery. We offer a dynamic, remote-friendly environment that fosters high integrity and collaboration, empowering you to excel. Dotmatics is a company built by scientists, for scientists. Combined, we are now the world’s largest cloud-based scientific research R&D platform. We need your help to keep growing and pioneering the future.

We are Science Driven. We are Customer Centric. We are Better Together.

What do we need

As a Validation Engineer, you will execute and contribute to validation activities for the Dotmatics Luma platform and its internal systems operating under GxP requirements. As a key contributor to computer system validation (CSV) and computer software assurance (CSA), you will help ensure that software development, testing, and release activities comply with applicable regulations and standards, including 21 CFR Part 11, EU Annex 11, GAMP 5, FDA CSA guidance, ICH Q10, and ISO 9001 as applicable.

You will also take ownership of our in-house validation application. This tool manages requirements, risk assessments, traceability, test evidence, and validation report generation for each Luma release. You will keep it current as our processes, products, and regulatory expectations change. You don't need to be a software developer on day one: we will provide training and mentoring on the tool's codebase and the AI-assisted development tools we use to maintain it.

The Validation Engineer partners closely with Product, Engineering, DevOps, and Quality Management teams to apply validation best practices throughout the software development lifecycle (SDLC), ensuring traceable, audit-ready deliverables that meet customer and regulatory expectations.

In this role you will get to:

  • Author and review validation lifecycle documentation, including Validation Master Plans, URS, FRS, Traceability Matrix, Risk Assessments, and IQ, OQ, and PQ protocols and reports. You will follow GAMP 5 principles, including risk-based approaches to validation, with guidance from senior validation and quality colleagues.
  • Gather, document, and manage product requirements (URS/FRS) with Product and Engineering. You will maintain them in tools such as Jira and Confluence and make sure they are clear, testable, and traceable to test evidence.
  • Work with the software quality team and DevOps to develop, review, and run IQ, OQ, and PQ protocols using automated tools such as Cypress.
  • Own and maintain the internal validation application. This includes:
    • Configuring and updating requirement, risk, traceability, and report templates.
    • Adjusting the tool's workflows and integrations (Jira, Zephyr, Confluence, automated test results) as our processes change.
    • Making changes to the tool under appropriate change control.
  • Make improvements and fixes to the validation tool's codebase (Python/Flask web application) with support from Engineering. You will use AI coding assistants (e.g., Cursor, Claude) to plan, implement, test, and document changes, and you will follow our code review and deployment process (Git, GitHub Actions).
  • Maintain and refine the AI features within the validation tool, such as AI-assisted requirement drafting. This includes reviewing prompt quality and output accuracy, and making sure use stays within company AI governance and data protection policies.
  • Use AI tools (e.g., generative AI assistants) to draft, review, and quality-check validation documentation, test scripts, and traceability, always applying human review and following company AI governance and data protection policies.
  • Apply the GAMP 5 framework to help determine appropriate validation strategies and documentation requirements, including the assurance approach for the validation tool itself.
  • Keep the validation tool's user and technical documentation up to date, and train colleagues on how to use it.
  • Support and share knowledge with junior validation team members and QA staff on validation methodologies and documentation best practices.
  • Serve as a go-to resource within Luma for GAMP 5, 21 CFR Part 11, EU Annex 11, and applicable ISO standards.
  • Provide validation guidance and training to engineers, QA analysts, and project managers on CSV/CSA principles, IQ/OQ/PQ expectations, and 21 CFR Part 11 controls.

We are looking for people who can support customer-facing validation activities, coordinate validation testing and defect resolution, assist with CAPA investigations and audit responses, and collaborate with the Quality Management team to maintain document control, periodic reviews, and overall audit readiness for validation artefacts.

The key skills we are looking for:

  • Solid working knowledge of GAMP 5, 21 CFR Part 11, EU Annex 11, and GxP requirements as they apply to software systems.
  • Approximately 5 years' experience in computer system validation, software quality assurance, or a related role, ideally within a GxP-regulated environment.
  • Familiarity with ISO 9001 quality management system principles.
  • Demonstrated experience authoring and executing IQ/OQ/PQ protocols, traceability matrices, and validation summary reports, including using automated testing tools (e.g., Cypress, Playwright) to generate and capture test evidence.
  • Understanding of the software development lifecycle (SDLC) and Agile methodologies.
  • Hands-on experience using AI tools (e.g., generative AI assistants) to improve productivity in documentation, test design, or analysis. You should understand responsible use, data confidentiality, and the need for human review of AI outputs.
  • Product management skills to support requirements management, including eliciting and writing clear, testable requirements and user stories, refining and prioritizing backlogs, and working with stakeholders in Jira, Confluence, or similar tools.
  • Experience validating cloud-based systems, SaaS applications, or commercial off-the-shelf (COTS) software.
  • A technical mindset and a willingness to learn to maintain and extend a software tool. You should be comfortable picking up new technical skills with training. Some exposure to scripting or programming (e.g., Python, SQL) is helpful but not required.

You may also have:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Biology, Chemistry, Engineering, or a related field (preferred but not required).
  • Background in regulated life sciences environments, such as pharmaceutical, biotech, or medical device industries.
  • Experience with Python, web applications (e.g., Flask), Git/GitHub, or CI/CD pipelines.
  • Experience using AI coding assistants (e.g., Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Claude Code) to build or modify software.
  • Familiarity with Gherkin/BDD test specifications, Zephyr, or the Jira/Confluence APIs.
  • Exposure to Databricks, AWS, or other cloud platforms.
  • Experience qualifying or validating in-house tools used in a regulated quality system.

Research shows us the confidence gap and imposter syndrome can get in the way of meeting outstanding candidates, so please don’t hesitate to apply — we’d love to hear from you.

By submitting your application, you agree that Dotmatics may collect your personal data for recruiting, global organization planning, and related purposes. Dotmatics Privacy Notice explains what personal information we may process, where we may process your personal information, our purposes for processing your personal information, and the rights you can exercise over Dotmatics use of your personal information.

Dotmatics is an equal opportunity employer. We are a welcoming place for everyone, and we do our best to make sure all people feel supported and connected at work.

Modern Recovery Services is a virtual intensive outpatient program for individuals working through mental health and substance use challenges. The Primary Therapists’ role is to support others in recovery from a substance use disorder and/or co-occurring disorders. The Primary Therapist will serve as a role model, mentor, advocate, and motivator to recovering individuals to help prevent relapse and promote long-term recovery. The Primary Therapist works in collaboration with the Clinical Director and Group Facilitator to meet the clients’ needs in accordance with their treatment plan, by providing Individual sessions to clients in need of these services.

Job Duties:

  • Provide recovery education to clients for every phase of the recovery journey from pre-recovery engagement, recovery initiation, recovery stabilization, and sustained recovery maintenance.
  • Assist recovering persons to identify their personal interests, goals, strengths, and weaknesses regarding recovery.
  • Assist/coach recovering persons develop their own plan for advancing their recovery.
  • Facilitate the transition from professional services to community-based services.
  • Promote self-advocacy by assisting recovering persons to have their voices fully heard; their needs, goals and objectives established as the focal point of rehabilitation and clinical services.
  • Actively identify and support linkages to community resources (communities of recovery, educational, vocational, social, cultural, spiritual resources, mutual self- help groups, professional services, etc.) that support the recovering person’s goals and interests.
  • Provide hope and encouragement for opportunities at varying levels of involvement in community-based activities (e.g., work, school, relationships, physical activity, self-directed hobbies, etc.).
  • Develop relationships with community groups/agencies in partnership with others in the agency.
  • Identify barriers (internal and external) to full participation in community resources and develop strategies to overcome those barriers.
  • Ability to provide services via video conferencing/teletherapy when determined appropriate for clients and the organization. Teletherapy may include evaluation, assessment, consultation, treatment planning, case management, coaching, individual therapy, couple/family therapy, and group therapy. Telehealth will occur primarily through interactive audio, video, telephone and/or other audio/video communications.

  • Master’s degree in Psychology from an accredited college or university

The Cardiac Technician plays a vital role in delivering high-quality ambulatory cardiac monitoring services by reviewing, analyzing, and processing cardiac studies with accuracy and attention to detail. This position is responsible for identifying and documenting cardiac rhythms, arrhythmias, and clinically significant events, preparing preliminary reports for physician interpretation, and escalating urgent findings in accordance with established clinical protocols. Cardiac Technicians provide patient support by assisting with monitor use, troubleshooting device issues, and ensuring successful study completion while maintaining excellent customer service. Working in a fast-paced, collaborative environment, they adhere to quality standards, departmental procedures, and regulatory requirements while effectively managing multiple priorities. The ideal candidate possesses strong ECG interpretation skills, critical thinking abilities, exceptional attention to detail, and a commitment to delivering safe, efficient, and patient-centered care. Cardiac Monitor Technicians perform patient monitoring duties in the telemetry areas and is responsible for informing physicians of any arrhythmias or changes in patient's rate or rhythm.

What You'll Do

• Review patient's ECG data and related algorithm findings for clinical accuracy and completeness
• Effectively communicate ECG abnormalities by notifying physicians as required according to physician notification protocol
• Perform 100% of the quality assurance behind the final report delivered to the physician, and provide report format modifications and additions as requested
• Maintain compliance with job specific proficiency requirements, including CCT certification
• Answers calls for assistance from patients and inquiries concerning patients from physicians
• Continuously develop clinical knowledge, particularly ECG rhythm interpretation skills
• Communicate with internal and external customers

What You Bring
This individual must possess the following knowledge, skills and abilities and be able to explain and demonstrate that he or she can perform the essential functions of the job, with or without reasonable accommodation, using some other combination of knowledge, skills, and abilities:

• Proficient in MS Internet Explorer, Excel and various MS office programs
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills

• Excellent phone manner

• Strong leadership skills

  • Organizational skills, detail oriented and ability to multi-task.
    • Excellent organizational skills
    • Awareness of internal and external customer needs

    QUALIFICATION STANDARDS:

    An associate degree (AA) or two years college course work preferred
    Certified Cardiographic Technician (CCT) required

    What Sets You Apart

A minimum of 3-5+ years of experience as a telemetry/monitor technician or equivalent combination of education and experience.


Why Join Resmed

We are shaping the future at ResMed, and we recognize the need to build on and broaden our existing skills and continue to attract and retain the world’s best talent. We work hard to offer holistic benefits packages, provide flexible work arrangements, cultivate a workforce culture that allows employees to grow personally and professionally, and deliver competitive salaries to our team members. Employees scheduled to work 30 or more hours per week are eligible for benefits. This position qualifies for the following benefits package:  comprehensive medical, vision, dental, and life, AD&D, short-term and long-term disability insurance, sleep care management, Health Savings Account (HSA), Flexible Spending Account (FSA), commuter benefits, 401(k), Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP), Employee Assistance Program (EAP), and tuition assistance. Employees accrue three weeks Paid Time Off (PTO) in their first year of employment, receive 11 paid holidays plus 3 floating days and are eligible for 14 weeks of primary caregiver or two weeks of secondary caregiver leave when welcoming new family members.

Individual pay decisions are based on a variety of factors, such as the candidate’s geographic work location, relevant qualifications, work experience, and skills.

At ResMed, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. raw.description:
In a nutshell

Title:Enterprise Account Executive, Health Systems (New Logo)
Location:Remote, U.S. (Eastern Time Zone preferred)
Type:Full-time
Compensation: $250,000-$300,000 OTE (uncapped commission)
Reporting to:Vice President of Sales
Travel:Up to 40%, including overnight stays

The Opportunity

Oxford Medical Simulation (OMS) uses AI-driven VR simulation to turn workforce development into measurable clinical performance. Health systems use OMS to improve quality of care, patient safety, and patient experience by closing the gap between how clinicians are trained and how they perform at the bedside. Our customers have seen measurable reductions in sepsis and medication errors while cutting training time and cost.

We are hiring an Enterprise Account Executive to win new health system logos. This role sells across the hospital organization, from department leaders to the C-suite. You will use each hospital win to bring other hospitals in the same system on board, building toward a system-wide agreement. Our account management team grows usage within each signed hospital.

You will inherit a pipeline to work from, along with a steady flow of inbound interest. This is primarily a pipeline-building role, and most of your success will come from opportunities you create yourself.

What You Will Own

  • New business quota

  • Pipeline progression and creation:work an existing pipeline, convert inbound interest, and maintain 3x coverage through your own prospecting, events, and BDR support

  • Value-based sales execution: run deals from first meeting to signature across clinical, operational, financial, IT/InfoSec, legal, and procurement stakeholders

  • System expansion:use each hospital win and its results to bring other hospitals in the system on board, building toward a system-wide agreement

  • Forecast accuracy:maintain disciplined CRM hygiene and forecasting in HubSpot

What You Will Be Doing

  • Prospect actively. Pick up the phone, work your network, and open doors at target accounts. Inbound is a starting point, not the whole job.

  • Manage your territory like a business. Prioritize accounts by readiness and focus your time where deals can move.

  • Run discovery that gets past what a customer is asking for to what they actually need: the clinical, operational, and financial problem behind the request.

  • Connect workforce performance to the outcomes hospital leaders are measured on, including quality of care, patient safety, patient experience (HCAHPS), nurse-sensitive indicators, retention, and cost.

  • Multi-thread across each account, from simulation and education leaders to department directors, CNOs, CMOs, CFOs, and CEOs.

  • Reach the executives who own the budget. Build ROI models that hold up to CFO review and clinical cases that hold up to CNO and CMO review.

  • Sell into a category where the buyer may not have an existing budget line, and help them build one.

  • Use a signed hospital’s results to open conversations with sister hospitals and system leadership, and build the case for a system-wide agreement.

  • Build mutual action plans, define decision criteria, and drive deals to signature.

  • Navigate enterprise procurement, including contracting, security and compliance review, and implementation requirements.

  • Bring in internal resources (clinical experts, solutions, leadership) as needed while owning the commercial plan and the close.

  • Represent OMS at customer meetings and industry events, and partner with BDR and Marketing on account targeting and messaging.

What Success Looks Like (First 6-12 Months)

  • Convert priority opportunities in the existing pipeline into signed agreements

  • Build new pipeline through outbound prospecting, not inbound alone

  • Turn early hospital wins into active conversations with other hospitals in the same system

  • Forecast with consistency and accuracy using agreed sales stages and methodology

Who You Are

  • Enterprise sales:7-10+ years of quota-carrying, full-cycle, new logo enterprise sales experience

  • Health system selling:recent, hands-on experience selling into U.S. health systems, IDNs, and hospitals

  • Executive access:a track record of selling to the C-suite and securing executive budget, while also working department-level buyers

  • Healthcare fluency:comfortable discussing margin pressure with a CFO, clinical outcomes with a CNO or CMO, and security and integration with a CIO

  • Value-driven:you sell outcomes, not features, and can explain how a solution affects quality, safety, and patient experience in terms a CNO or CFO cares about

  • Curious: you ask the next question and want to understand the customer’s pain before you talk about a solution

  • Self-starter: you work inbound leads well and are just as comfortable building your own pipeline from a cold start

  • System selling:proven ability to turn a single-hospital win into a multi-hospital or system-wide agreement

  • Enterprise deal execution:closed complex six-figure+ agreements through IT/InfoSec, legal, and procurement review

  • Commercial rigor:strong forecasting discipline and CRM hygiene

What Will Make You Stand Out

  • Experience selling solutions tied to quality, patient safety, patient experience, or clinical performance improvement

  • Experience selling workforce development, clinical education, simulation, or competency assessment solutions

  • Experience selling into a new category where the buyer had no existing budget line

  • Established relationships with nursing and clinical executives (CNOs, CNEs, CMOs) at U.S. health systems

  • Familiarity with HCAHPS, nurse-sensitive indicators, Magnet, or similar quality frameworks

  • Experience at an early-stage or high-growth company

  • Training in MEDDPICC, Challenger, Command of the Message, or a comparable methodology

About Oxford Medical Simulation

OMS helps health systems, nursing schools, and medical schools deliver training and assessment better, cheaper, faster and at scale.

Our award-winning simulation platform is transforming the way healthcare and educational institutions train, assess, and recruit healthcare professionals. By combining cutting-edge 3D visualization with artificial intelligence and leading educational theory, OMS delivers all of the benefits of physical simulation while driving significant savings and improving patient care.

Founded in 2017 and commercially launching the award-winning OMS Platform in late 2018, OMS has experienced rapid growth with deployments spanning more than 100 Healthcare and Academic institutions around the world including Mayo Clinic, Advent Health, Johns Hopkins, the NHS, and the world’s #1 pediatric hospital.

Oxford Medical Simulation is committed to equal treatment and opportunity in all aspects of recruitment, selection, and employment without regard to gender, race, religion, national origin, ethnicity, disability, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other category protected under the law. Oxford Medical Simulation is an equal opportunity employer committed to a community of inclusion and an environment free from discrimination, harassment, and retaliation.

Who we are

We are Skiers / Boarders, Runners, Rowers, Pilots, Magicians, Weavers, Photographers, Game Heroes, Movie Buffs, and every other variety of people. We are hard working. We are passionate about what we do. We care about the work. We care about each other. We care about pushing the envelope and we care about using our working lives to make the world a better place.

We value these behaviors above all:

  1. Care & Pride - we take care and pride in everything we do

  2. Growth mindset - we push the boundaries so we are adaptive, inventive and always learning

  3. One Team - we are in it together, mucking in and supporting each other with humour and humility

Sound like you?

Benefits

  • 38 days paid time off

  • Uncapped commission

  • Medical, Vision and Dental Insurance

  • High specification laptop and VR headset

  • Flexible work environment - work from home/ remote first

  • $600 one-off office set up allowance

  • 401k

  • Knowing that you are making a real difference!

raw.description:
About the Role

We are seeking a strategic and commercially minded Product Director to lead the evolution of our audience, media, and advertising platform capabilities. This leader will define and deliver product strategy across audience solutions, programmatic advertising, and the integration of owned media into a unified commercial experience.

The role will turn audience insights, media assets, and performance data into differentiated products that are easy to sell, plan, activate, measure, and optimize. It is an opportunity to shape a foundational growth platform at the intersection of product, data, advertising technology, and commercial transformation.

What You Will Own

Audience Strategy & Product Development

Define and execute the vision, product strategy, and roadmap for audience capabilities.

Build differentiated products using first-party, behavioral, contextual, geographic, and advertiser-permissioned data.

Create packaging, activation, pricing, measurement, and reporting frameworks.

Advance segmentation, enrichment, identity, insights, and responsible data use.

Owned Media Integration & Unified Workflows

Integrate owned media inventory and audience signals into planning, selling, delivery, and reporting workflows.

Define the target experience across planning, order management, inventory, campaign delivery, optimization, and measurement.

Connect advertising, commercial, data, and reporting capabilities through clear platform boundaries.

Simplify fragmented workflows and reduce manual handoffs.

Programmatic Monetization

Own the strategy for direct and automated media offerings across multiple buying models.

Improve yield and inventory utilization while protecting customer value and premium experiences.

Advance forecasting, pricing, packaging, decisioning, and campaign optimization.

Use performance data and market insights to prioritize investment and validate product-market fit.

Commercialization & Leadership

Build business cases, launch plans, adoption strategies, and success measures.

Lead across Sales, Client Success, Marketing, Data, Engineering, Operations, Finance, Legal, and Privacy.

Guide roadmap, investment, dependency, and trade-off decisions with senior stakeholders.

Develop product talent and influence matrixed teams across the organization.

Required Qualifications

10+ years of product management experience in digital advertising, advertising technology, media platforms, data products, or related fields.

5+ years leading complex platform products, major integrations, or multi-team transformation initiatives.

Strong understanding of programmatic advertising, digital media monetization, audience products, campaign workflows, and advertising operations.

Experience translating customer and commercial problems into platform strategy, roadmaps, product requirements, and measurable outcomes.

Strong analytical and commercial judgment, executive communication, and cross-functional leadership skills.

Technical & Domain Expertise

Deep working knowledge of Google Ad Manager or a comparable enterprise ad server, including orders, line items, targeting, pacing, creative trafficking, and reporting integrations.

Experience with advertising order-to-cash ecosystems, including booking, pricing, fulfillment, billing, and revenue-recognition processes to connect with ad-serving and reporting platforms.

Understanding modern cloud data platforms and warehouses, such as BigQuery, Snowflake, Redshift, or Databricks, including audience tables, identity graphs, data marts, and scalable reporting layers.

Expertise in audience and identity architecture, including first-party identity resolution, consumer graphs, segment taxonomies, known and anonymous audiences, and deterministic and probabilistic matching.

Experience defining API and integration patterns, including REST or GraphQL, event-driven contracts, system-of-record boundaries, and data synchronization across commercial, advertising, and reporting systems.

Strong understanding of media monetization and yield concepts, including CPM pricing, rate cards, floor strategies, margin structures, premium and remnant inventory, and cross-channel revenue attribution.

Knowledge of cross-channel audience activation from owned environments into social, video, and demand-side advertising platforms.

Knowledge of data-modeling and SQL, including dimensional models for campaign, impression, audience, and revenue data; sold-versus-delivered reconciliation; complex joins; window functions; and performance optimization on large datasets.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience launching audience-based solutions and enabling commercial teams to bring new capabilities to the market.

Experience integrating advertising, customer-management, order-management, reporting, or revenue platforms.

Familiarity with AI-assisted media planning, campaign optimization, and decision-support products.

Experience integrating customer relationship management and commercial workflow platforms, including campaign planning, quote-to-cash, and opportunity-to-order processes in a media sales environment. Experience with Salesforce or an equivalent platform is beneficial.

Experience with business intelligence and reporting platforms that surface campaign, audience, and revenue insights to commercial teams and customers. Familiarity with tools such as Looker, Tableau, or comparable reporting solutions is beneficial.

Understanding of creative fulfillment workflows, including how creative assets are requested, produced, approved, and routed into advertising delivery systems. Experience with commercial creative workflow platforms is beneficial.

Working knowledge of Python or a similar language for prototyping, data validation, analysis, and workflow automation.

MBA or equivalent experience leading product strategy and commercial transformation.

The annualized base salary for this role will range between $160000 and $180000. Variable incentive compensation, including commissions, is not reflected in these figures and based on the role, may be applicable. Exact compensation may vary based on skills, experience, education level, location, and union representation, if applicable
