raw.description:
*This is an individual contributor role, and we have a preference for West Coast-based candidates to support Asia-Pacific clients.

About this role:

Gartner analysts are industry thought leaders who create must-have research, market predictions and best practices for a broad range of world-leading organizations. Senior directors serve as leaders within Gartner’s Business and Technology Insights (BTI) group, establishing themselves as a credible voice within their area(s) of expertise across industries at regional and global levels. Using exceptional research and analytical skills, senior directors play a significant role in producing pragmatic and provocative insights that Gartner clients consume and apply to support their key objectives. They are a trusted source of advice for clients, reinforcing Gartner’s value every day by engaging them via virtual and in-person interactions, sales support visits and Gartner conferences to discuss complex client challenges and offer appropriate recommendations. As more seasoned members of the analyst team, senior directors also play a role in supporting junior analyst development and leading research discussions and collaboration.

This role is an opportunity to join Gartner’s growing Human Resources Practice. A team of experts within this group is dedicated to tracking the leading edge of HR technology innovation — notably the impact of AI and other HR technologies on HR, and the effective use of data to unlock new opportunities for HR organizations. This group advises Chief Human Resources Officers (CHROs) and other HR functional leaders on HR tech strategies, initiatives and investments. Senior directors are expected to offer flexibility in what they can cover and how they channel their expertise. This role will be expected to support 6-8 hours of engagement per month at minimum with Asia-Pacific-based clients.

What you’ll do:

  • Create innovative, thought-provoking and highly leveraged research, offering compelling, objective and actionable advice for Gartner clients in multiple formats (i.e., writing, video, infographics, podcasts) on topics including (but not limited to) data governance and management across a range of HR use cases, technologies and geographies; HR technology road mapping; and AI’s transformative impact on the HR function, technologies and how work gets done, from the frontline to back office.

  • Develop new insights and ideas through thought leadership and offer compelling, actionable approaches to clients’ needs and requests that accelerate their ability to act strategically and proactively.

  • Create in-depth analysis that identifies the root causes of clients’ barriers or overall needs and reframes their thinking to drive their business forward.

  • Demonstrate thought leadership by developing provocative, independent insights that can evolve our research agenda.

  • Track and work closely with vendors, emerging technologies and practices to remain ahead of the curve within the AI- and data-driven HR technology space; use these sources to research, analyze and predict market trends and shifts in actionable content deliverables.

  • Provide individualized advice rooted in quantitative and qualitative data and specific to a client role to CHROs, HR functional leaders and HR technology leaders through video-based presentations and discussions.

  • Create and deliver high-value presentation materials on- and off-stage for Gartner events, industry and professional association conferences, and client briefings.

  • Provide sales support by serving as voice of the market to help BTI teams create content and drive engagement with clients to make progress against their critical priorities and grow their business.

  • Provide high-quality and timely content peer review.

  • Build credibility as an industry expert to represent Gartner insights, methodology and strategy.

  • Actively participate in innovation, ideation and research discussions and collaborate effectively with peers in the BTI community.

  • Identify research process improvements and/or develop new processes that help the team and BTI provide excellent service delivery.

  • Serve as a mentor and coach by supporting more junior team members.

What you’ll need:

  • Bachelors degree and 12 + years of relevant experience in HR technology and/or operations leadership roles, with recent ownership of data governance, or an equivalent combination of education and experience, including the following subject matter expertise:

    • Demonstrated experience implementing and managing HCM and other core HR technology in enterprise organizations to transform HR processes and workflows.

    • Background in global data governance and management, including working with legal, privacy and compliance teams to institute strict ethical guidelines, bias mitigation protocols and data privacy standards for AI tool and HR technology usage.

    • Knowledge of physical AI applications and their implications for the workforce in manufacturing and/or field service environments.

    • Profound understanding of the challenges CHROs face as leaders both within the HR function and across the enterprise, plus familiarity with CHRO workflows and priorities.

    • Deep first-hand knowledge of the HR technology landscape, particularly with respect to HCM suites, including market dynamics, vendors, products and emerging use cases, as well as AI’s transformative impact on vendors within this market.

    • Track record of successfully collaborating with IT, senior leaders and cross-functional teams to improve data literacy and build a “data-ready” culture.

  • Strong executive presence and ability to establish credibility with senior-level audiences.

  • Strong organizational and time management skills, including an ability to work under tight deadlines and produce high-quality deliverables.

  • Strong written and verbal proficiency, analytical and presentation skills; ability to engage clients and respond effectively to questions.

  • Proficiency in analyzing and synthesizing data, including the ability to effectively apply patterns and frameworks while drawing and defending conclusions to client challenges.

  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively as part of a global team.

  • Ability to take peer feedback and provide constructive feedback to others.

  • Comfort level with presenting at large and small-scale speaking engagements.

  • Strong business and financial acumen.

  • Ability to represent Gartner's research methodology and strategies effectively at all levels.

  • Agility with navigating and learning in highly matrixed environments.

  • Preference for West Coast-based candidates to support Asia-Pacific clients.

  • Willingness and ability to travel up to 25%, regionally and globally (where applicable).

Who are we?

At Gartner, Inc. (NYSE:IT), we guide the leaders who shape the world.

Our mission relies on expert analysis and bold ideas to deliver actionable, objective business and technology insights, helping enterprise leaders and their teams succeed with their mission-critical priorities.

Since our founding in 1979, we’ve grown to 20,000 associates globally who support over 13,000 client enterprises in ~90 countries and territories. We do important, interesting and substantive work that matters. That’s why we hire associates with the intellectual curiosity, energy and drive to want to make a difference. The bar is unapologetically high. So is the impact you can have here.

What makes Gartner a great place to work?

Our vast, virtually untapped market potential offers limitless opportunities – opportunities that may not even exist right now – for you to grow professionally and flourish personally. How far you go is driven by your passion and performance.

We hire remarkable people who collaborate and win as a team. Together, our singular, unifying goal is to deliver results for our clients.

Our teams are inclusive and composed of individuals from different geographies, cultures, religions, ethnicities, races, genders, sexual orientations, abilities and generations.

We invest in great leaders who bring out the best in you and the company, enabling us to multiply our impact and results. This is why, year after year, we are recognized worldwide as a great place to work.

Gartner is the world authority on AI

At Gartner, you’ll join a company at the very center of the AI revolution. Gartner has proactive, objective guidance throughout clients’ AI journeys. We set the standard for how organizations leverage artificial intelligence to drive meaningful impact. You’ll have access to unmatched resources, expertise, and technology, and play a key role in helping Gartner and our clients innovate and grow as we leverage AI to transform business and technology landscapes.

It’s an exciting time to be at Gartner, with limitless opportunities to make a real impact, grow your skills, and build a lasting, meaningful career in a field that’s reshaping the way we operate. If you’re passionate about AI and want to be part of a team that’s guiding the leaders who shape the world, Gartner is the place for you.

What do we offer?

Gartner offers world-class benefits, highly competitive compensation and disproportionate rewards for top performers.

In our hybrid work environment, we provide the flexibility and support for you to thrive — working virtually when it's productive to do so and getting together with colleagues in a vibrant community that is purposeful, engaging and inspiring.

Ready to grow your career with Gartner? Join us.

raw.description:
Technology

Our Technology Practice partners with organizations to design, build, and scale innovative digital solutions that drive measurable business impact. We bring together product strategists, engineers, architects, data experts, and transformation leaders to solve complex challenges across cloud, data, AI, cybersecurity, enterprise platforms, and modern application development. We don't just implement technology, we translate business strategy into scalable, secure, and future-ready solutions. Our teams work at the intersection of innovation and execution, helping clients modernize legacy systems, accelerate digital transformation, and unlock the full value of emerging technologies. We foster a collaborative, growth-oriented environment where technologists are empowered to solve meaningful problems, continuously learn, and deliver high-impact outcomes.

What We're Looking For:

We're looking for a Manager, Platform Engineering & Reliability Engineering to own the cloud platform foundation and the site reliability engineering (SRE) practices that let our product and engineering teams build, deploy, and operate services reliably. This person will design and run the landing zones, cloud networking, policy-as-code guardrails, billing constructs, and Internal Developer Platform (IDP) that give teams secure, self-service environments to build in, while building the observability and reliability disciplines that keep those services healthy and prevent incidents before they happen. They'll partner closely with our core infrastructure team, who own the underlying physical network and identity substrate the platform runs on, and will lead and grow a team of platform and SRE engineers.

What You’ll Do:

  • Architect and own our cloud platform foundation — landing zones, management group and subscription hierarchies, cloud networking (hub-spoke or Virtual WAN topologies, private endpoints, firewalls), and account/billing constructs that give teams secure, cost-visible environments to build in.
  • Enforce guardrails and policy as code — implementing Azure Policy (or comparable), management group governance, security baselines, and automated compliance checks so teams can move fast within safe boundaries.
  • Build and operate our Internal Developer Platform (IDP) — self-service provisioning portals, golden-path templates, CI/CD pipelines, and paved-road tooling that let engineering teams stand up environments without filing tickets.
  • Own platform and reliability outcomes — defining and managing service level indicators (SLIs), service level objectives (SLOs), and error budgets, and driving observability maturity across our cloud and hosted platforms.
  • Lead incident response and operational discipline — incident classification, escalation procedures, blameless postmortems, runbooks, and change management.
  • Partner across teams — working closely with our core infrastructure team to align cloud networking and platform security with the underlying infrastructure, and with product teams to remove delivery blockers.
  • Build and mentor your team — hiring and developing SRE and platform engineers and defining clear career paths.

What You Need to Succeed:

Required:

  • 8+ years of experience in platform engineering, site reliability engineering, or cloud engineering.
  • 3+ years in a team leadership role, or as a senior individual contributor with mentorship experience.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or equivalent technical leadership experience.
  • Hands-on experience running production Azure environments at scale — compute, networking fundamentals, identity (Entra ID / hybrid identity), and observability tooling such as Prometheus or Grafana.
  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, Bicep, or comparable), CI/CD pipeline design, and self-service developer platforms.
  • Practical experience defining and operating SLIs, SLOs, and error budgets, and leading incident response and postmortem processes.
  • Strong communication skills, with experience translating technical trade-offs for non-technical stakeholders and executive leadership.

Preferred:

  • Experience running SRE teams or establishing SRE practices within an infrastructure or platform engineering organization.
  • Experience managing through organizational change, including reorganizations or operating model shifts.
  • Familiarity with core infrastructure domains (networking, identity, on-premises compute).
  • Experience with AWS infrastructure.
  • Familiarity with NIST 800-53, CIS Benchmarks, or CMMC/DFARS requirements as applied to platform or reliability engineering.

Compensation:

The approximate compensation range for this position is $124,454 – $194,383. This compensation range is a good faith estimate for the position at the time of posting. Actual compensation will be dependent upon factors including, but not limited to, relevant experience, qualifications, education, skill set, and geographic location.

Why Choose Us:

  • Medical, dental, vision insurance
  • 401(k) Retirement Plan
  • Health Savings Account (HSA)
  • Flexible Spending Account (FSA)
  • Life, AD&D, short-term, and long-term disability
  • Professional and personal development
  • Generous paid time off
  • Commuter and wellness benefits
  • Tuition reimbursement

raw.description:
XTB is a global company from the financial industry, focusing on online trading of financial instruments. We are the largest FinTech in Poland and a leader in Central and Eastern Europe, and the range of our operations covers several countries, including Asia and South America. At XTB, we focus on the development of our employees, giving them opportunities to gain knowledge and skills in various fields, as well as offering a number of training and development programs. If you are looking for challenges and want to gain valuable experience in an international business environment, XTB is the right place for you.

We are a certified Great Place to Work company.

We are looking for an Engineering Team Leader to drive the development and growth of the Salesforce Platform team. In this role, you will have the opportunity to shape the technical and cultural direction of the Salesforce ecosystem, lead a major architectural transformation, and play a key role in defining and delivering solutions that will have a lasting impact across a fast-growing customer base and product portfolio.

Responsibilities

  • Team Leadership: Shape and grow a high-performing Salesforce engineering team, creating an environment that promotes ownership, technical excellence, and continuous improvement, and the adoption of modern AI-assisted engineering practices.
  • Platform Strategy: Define and drive the Salesforce platform strategy in close collaboration with product teams, ensuring alignment with business objectives and product priorities.
  • Architecture Transformation: Lead the evolution toward offloading custom logic from Salesforce and building Java-based integrations.
  • Release Governance & Community: Oversee the Salesforce release process across multiple teams, ensuring consistent solution design, architectural alignment, and adoption of best practices, while fostering a collaborative Salesforce community across the organization.
  • Engineering Standards: Ensure the delivery of high-quality, maintainable, secure, and reusable Salesforce solutions by setting and enforcing engineering standards, best practices, and architectural patterns for shared, generic components.
  • Budget & Resource Management: Take accountability for the Salesforce platform budget and resource allocation, managing costs in line with business objectives and platform strategy.
  • Data-Driven Management: Define and track measurable objectives for the Salesforce platform, leveraging data and KPIs to evaluate performance, improvements, and ensure alignment with business outcomes.
  • User Support & Experience: Support several hundred Salesforce users across the organization through AI-driven automations and continuous user experience improvement.

Technical skills we expect

  • Solution Engineering & Design Standards: Proven experience defining design rules, establishing platform-wide best practices, and delivering maintainable solutions with reusable components.
  • Salesforce & Core Ecosystem: Deep knowledge in Salesforce (e.g., Cloud, Apex, LWC), integrations, managing data for millions of customers..
  • Integration & Microservices Architecture: Experience integrating Salesforce with microservices-based architectures and external systems. Solid understanding of event-driven architecture in modern tech companies.
  • DevOps & Release Engineering: Hands-on experience with Salesforce DX, CI/CD and source control workflows supporting complex, multi-team release processes.

Leadership & Management

  • Execution: Break down complex projects into actionable tasks; drive incremental value.
  • Growth: Mentor and support the professional growth of team members, promoting ownership and continuous improvement.
  • Collaboration: Facilitate workshops; build technical community; resolve conflicts effectively.
  • Operational Excellence: Drive operational excellence and reliability culture within the team; lead incident management and champion post-mortems.
  • Strategy: Proactively manage technical debt; align team output with organizational goals.

What we offer

  • Real influence on the development of the company and the product.
  • Work in an experienced team that is happy to share its knowledge.
  • A clear vision of development thanks to regular feedback and clear career paths.
  • Regular team-building meetings.

Benefits

  • A training budget for courses and conferences that interest you.
  • An extra day off on your birthday.
  • An extra day off for parents.
  • Equipment tailored to your needs.
  • Private medical care and group insurance.
  • Access to an e-learning platform for learning English and a benefits platform.
  • Access to a wellbeing platform and the opportunity to take advantage of workshops and private therapy sessions.
  • Remote work, from the office in Warsaw or from a coworking space in your city.

Job Description

Job Purpose

​​As a National Account Manager, you will be responsible for a specified channel. This role is uniquely positioned for an ambitious leader who is craving full ownership and accountability for our products and customers within the assigned Accounts. This is not a traditional sales role. We are searching for a candidate who shows a high level of ownership for their business and is adept at selling solutions and has a proven ability to win new business. We are seeking a candidate who is eager to be a leader, influencer and activator with internal and external key stakeholders from the first day on the job. ​

Essential Functions & Responsibilities

  • ​​Liaison to the customer and Kraft Heinz Sales organization.
  • ​Utilize market & insights data to identify potential customers.
  • ​Tailors programs consistent with customer’s strategy that deliver superior results and aligns with the business sectors’ expectations.
  • ​A bias toward action with an Entrepreneurial mentality, who can make and own decisions and embraces our “culture” of grit, action and perseverance.
  • ​Effective communication skills, both verbal and written, demonstrated by effective presentation, influence, and negotiation with internal and external stakeholders.
  • ​Strong financial acumen to build business cases, present internally to stakeholders, and impact P&L management.
  • ​Think creatively and critically, can learn new concepts and seeks to resolve complex problems.
  • ​Develops, tracks, analyzes, and evaluates insightful business plans based on AFH priorities, customer strategies/initiatives and external factors to build total customer profit.
  • ​Builds Kraft Heinz business with customer measured by profitability achievement, share gains, revenue targets, EBITA, Customer P&L, new and core item introductions/distribution.
  • ​Communicates and influence implementation of business plans to enable superior execution across vital team members (i.e. Supply Chain, Demand Planning, Legal, Culinary, Marketing, R&D).
  • ​Drives efficient and effective trade programs to deliver best return on investment.
  • ​Challenge both Kraft Heinz teams as well as external teams to drive creative ideas that capitalize on business opportunities.
  • ​Leads Joint Business Planning with strategic customers.
  • ​Prepare and present periodic business reviews for customers.​

Expected Experience & Required Skills

  • ​​Bachelor’s degree in business, marketing, sales, or related field preferred. Equivalent combination of education and experience will be considered.
  • ​Prior sales experience required with a demonstration of major account management resulting in profitable volume, customer penetration, attainment of new business and growth.

  • ​Command of business acumen and strong business intuition demonstrated by discernment that not every sales opportunity is equal and a track record of securing profitable volume and walking away from less profitable deals.

ACERCA DE LA POSICIÓN SALESFORCE DEVELOPER

En Vortech PCI Group buscamos incorporar un/a Salesforce Developer para colaborar en un proyecto internacional con uno de nuestros clientes, participando en el desarrollo, integración y evolución de soluciones Salesforce.

La persona seleccionada contribuirá al diseño y desarrollo de soluciones personalizadas, integraciones con sistemas corporativos y mejora continua de la plataforma Salesforce, trabajando en colaboración con equipos técnicos y funcionales en un entorno internacional.

Buscamos un perfil técnico, claramente orientado al desarrollo, con 3–5 años de experiencia en Salesforce, conocimientos sólidos de Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), SOQL y Salesforce Flow, experiencia en integraciones y buenas prácticas de ingeniería.

RESPONSABILIDADES

  • Diseñar, desarrollar y mantener soluciones Salesforce utilizando Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), SOQL y Salesforce Flow.
  • Desarrollar integraciones con sistemas internos y externos mediante APIs REST/SOAP y Platform Events.
  • Colaborar con analistas funcionales y equipos de negocio para transformar requisitos en soluciones técnicas escalables.
  • Participar en el diseño y evolución de aplicaciones, automatizaciones y modelos de datos Salesforce.
  • Desarrollar nuevas funcionalidades y optimizar las soluciones existentes, garantizando calidad y mantenibilidad.
  • Implementar pruebas unitarias y participar en code reviews.
  • Contribuir a procesos de migración de datos, calidad de la información y gobierno de la plataforma.
  • Resolver incidencias técnicas y dar soporte a entornos productivos siguiendo buenas prácticas de gestión de cambios.
  • Colaborar con equipos internacionales en la mejora continua de las soluciones Salesforce.

REQUISITOS

  • Entre 3 y 5 años de experiencia profesional desarrollando soluciones Salesforce.
  • Experiencia sólida en Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), SOQL y Salesforce Flow.
  • Experiencia en integraciones Salesforce mediante APIs REST/SOAP y patrones de integración.
  • Conocimiento y experiencia trabajando con Platform Events.
  • Certificación Salesforce Platform Developer I o superior (obligatoria).
  • Experiencia en desarrollo de componentes personalizados, automatizaciones y mantenimiento de aplicaciones Salesforce.
  • Conocimientos de testing unitario, depuración y buenas prácticas de desarrollo.
  • Capacidad para trabajar con autonomía y colaborar con equipos técnicos y funcionales.
  • Nivel profesional de inglés y español, tanto hablado como escrito.

VALORAREMOS ESPECIALMENTE

  • Certificación Salesforce Platform Developer II.
  • Certificaciones Salesforce Sales Cloud Consultant o Service Cloud Consultant.
  • Experiencia con Salesforce CPQ, Field Service Lightning o Marketing Cloud.
  • Conocimiento de Salesforce DX, Git y pipelines CI/CD.
  • Experiencia con herramientas middleware e integraciones empresariales.
  • Experiencia previa en los sectores energético, industrial, manufacturing o gases industriales.
  • Familiaridad con procesos ITIL o metodologías equivalentes de gestión de cambios.

CONDICIONES

  • Modalidad: 100% remoto desde cualquier parte de Europa.
  • Proyecto internacional.
  • Idiomas de trabajo: inglés y español.
  • Incorporación a un equipo especializado en soluciones Salesforce.

QUÉ OFRECEMOS

  • Participación en un proyecto internacional de desarrollo y evolución de soluciones Salesforce.
  • Entorno técnico colaborativo, con equipos especializados en Salesforce.
  • Oportunidad de trabajar con tecnologías actuales del ecosistema Salesforce.
  • Participación en proyectos de integración, automatización y mejora continua.
  • Autonomía técnica y colaboración directa con equipos funcionales y de negocio.
  • Acompañamiento cercano durante todo el proceso de selección.

¿TE INTERESA?

Si tienes experiencia desarrollando soluciones Salesforce con Apex, LWC, SOQL y Salesforce Flow, has trabajado con integraciones y buscas un nuevo proyecto internacional en modalidad 100% remota desde cualquier parte de Europa, nos encantará conocerte.

raw.description:
Enterprise Transformation Director – Insurance & Investments

1. Role Summary

The Enterprise Transformation Director is responsible for defining, leading, and overseeing the organization's enterprise-wide transformation strategy to improve business performance, operational efficiency, financial sustainability, customer experience, and long-term competitiveness.

Within the Insurance & Investments sector, the role drives large-scale transformation initiatives across business operations, technology, organizational structures, digital capabilities, governance, and customer-facing services.

The incumbent translates corporate strategy into an integrated transformation roadmap, oversees strategic programmes and transformation portfolios, and ensures initiatives deliver measurable business value. The role works closely with the CEO, executive leadership, business unit heads, and external partners to drive sustainable organizational change and achieve strategic objectives.

2. Key Responsibilities

A. Enterprise Transformation Strategy & Leadership

  • Define and lead the organization's enterprise-wide transformation strategy, vision, and execution roadmap.
  • Translate corporate strategy into transformation priorities, strategic initiatives, and measurable business outcomes.
  • Identify opportunities for business model innovation, organizational improvement, operational modernization, and sustainable growth.
  • Align transformation initiatives with corporate objectives, market developments, customer expectations, and regulatory requirements.
  • Advise the CEO and executive leadership on transformation priorities, investment decisions, and strategic opportunities.

B. Business Model & Operating Model Transformation

  • Lead enterprise-wide operating model redesign and organizational transformation initiatives.
  • Evaluate existing business structures, processes, capabilities, and operating models to identify improvement opportunities.
  • Drive business process reengineering, simplification, standardization, and automation.
  • Oversee transformation of insurance operations, investment services, distribution channels, and customer service functions.
  • Improve organizational agility, productivity, cost efficiency, and service delivery.

C. Digital & Technology Transformation

  • Oversee enterprise-wide digital transformation and technology modernization initiatives.
  • Drive adoption of cloud platforms, artificial intelligence, automation, advanced analytics, and digital business solutions.
  • Lead modernization and integration of enterprise applications, core insurance systems, investment platforms, and customer management technologies.
  • Collaborate with technology leadership to ensure digital investments support business strategy.
  • Promote innovation, data-driven decision-making, and technology-enabled business growth.

D. Transformation Portfolio & Programme Governance

  • Oversee the organization's strategic transformation portfolio, programmes, and major initiatives.
  • Establish enterprise transformation governance frameworks, performance controls, and reporting mechanisms.
  • Monitor transformation milestones, budgets, resource requirements, risks, and dependencies.
  • Coordinate transformation directors, programme managers, project leaders, and cross-functional teams.
  • Ensure initiatives are delivered within approved timelines, budgets, and quality standards.

E. Financial Performance & Value Creation

  • Develop transformation business cases, investment proposals, and financial impact assessments.
  • Identify opportunities to improve profitability, reduce operating costs, and optimize capital and resource utilization.
  • Monitor transformation expenditure, financial performance, and expected return on investment.
  • Establish benefits realization frameworks to track financial and non-financial outcomes.
  • Ensure transformation investments generate measurable and sustainable business value.

F. Organizational Change & Cultural Transformation

  • Lead enterprise-wide change management and organizational development strategies.
  • Work with HR and business leaders to drive workforce transformation, leadership alignment, and cultural change.
  • Build organizational readiness and employee engagement for major transformation initiatives.
  • Oversee communication, training, capability development, and change adoption programmes.
  • Promote a culture of innovation, accountability, adaptability, and continuous improvement.

G. Risk, Compliance & Regulatory Transformation

  • Ensure enterprise transformation initiatives align with applicable insurance, investment, financial services, and regulatory requirements.
  • Oversee transformation-related strategic, operational, financial, technology, and compliance risks.
  • Collaborate with risk, compliance, legal, and internal audit teams to strengthen governance and controls.
  • Drive initiatives that improve operational resilience, data governance, cybersecurity, and regulatory readiness.
  • Ensure transformation programmes maintain appropriate oversight, accountability, and auditability.

H. Executive Stakeholder & Board Engagement

  • Build strong relationships with the CEO, board members, executive committees, and business unit leaders.
  • Present transformation strategies, performance reports, financial outcomes, and strategic recommendations.
  • Lead enterprise transformation steering committees and executive review meetings.
  • Manage relationships with external consultants, strategic partners, technology providers, and regulators.
  • Ensure executive alignment and accountability for transformation outcomes.

3. Required Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Economics, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related discipline.
  • Master's degree or MBA is strongly preferred.
  • 15+ years of progressive experience in enterprise transformation, corporate strategy, business transformation, management consulting, or executive programme leadership.
  • At least 5–7 years in a senior director-level or enterprise transformation leadership position.
  • Proven experience leading large-scale, enterprise-wide transformation initiatives within complex organizations.
  • Experience in insurance, banking, investment management, or financial services is highly desirable.
  • Strong expertise in operating model redesign, business process reengineering, digital transformation, and organizational change.
  • Demonstrated experience managing large transformation portfolios, budgets, executive stakeholders, and multidisciplinary teams.
  • Strong financial management, strategic planning, governance, and benefits realization capabilities.
  • Certifications such as PgMP, PMP, Prosci Change Management, Lean Six Sigma, TOGAF, or equivalent are advantageous.

4. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Achievement of enterprise transformation strategy and strategic milestones.

Who we are looking for:

We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced SeniorProduct Manager, Customer Communications Management to help define what MHC NorthStar should be and how we get there. This role is both strategic and hands-on, focused on deciding where automation and intelligence can remove manual work, where personalization can change how people consume information, and turning those decisions into clear, precise, AI-ready requirements that engineering teams and AI-assisted development workflows can build from.

The ideal candidate brings solid knowledge of customer communications management (CCM) and intelligent document automation, along with a strong sense of the market. This individual will work across the company with Engineering, UX, Customer Success, Sales, Marketing, and Product Enablement, and alongside the Product Owners on the team who help with day-to-day prioritization and triage.

What you will get to do:

Shape Product Direction with Market & Customer Insight
•Build and maintain a working understanding of CCM and document automation capabilities: template design and authoring, document composition and generation, data integration, multichannel output, and document ingestion and capture
•Look for where manual work still lives in our customers' communication and document processes and identify the biggest opportunities to automate it and make it intelligent
•Look for where information reaches people in a generic form, and shape capabilities that personalize how it is created, delivered, and consumed
•Track the competitive landscape, analyst perspectives, and emerging customer expectations, and turn them into clear product recommendations about what it takes to be #1

Define Products in AI-Native, Build-Ready PRDs
•Write PRDs that are precise, structured, and testable: clear goals, constraints, inputs and outputs, edge cases, and measurable acceptance criteria, including at least three Given/When/Then scenarios per feature
•Specify the behavior of autonomous and AI-driven capabilities: expected outputs, quality thresholds, evaluation approach, failure modes, human-in-the-loop points, and guardrails
•Define how each capability reduces manual effort or improves personalization, and how we will measure that
•Write requirements that people and AI agents can both act on without guessing, and keep them current as we learn
•Work with Engineering and UX to refine scope, feasibility, and sequencing

Prioritize & Deliver

  • Set the strategic context for prioritization using the MHC prioritization framework, tying work to customer, market, and BHAG outcomes
    •Bring recommendations to the Betting Table for strategic investment decisions

Communicate & Collaborate

  • Keep Engineering, Customer Success, Sales, and leadership informed through roadmap views and regular updates
    •Contribute to QBRs and launch planning with Marketing and Product Enablement

What Success Looks Like in This Role:

  • CCM and market understanding strong enough that your recommendations visibly shape roadmap decisions
    •Clear, current, build-ready PRDs for your capability areas that Engineering can execute with few clarification loops
    •Measurable impact from the work you define on reducing manual effort or improving personalization for customers
    •Customer and market evidence clearly connected to what we choose to build

Knowledge and Skills:

  • Professional background in CCM or document automation, for example at a CCM vendor, in a customer's communications or document operations, or in a related role
    •Experience in adjacent areas such as intelligent document processing, AP automation, or industry-specific communications in insurance, financial services, or healthcare
    •Experience specifying products that are built with AI-assisted engineering workflows
    •Familiarity with Dual Track Agile and continuous discovery
    •Tools and tech stack: Aha!, Azure DevOps, or similar tools

Education and Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience
    •A minimum of 5+ years of product management experience in B2B or enterprise software
    •A working understanding of CCM or document automation concepts, such as templates, document composition, data integration, and multichannel output, and the ability to ramp up quickly on the rest
    •Awareness of the CCM and document automation market, including competitors, buyers, and use cases, or experience in comparable enterprise software markets that you can apply quickly
    •Experience writing PRDs or specifications for AI or LLM-based features, including evaluation criteria and non-deterministic behavior
    •A track record of building automation, intelligence, or personalization into products in ways that measurably reduce customer effort
    •Strong written communication; your specs are read by engineers and executives, and increasingly by AI agents
    •Sound judgment and comfort with ambiguity, with the ability to pick a direction and test it against evidence

If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.

Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job

Senior Business Analysts specializing in M&A transactions and strategy consulting to support the origination, evaluation, and execution of acquisitions, divestitures, investments, and strategic partnerships. The role bridges corporate strategy with rigorous commercial and financial analysis, evaluating companies, assets, and transactions across a broad range of industries.

Responsibilities

  • Conduct commercial, financial, and operational due diligence on target companies and assets, integrating inputs from legal, tax, technical, and other specialist advisors.

  • Build and maintain financial models (DCF, LBO, merger and accretion/dilution, sum-of-the-parts, comparable transactions and companies) for valuations and corporate transactions.

  • Support the full M&A deal cycle, from origination and screening through valuation, structuring, negotiation support, and closing, on both buy-side and sell-side mandates.

  • Deliver corporate and business-unit strategy work, including market sizing, industry and competitive analysis, growth strategies, portfolio reviews, and investment theses.

  • Prepare investment memoranda, information memoranda, pitch books, valuation summaries, and board- and investment-committee-level presentations.

  • Monitor M&A activity, capital markets, sector trends, and the competitive landscape to identify and prioritize opportunities.

  • Support deal execution, including data room management, coordination with legal teams, advisors, and counterparties, and review of transaction documents (term sheets, SPAs, shareholder agreements).

  • Assess regulatory, geopolitical, ESG, and integration risks, and contribute to synergy assessment and post-merger integration planning.

  • Structure and evaluate transaction alternatives, including asset vs. share deals, joint ventures, minority stakes, earn-outs, deferred and contingent consideration, and structured or hybrid financing (e.g., royalties, streams, prepays, offtakes), and assess their impact on value and counterparty risk.

Requirements

Requirements

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Finance, Economics, Business Administration, Engineering, or a related quantitative field.

  • 5+ years of relevant experience in M&A, investment banking, transaction advisory, private equity, corporate development, or strategy consulting.

  • Hands-on exposure to live M&A transactions (buy-side and/or sell-side) is highly desirable.

  • Formal business education or training is a plus (MBA, CFA progress, or equivalent practical commercial experience).

  • Demonstrated experience with strategy consulting methods and structured problem solving (hypothesis-driven analysis, market and competitive assessment).

  • Working knowledge of transaction structures and documentation (term sheets, SPAs, shareholder agreements) and of acquisition financing instruments.

  • Strong financial modelling and valuation skills.

  • Ability to translate complex commercial, operational, and financial information into clear investment recommendations.

  • Advanced proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint; familiarity with financial databases (e.g., Capital IQ, Bloomberg, PitchBook) is an advantage.

  • English fluent

  • Strong analytical, quantitative, and problem-solving abilities.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication, including report and presentation preparation.

  • Ability to manage multiple workstreams under deadline pressure.

  • Attention to detail and sound commercial judgement.

Preferred / Advantageous

  • Sector experience in mining and metals, agribusiness, or infrastructure.

  • Experience with cross-border transactions.

  • Additional languages and willingness to travel to target companies, assets, and counterparties.

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

  • Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page:

  • Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

  • Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

  • Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ or @

  • We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

Why this role and why now?

Organizations worldwide are under pressure to get more value from their assets, faster. Ultimo is growing rapidly, both globally and in the US, and our North American customers are increasingly multi-site manufacturers and distribution networks moving off legacy CMMS platforms such as MainSaver. Getting their data and technical foundation right is what makes or breaks a go‑live.

This is not a back-office data role. You are the technical lead our customers work with, from the first scoping call to cutover weekend, and the person their IT team trusts on data, environments, and technical design.

If you enjoy solving technical problems with customers, getting hands-on with data, and seeing a go‑live land cleanly, this is your moment.

Your impact

As Technical Consultant, Data Migration, you own the technical side of Ultimo implementations: moving customers’ asset, maintenance, and inventory data into Ultimo, and making sure the platform is set up to run reliably in their environment. You work directly with customer maintenance and IT teams, alongside our consultants, project manager, Solution Architect, and Integration Specialist.

You are trusted to lead the technical workstream, not just to support it.

What you’ll be doing:

  • Act as the technical lead on North American implementations, from estimate through go‑live and handover to support
  • Run technical workshops with customer IT teams covering environments, security, user access, data, and the systems Ultimo will connect to
  • Turn business and technical requirements into a sound technical design, working with the Solution Architect and functional consultants
  • Handle the technical side of configuration, including user roles and permissions, advanced configuration, and custom reports and queries
  • Scope and estimate data migration work before proposals go out, using standard discovery questions and validating assumptions with the customer’s IT team
  • Lead data workshops, source-system analysis, field mapping, and data cleansing guidance
  • Run trial loads, reconciliation, and validation cycles, and secure customer sign-off on migrated data before go‑live
  • Build and run the cutover plan with the project manager, and be on site for cutover and early go‑live support where needed
  • Work with the Integration Specialist to define data requirements for integrations and test them end to end
  • Troubleshoot technical issues through testing, go‑live, and early life support, and raise scope changes early through the change order process
  • Cross-train consultants on data migration and technical work so that no project depends on a single person
  • Build a North American data migration toolkit with our European practice, applying AI‑assisted methods to mapping, cleansing, and validation
  • Support sales on qualified opportunities where data or technical complexity is a material risk
  • Document technical and data decisions so that support can take over cleanly after go‑live

This role is a great fit if you:

  • Bring 5+ years of hands‑on experience as a technical consultant on EAM / CMMS / ERP implementations, including leading data migrations (MainSaver, IBM Maximo, SAP PM, Infor, or similar)
  • Have strong SQL and data-transformation skills, and are comfortable with ETL tooling, data profiling, and large spreadsheets
  • Understand enterprise SaaS environments, including security and user access, single sign-on, and how systems exchange data through APIs and files
  • Have carried a cutover through to go‑live and know how to keep a migration on track when the source data is worse than expected
  • Can turn a short discovery conversation into a defensible estimate and explain the assumptions behind it
  • Can build reports and queries that help customers trust and use their data
  • Communicate confidently and clearly with maintenance managers and IT directors, including when the news is not good
  • Enjoy sharing what you know and helping teammates build their technical skills
  • Have an affinity with AI and emerging technologies, and are curious about applying them to mapping, cleansing, and testing
  • Take ownership and act proactively, with a genuine commitment to customer success

Ready to step up?

If you want to be the person customers trust with their data and the technical health of their implementation, and help make data migration a strength of how Ultimo delivers, this is the opportunity.

This role is remote within the US, ideally based in the Eastern or Central time zone, with regular travel to customer sites around technical workshops, trial loads, and cutover.

Apply now and help organizations get more out of their assets faster.

About the Role

We are hiring a Legal Operations Lead & AI Builder to run the operational backbone of our legal department and lead how we use AI. You will work closely with the Deputy General Counsel, Data, Privacy & Compliance on privacy operations and AI governance, ensuring every tool you build protects privilege and personal data. This is an individual contributor role today, with the opportunity to build a small team as the program grows. A law degree is not required.

What You Will Do

Legal operations

  • Own contract lifecycle management and legal intake, including administering Ironclad workflows, templates, clause libraries, and approvals, and integrating with Zip and Salesforce for procurement and sales contracting.
  • Run privacy operations inDataGrail, including data subject request workflows, data maps, and system inventories, in partnership with the Deputy GC, who sets privacy policy.
  • Build and maintain legal metrics and dashboards, such as contract volume, cycle time, and request turnaround, and support legal budget planning and tracking.
  • Own the legal technology stack, including vendor relationships, renewals, evaluations, and the roadmap.
  • Design and document scalable processes, playbooks, and knowledge resources for the legal team.

AI building

  • Design, build, and maintain Claude and GC AI skills, Projects, and agents for legal workflows such as contract review, NDA triage, intake routing, and policy questions.
  • Build self-service AI tools for business teams such as sales, procurement, and HR, with clear escalation paths to attorneys.
  • Evaluate and deploy legal AI tools, including GC AI, and identify where AI can save time or reduce risk.
  • Test and monitor tool quality through test cases, output review, and iteration, and measure adoption and time saved.
  • Train and support legal and business users and maintain clear documentation for every tool.

Privilege, privacy, and AI governance

  • Design guardrails that protect attorney-client privilege and work product, including attorney oversight, routing of sensitive questions, output labeling, and access controls.
  • Ensure AI tools handle personal and confidential data consistently with our customer commitments, including data minimization and retention settings.
  • Partner with IT and the CISO on access management, configuration, and vendor security reviews.

Required Skills and Experience

  • 5+ years of legal operations experience, ideally within an in-house legal department.
  • Hands-on administration experience with Ironclad,DataGrail, Salesforce and Zip, or directly comparable platforms.
  • Demonstrated experience building with Claude, including skills, Projects, prompt design, and agents. Be prepared to walk us through tools you have built.
  • Working knowledge of attorney-client privilege, work product, and core data privacy principles, and how they apply to AI tools.
  • A track recordof drivingadoption andchangemanagement with lawyers and business users.
  • Strong analytical skills, including building dashboards and reporting on metrics.
  • Clear, practical communication and the ability to work independently.
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience. A JD is not required.
  • Fluency in written and spoken English.

Preferred Skills and Experience

  • Experience in EdTech, higher education, or B2B SaaS.
  • Involvement in CLOC or the broader legal operations community, such as speaking, writing, or leading working groups.
  • Familiarity with AI governance frameworks, such as the NIST AI RMF.
  • Experience supporting a global legal team.

We're an education company that builds technology. Learn more at blackboard.com.

raw.description:
This position will operate on a remote, freelance basis. Applicants must be located in the US or Canada.

Is your desk covered in Raspberry Pis, half-finished ESP32 builds and test prints? Do you run a 3D printer, tinker with single-board computers and keep a home lab going, and actually enjoy explaining what worked, what didn’t and why? Can you take a weekend project and turn it into a story readers can’t stop reading?

Valnet's Tech brands (XDA and How-to Geek) are looking for a Features Writer who lives at the crossroads of maker tech and computing. You’ll write first-person, hands-on features based on real projects you build, break, fix and improve.

We’re looking for a sharp, practical voice to cover these verticals:

  • Raspberry Pi & SBCs: Pi 5, Pi Zero, Pico and other single-board computers. Projects, setups, edge AI, value comparisons (SBC vs. mini PC) and community builds worth showing off.
  • Microcontrollers & DIY Electronics: Arduino, ESP32, GPIO projects, sensors and practical gadgets for the home and desk.
  • 3D Printing: Filaments (PLA, PETG, ABS, TPU and others), slicer settings, printer upgrades and monitoring, model management, and useful prints that solve real problems around the house, office and home lab.
  • Home Lab & Self-Hosting: NAS builds, TrueNAS, Proxmox, Docker, Jellyfin/Plex, and running local services on low-power hardware.
  • Mini PCs & Alternative OSes: Small-form-factor builds, Linux distros, and the odd niche OS that’s fun to explore.

Job Responsibilities

  • Contribute reliably and consistently under tight deadlines. Work includes hands-on features, project write-ups, tutorials, listicles and opinion pieces, plus timely news on Raspberry Pi and 3D printing launches.
  • Pitch original story ideas drawn from your own builds, experiments and failures.
  • Take original photos of your projects, prints and setups, and find and format images according to our guidelines.
  • Enter your work into our in-house CMS.
  • Stay current with maker, SBC, 3D printing and self-hosting news, including product releases, price changes, software updates and standout community projects.
  • Coordinate with the editorial team on assignments and feedback.

Application Requirements

  • CV
  • Cover Letter (tell us why you want to write for us, and what’s on your workbench right now!)
  • 2–3 tech articles you’ve written that best show your writing. Hands-on or project-based pieces are strongly preferred.

Applicants must have a self-starter attitude and meet the following requirements:

  • Relevant experience writing and editing in English.
  • Ownership of, and regular hands-on experience with, at least one 3D printer and one or more Raspberry Pis or other SBCs.
  • Working knowledge of Linux, the command line, and setting up and troubleshooting self-hosted services (Docker experience is a plus).
  • Comfort with slicers (e.g., Bambu Studio, OrcaSlicer, PrusaSlicer, Cura) and with diagnosing print-quality problems.
  • The ability to explain technical projects clearly and with personality, for beginners and experienced tinkerers alike.

Nice to Have

  • CAD experience (Fusion, OpenSCAD, Onshape, Tinkercad or similar) for designing your own prints.
  • Experience with Arduino, ESP32 or Pico projects, including basic wiring or soldering.
  • A home lab or NAS setup you actively maintain.
  • A background in IT, sysadmin or networking.

The hiring team will get back to you as soon as possible if we think you’d be a solid addition to the team. We only consider applications that include relevant writing samples.

About Us

At Medius, we believe managing finance should be about strategy, not stress. That same mindset shapes not only the solutions we build, but also the culture we create for our people. We remove complexity, embrace innovation, and give our teams the freedom to focus on what truly matters — whether that’s transforming the future of finance with AI or finding balance to go home on time.

Founded in Sweden in 2001, Medius has grown from a local startup into a global leader in cloud-based spend management solutions. Today, thousands of organizations worldwide trust us to simplify accounts payable and spend management processes. Our journey has been driven by continuous innovation, a passion for technology, and above all — the people who make it happen.

We’re more than a software company. We’re a team of problem-solvers, innovators and collaborators working together to reinvent the category of accounts payable. Our solutions use Artificial Intelligence to eliminate manual work, bring clarity, confidence, and control, and empower finance teams of the future.

At Medius,our values guide how we work and grow together:

  • Connect – We believe in the power of people—individually and collectively—and our success depends on understanding and respecting each other. We appreciate that ‘empowering finance teams of the future’ is an exciting endeavor, and we share it with everyone around us.

  • Question – We enjoy the challenge of our work and the thrill of collaboration. We are not afraid to question ourselves and each other because we believe diverse perspectives can lead to better outcomes and that there is great power in resolution.

  • Own – We are thorough, thoughtful, and decisive. We anticipate what’s next, what a customer might need, and then we deliver. That’s how we get things done. And that’s how we remain a leader. Customers trust us to do our job so that they can focus on what they do best.

At Medius, you’ll join a diverse, global community where curiosity is celebrated, ideas matter, and innovation never stops. If you’re passionate about technology, eager to make an impact, and ready to grow alongside a team that lives its values, Medius is where you can do your best work — your impact is global.

Learn more at

Job overview

Medius helps finance teams get their time back by taking the work and worry out of invoices. Partners are a big part of how we get there: ERP and technology alliances, resellers, consultancies, and marketplaces that put Medius in front of more customers and get them up and running faster.

As Global Head of Partners & Ecosystems, you'll own that whole picture. You'll set the strategy, build the programs, lead the team, and answer for the revenue and reach partners bring in. You will report directly to the Chief Revenue Officer, who is based in North America and manage a team of high performing professionals across North America and Europe.

Responsibilities and Duties

  • Set the strategy.Define the global partner and ecosystem plan, tied to Medius's growth goals and go-to-market priorities.

  • Build the programs.Design tiers, incentives, enablement, and onboarding for each partner type: resellers, technology and ERP alliances, consultancies and integrators, and marketplaces.

  • Grow partner revenue.Own partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline, bookings, and retention, with clear targets by region.

  • Deepen strategic alliances.Build executive-level relationships with the ERP, cloud, and technology vendors our customers already rely on, and turn them into joint plans with real results.

  • Make partners part of the sales motion.Work with Sales, Marketing, Product, Customer Success, and Finance so partners are built into how we sell, deliver, and support, not bolted on afterward.

  • Speed up customer onboarding.Make sure partners can deliver Medius implementations and integrations well, so customers see value quickly.

  • Shape the roadmap.Bring partner and ecosystem input into product priorities, including integrations and marketplace listings.

  • Run it with discipline.Set metrics, governance, and regular business reviews. Forecast accurately and report to leadership with no surprises.

  • Lead the team.Hire, develop, and coach a global partner organization, and keep it focused on the things that matter most.

Qualifications

  • 12+ years in B2B SaaS, with at least 5 leading partner, alliance, or channel teams at a global scale

  • A track record of building and scaling partner programs that produced measurable revenue, not just logos

  • Experience across several partner models: ERP and technology alliances, system integrators, resale and marketplace or co-sell

  • Strong commercial instincts: you can build a business case, set targets, forecast, and manage a budget

  • Comfort working with C-level executives at partners and at Medius

  • Experience leading distributed teams across regions and cultures

  • A collaborative style. You get results by working through Sales, Product, Marketing, and Customer Success, not around them.

  • Clear, plain communication, in writing and in the room

Preferred -

  • Background in accounts payable automation, spend management, fintech, or finance software

  • Hands-on experience with ERP ecosystems and the partners around them

  • Experience launching or scaling a cloud marketplace presence

  • Experience in a company that has grown through both direct and partner-led sales

  • Fluency in more than one language

Medius is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices.

The estimated base salary range for this role is $225,000+ USD, which represents a good-faith estimate of the compensation for this position. This role also receives a variable component that is added to the base for an On Target of around $350k+

Actual compensation will be determined based on several factors, including but not limited to relevant skills, experience, qualifications, certifications, internal equity, and the geographic location in which the role is performed. Compensation may vary for roles performed in different locations due to differences in the cost of labor.

The total compensation package for this position may also include eligibility for variable compensation (such as a performance bonus or commission), benefits, and/or participation in other incentive or benefit plans, in accordance with the terms of the applicable plans. Benefits may include medical, dental, and vision coverage, paid time off, and retirement benefits, subject to eligibility requirements.

At the forefront of health tech innovation, CopilotIQ+Biofourmis is transforming in-home care with the industry's first AI-driven platform that supports individuals through every stage of their health journey-from pre-surgical optimization to acute, post-acute and chronic care. We are helping people live healthier, longer lives by bringing personalized, proactive care directly into their homes. With CopilotIQ's commitment to enhancing the lives of seniors with chronic conditions and Biofourmis' advanced data-driven insights and virtual care solutions, we're setting a new standard in accessible healthcare. If you're passionate about driving real change in healthcare, join the CopilotIQ+Biofourmis Team!

What is the Telehealth Nurse role?

We are seeking nurses (LPN/LVN) to provide outstanding care to members with diseases such as hypertension, diabetes, and heart failure through remote patient monitoring. The Telehealth Nurse will support members through regular phone visits during which they will discuss how to make progress towards goals, medical and lifestyle education, and how to improve outcomes on chronic conditions.

This position offers full-time hours (Monday through Friday 8:30am-5pm local time), benefits, and the ability to work from home.

What you’ll be doing:

  • Perform regular telehealth calls to a dedicated panel of members.
  • Accurately and confidently provide medical, diet, and wellness education to members.
  • Ensure accurate and timely documentation.
  • Maintain good member/nurse rapport.
  • Ability to perform high quality, high volume calls.
  • Drive clinical outcomes through member engagement and coordination
  • Escalate members to our Provider team as needed.
  • Provide device support and troubleshooting in a professional, knowledgeable manner.
  • Provide support and encouragement as indicated.
  • Maintain a good rapport with members, nursing team, and providers.
  • As a member of our team, foster and grow a culture of kindness, compassion, and mutual respect.
  • Assist with special projects and other assignments as needed.

What you’ll bring:

  • Must have a current, active, unrestricted LPN/RN multi-state compact license in a nursing compact state and be in good standing with the Board of Registered Nurses.
  • A minimum of 2 years hands on nursing experience is required; telehealth and chronic care management experience is strongly preferred.
  • EHR experience, specifically AthenaHealth, is a plus.
  • Fluency in English and Spanish is highly preferred.
  • Comfortable working on a computer; experience navigating through multiple computer applications while on calls; Macbook experience is a plus.
  • Must have reliable high-speed internet.
  • Strong time management skills and self-motivation.
  • Must be a quick learner in a fast paced, changing environment.
  • Professional and effective communication style that translates across all members of the team and members.
  • An attitude and work ethic that meets the core values and goals of CopilotIQ.
  • Self-motivated and able to work well independently.
  • A willingness to jump in and help where needed to ensure team success.

raw.description:
This is where your work makes a difference.

At Baxter, we believe every person—regardless of who they are or where they are from—deserves a chance to live a healthy life. It was our founding belief in 1931 and continues to be our guiding principle. We are redefining healthcare delivery to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond.

Our Baxter colleagues are united by our Mission to Save and Sustain Lives. Together, our community is driven by a culture of courage, trust, and collaboration. Every individual is empowered to take ownership and make a meaningful impact. We strive for efficient and effective operations, and we hold each other accountable for delivering exceptional results.

Here, you will find more than just a job—you will find purpose and pride.


Job Description

Your Role at Baxter

As a Technical Support Specialist, you will provide front-line support for Baxter's infusion systems, software applications, and connected technologies used in healthcare environments. This is where you can make an impact by helping hospitals, clinicians, biomedical technicians, and IT teams quickly resolve technical issues involving equipment that supports patient care. In this role, you'll balance technical support activities with case management and ticket processing while partnering with customers to maintain system performance and uptime.


What You'll Do

  • Provide Level 1 technical support via phone, email, and future chat channels for Baxter infusion pumps, associated software, and connected digital products.
  • Troubleshoot hardware, software, connectivity, and system-related issues using established troubleshooting guides, technical documentation, and standard operating procedures.
  • Process, document, and manage customer cases, ensuring accurate updates, issue tracking, and timely resolution of support requests.
  • Support Return Material Authorization (RMA) activities for devices requiring repair, replacement, or depot service.
  • Guide customers through product setup, configuration, and operational issues related to Baxter infusion systems and software applications.
  • Escalate complex technical issues to advanced support teams and collaborate with internal partners to drive resolution.
  • Utilize support systems, Microsoft applications, knowledge management tools, laptops, tablets, and mobile devices to manage daily work activities.
  • Maintain compliance with HIPAA, GDPR, and all applicable environmental, health, and safety requirements.

What You'll Bring

  • High school diploma or GED.
  • 1+ years of technical support, help desk, desktop support, service desk, or technical call center experience.
  • Experience troubleshooting computer hardware, software applications, operating systems, and connected devices.
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft Windows operating systems and general computer networking concepts.
  • Experience using case management, ticketing, CRM, or knowledge management systems.
  • Experience utilizing Microsoft Office applications, including Outlook, Excel, and Word, to support daily work activities.
  • Experience supporting customers via phone, email, or other service channels.
  • Ability to work the scheduled 10:00 AM - 7:00 PM EST shift and participate in a rotating on-call schedule approximately every six weeks.

We understand compensation is an important factor as you consider the next step in your career. At Baxter, we are committed to equitable pay for all employees, and we strive to be more transparent with our pay practices. The estimated base salary for this position is $44,800 - $61,600. The estimated range is meant to reflect an anticipated salary range for the position. We may pay more or less than of the anticipated range based upon market data and other factors, all of which are subject to change. Individual pay is based on upon location, skills and expertise, experience, and other relevant factors. For questions about this, our pay philosophy, and available benefits, please speak to the recruiter if you decide to apply and are selected for an interview.

Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa at this time.

US Benefits at Baxter (except for Puerto Rico)

This is where your well-being matters. Baxter offers comprehensive compensation and benefits packages for eligible roles. Our health and well-being benefits include medical and dental coverage that start on day one, as well as insurance coverage for basic life, accident, short-term and long-term disability, and business travel accident insurance. Financial and retirement benefits include the Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP), with the ability to purchase company stock at a discount, and the 401(k) Retirement Savings Plan (RSP), with options for employee contributions and company matching. We also offer Flexible Spending Accounts, educational assistance programs, and time-off benefits such as paid holidays, paid time off ranging from 20 to 35 days based on length of service, family and medical leaves of absence, and paid parental leave. Additional benefits include commuting benefits, the Employee Discount Program, the Employee Assistance Program (EAP), and childcare benefits. Join us and enjoy the competitive compensation and benefits we offer to our employees. For additional information regarding Baxter US Benefits, please speak with your recruiter or visit our Benefits site: Benefits | Baxter

Equal Employment Opportunity

Baxter is an equal opportunity employer. Baxter evaluates qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, protected veteran status, disability/handicap status or any other legally protected characteristic.

Know Your Rights: Workplace Discrimination is Illegal

Reasonable Accommodations

Baxter is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities globally. If, because of a medical condition or disability, you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the application or interview process, please click on the link here and let us know the nature of your request along with your contact information.

Recruitment Fraud Notice

Baxter has discovered incidents of employment scams, where fraudulent parties pose as Baxter employees, recruiters, or other agents, and engage with online job seekers in an attempt to steal personal and/or financial information. To learn how you can protect yourself, review our Recruitment Fraud Notice.

AI Disclaimer

Baxter may use AI-enabled technologies to support portions of the hiring process, such as scheduling or skills matching. Final decisions regarding candidate applications and selection are made by our hiring teams, who review any AI-assisted outputs before decisions are made, and we remain committed to fairness, inclusion, and thoughtful decision-making led by our hiring teams throughout the selection process. Our AI-enabled technologies do not automatically disqualify candidates or make hiring decisions.

raw.description:
As a global leader in cybersecurity, CrowdStrike protects the people, processes and technologies that drive modern organizations. Since 2011, our mission hasn’t changed — we’re here to stop breaches, and we’ve redefined modern security with the world’s most advanced AI-native platform. We work on large scale distributed systems, processing almost 3 trillion events per day and this traffic is growing daily. Our customers span all industries, and they count on CrowdStrike to keep their businesses running, their communities safe and their lives moving forward. We're proud to work for a mission-driven company leveraging AI to transform the way we work. CrowdStrikers drive their careers through flexibility and autonomy while also being expected to contribute to a culture of responsible AI adoption, experimentation, and innovation. We use an AI-first mindset as a force multiplier to proactively and continuously accelerate execution, build expertise, uncover insights, and solve complex problems. We’re always looking to add talented CrowdStrikers to the team who have limitless passion, a relentless focus on innovation and a fanatical commitment to our customers, our community and each other. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you.



About the Role:

Are you ready for your next real security challenge? Are you passionate about helping organizations stop breaches using a platform that just works? If so, CrowdStrike is seeking a Sales Engineer with significant security expertise. You should be able to articulate how current security solutions are designed and deployed, and why they are failing. You will be part of a team responsible for changing what the security market and customers believe is possible with the AI-native CrowdStrike Falcon platform, spanning endpoint, cloud, identity, exposure management and next-gen SIEM.


You should be comfortable working in a fast-paced environment on multiple engagements.


This role is remote-based in or around the Paris area.


What You'll Do:

  • Understand customer needs: lead technical discovery to understand customer pain points, goals and risk exposure, and qualify opportunities with MEDDPICC, from the first engagement through expansion.
  • Be a trusted advisor: help customers understand their risk exposure and how CrowdStrike is uniquely positioned to reduce it, building long-term relationships with technical and executive stakeholders.
  • Present and demonstrate: deliver compelling presentations, whiteboards and tailored demos of the Falcon platform across AI, endpoint, cloud, identity, exposure management and next-gen SIEM, from SOC analysts to C-level executives.
  • Deliver Proofs of Value: design and run POVs tied to measurable customer objectives (risk reduction, improved efficiency, cost savings) and turn them into technical wins.
  • Answer RFPs: own the technical response to customer RFPs and security questionnaires.
  • Work as one team: act as the technical bridge between CrowdStrike and customers, aligning with Sales on account strategy and working with specialists (CTEM, AI, SecOps, Identity), Product, Marketing and Customer Success.
  • Share and continuously improve: share projects, scripts and best practices with the team, use customer feedback to improve the pre-sales process, and build technical champions in your accounts.

What You'll Need:

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in a relevant field
  • Sales engineering background or 5+ years of relevant work experience
  • Broad cybersecurity background across multiple domains – endpoint (EDR/XDR), security operations (SIEM/SOAR, incident response, forensics, threat hunting), cloud security, identity protection and exposure/vulnerability management – with a clear understanding of how they come together in a modern security architecture
  • Strong understanding of Windows, macOS and Linux operating systems
  • Strong self-starter, able to work independently and manage multiple engagements at once
  • Ability to travel as required
  • Proven experience utilizing AI technologies to enhance decision-making, streamline workflows and processes, improve efficiency and drive business outcomes.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills with the ability to present to a variety of external audiences, including C-level executives
  • Extensive contacts in the information security field and strong references
  • English and French fluency

Preferred Skills:

  • CTEM (Continuous Threat Exposure Management): exposure and vulnerability management, internal and external attack surface management, asset discovery and risk-based prioritization of remediation
  • AI: AI-driven SOC workflows and agentic automation, securing AI/LLM workloads (AI-SPM, prompt injection, data leakage), and positioning AI-native security to technical and business audiences
  • SecOps / Next-Gen SIEM: SIEM and log management, SOAR and workflow automation, SOC modernization and legacy SIEM displacement (e.g. Splunk, QRadar, Sentinel), detection engineering and threat hunting
  • Identity: Active Directory and Entra ID security, Identity Threat Detection and Response (ITDR), credential-based attacks and lateral movement, Zero Trust and IdP integrations (Okta, Ping)

Bonus Points:

  • Experience with malware, threat intelligence, and/or sandbox analysis
  • Experience with programming or scripting languages such as PowerShell, Python, and Bash
  • Experience with virtualization/VDI technologies
  • Experience with large scale cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, GCP, etc.
  • Understanding of the OSI model
  • Certifications such as CEH, CISSP, OSCP, and SANS

#-LI-Remote


Benefits of Working at CrowdStrike:

  • Market leader in compensation and equity awards
  • Comprehensive physical and mental wellness programs
  • Competitive vacation and holidays for recharge
  • Paid parental and adoption leaves
  • Professional development opportunities for all employees regardless of level or role
  • Employee Networks, geographic neighborhood groups, and volunteer opportunities to build connections
  • Vibrant office culture with world class amenities
  • Great Place to Work Certified™ across the globe
